title: Field Accountmanager Samsung
description:
"Als Field Accountmanager bij CPM krijg je de kans om populaire winkels zoals MediaMarkt, Coolblue en KPN te bezoeken en hen te adviseren en enthousiasmeren over de nieuwste Telecom producten van Samsung. En alsof dat nog niet genoeg is, kun je deze winkels bezoeken in een te gekke Cupra. Sluit je aan bij ons ambitieuze team, waar we jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal stellen. Start als Field Accountmanager voor Samsung bij CPM en solliciteer!"

Als Field Accountmanager bieden wij jou:

  • Een contract voor 40 uur per week met een looptijd van 12 maanden;
  • Als Field Accountmanager verdien je een startsalaris van €2925,- per maand o.b.v. 40 uur;
  • Een super toffe Cupra (auto) van de zaak die je ook privé mag rijden (Bijtelling van toepassing);
  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden, structurele coaching en een op maat gemaakt en volledig betaald trainingstraject van 2 jaar;
  • Maandelijkse onkosten vergoeding van €60,- netto;
  • 25 verlofdagen per jaar en deelname aan ons pensioenplan;
  • Verschillende Samsung devices zoals een telefoon en laptop van de zaak;

Wat je gaat doen als Field Accountmanager:
Als Field Accountmanager bij CPM Benelux bezoek je dagelijks winkels van diverse retailers in de regio Zuid-Holland en Zeeland om hen te adviseren en enthousiasmeren over de Telecom producten van Samsung. Je kunt hierbij denken aan elektronica zaken, zoals MediaMarkt, Coolblue en KPN.

Met jouw kritische blik zorg je ervoor dat alles in de winkel op de juiste manier gepresenteerd staat. Daarnaast zorg je voor een goede relatie met het winkelpersoneel. Je traint hen regelmatig zodat zij altijd op de hoogte zijn van nieuwste productinnovaties en ontwikkelingen in de markt.

Om de producten extra onder de aandacht te brengen en de consumenten te informeren maak je gebruik van uniek point of sale materiaal (posm) Alles met het doel, de consument de perfecte Samsung experience te bieden.

Het team:
Hoewel je veel zelfstandig onderweg bent, ben je niet alleen! Je hebt meerdere collega’s die elke dag het hele land afrijden om ervoor te zorgen dat het merk optimaal wordt vertegenwoordigd. Jullie spreken elkaar regelmatig aan de telefoon en ontmoeten elkaar tijdens meetings en trainingen.

Wie zoeken wij:

Om succesvol te zijn in deze rol is communicatie belangrijk. Daarom ben jij in staat om jezelf verbaal en non verbaal goed te presenteren. Verder;

  • Ben je ambitieus, leergierig en heb je Retail e/o Marketing ervaring.
  • Heb je een klantgerichte instelling en ervaring opgedaan met commerciële doelstellingen. Bijvoorbeeld als Verkoper of Promotor.
  • Ben je in het bezit van een HBO diploma of bijna klaar met jouw studie.
  • In het bezit van rijbewijs B.
  • Woonachtig in de regio: Ideale woonplaatsen zijn Den Haag, Rotterdam, Dordrecht en Breda.

Sollicitatieprocedure:

  1. Telefonische kennismaking.
  2. Een eerste gesprek bij CPM op kantoor in Amstelveen of via Microsoft Teams.
  3. Het tweede gesprek waarin we je graag voorstellen aan Samsung.
  4. Wij doen jou een passend aanbod.

Direct solliciteren

Enthousiast geworden? Solliciteer dan direct via de sollicitatiebutton. Heb je nog vragen over de functie of het proces? Neem gerust contact op met Tibor:

Tibor Zandvliet
Account Manager CPM Benelux

06-189 997 31

title: Manufacturing Analyst
description:
Career Area:

Manufacturing

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition

Supports manufacturing processes by performing many technical tasks while ensuring compliance with the prevailing safety and quality procedures and policies.

Responsibilities

• Executing manufacturing tasks and processes according to defined SOPs and accurately documenting data and related batch records.

• Identifying issues related to manufacturing processes and implementing process improvements.

• Providing support to manufacturing processes with activities such as validation of processes and equipment, implementing manufacturing best practices, and reporting.

• Training new and junior employees on SOP's, safety procedures, policies and standards.

Degree Requirement: Preferred to have a Bachelor’s in Engineering from Tier 1 college or University.

Skill Descriptors

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Level Basic Understanding:

• Explains the value of a disciplined approach to problem solving.

• Describes problem reporting and escalation practices.

• Utilizes accepted procedures for problem analysis and resolution.

• Identifies key aspects of problem-solving techniques used in own area.

Manufacturing Processes: Knowledge of existing product manufacturing methods, technologies and processes; ability to execute, plan, manage and monitor the entire manufacturing process.

Level Basic Understanding:

• Describes functional areas in a manufacturing facility.

• Describes the roles and responsibilities of manufacturing areas and staff.

• Identifies major phases and activities associated with a manufacturing cycle.

• Obtains and interprets high-level manufacturing flow and documentation.

Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools, and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application, or operation.

Level Basic Understanding:

• Describes problem identification, reporting and escalation procedures.

• Explains the underlying concept of using a systematic approach to solve technical problems.

• Identifies available resources and support systems for troubleshooting.

• Describes common hardware, software, and communication problems; finds ways to resolve issues.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.

Level Basic Understanding:

• Explains characteristics and steps in an effective decision-making process.

• Identifies issues and communicates with others when a decision needs to be made.

• Names decision makers in own environment and cites examples of past decisions.

• Describes types of decisions incumbent may and may not make in own job or function.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Level Basic Understanding:

• Describes non-verbal behaviors that influence the interpretation of the message.

• Cites examples of effective and ineffective communications.

• Explains the importance of effective business communication.

• Speaks/writes using correct language, mechanics, and gestures.

Maintaining Focus: Understanding of the importance of keeping sight of current responsibilities and ability to bring thoughts and tasks to completion.

Level Basic Understanding:

• Demonstrates a basic understanding of the relationship between maintaining focus and productivity.

• Explains the concept of maintaining focus.

• Describes various techniques, such as breaking effort into bite-sized chunks, for maintaining focus.

• Provides examples of how the ability of individuals to improve their focus has been beneficial.

Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision.

Level Basic Understanding:

• Explains the importance of accuracy in own function or unit.

• Identifies tasks or outputs that require accuracy and detail-level attention.

• Identifies the procedures for making sure that results are mistake-free.

• Describes consequences of errors within own unit or function.

It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as an exhaustive summary of all responsibilities, duties and effort required of employees assigned to this job. title: Gas Systems Engineer (Entry, Staff, Senior or Principal)
description:
Xcel Energy (NASDAQ: XEL) is a leading energy provider and Fortune 500 company, dedicated to serving millions of electricity and natural gas customers across eight states: Minnesota, Colorado, Wisconsin, Michigan, North Dakota, South Dakota, New Mexico and Texas. We make energy work better for our customers, helping them thrive every day. That means always raising the bar - delivering better service and providing more reliable, resilient, and sustainable energy.

Xcel Energy is a place where you’ll have opportunities to grow, expand your skills, and help lead the clean energy transition. We offer meaningful rewards, recognition, and support to help you build your career and make an impact - both on the job and beyond. Most importantly, it means you’ll be joining a company that knows employees are the driving force behind its success and is committed to helping you be your best.

Xcel Energy supports a hybrid work model to enable collaboration and flexibility. Many roles are expected to work onsite three days per week (Tuesday–Thursday); however, work location expectations vary based on role, team, and business needs.

The job summary below and responsibilities reflect the senior engineer level role. The successfully chosen candidate will be placed at a level that is commensurate with their skills and experience as different skills and/or experience will be required at the entry, staff, and principal engineer levels.


Position Summary


Applies extensive technical expertise and has full knowledge of other related disciplines. Performs as a staff advisor and consultant in a technical specialty, a type of facility or equipment, or a program function. Carries out complex or innovative assignments requiring the development of new or improved techniques and procedures. Work is expected to result in the development of new/improved techniques and procedures or new/refined equipment, materials, processes, products, and/or scientific methods. Represents the organization as the prime technical contact on contracts and projects and interacts with senior external personnel on significant technical matters often requiring coordination between organizations. Work is performed without appreciable direction and considerable latitude is exercised in determining technical objectives of assignment. Guidance relates largely to overall objectives, critical issues, new concepts and policy matters. Completed work is reviewed from a relatively long- term perspective, for desired results. May assign tasks to and direct engineers, technicians, craft personnel and administrative staff, including coordination and review of work assignments. Responsible for (and may lead) multiple projects of moderate to large size or portions of major projects.


Essential Responsibilities


  • Applies extensive technical expertise and has an understanding of the basic principles of other related disciplines. Fully demonstrates the unique technical skills and core competencies for this engineering level by applying technical standards, principles, theories, concepts, and techniques to lead projects of moderate to large size, scope and complexity.
  • Largely self-directed work is expected to result in the development of new or improved techniques, procedures and standards. Supports the development of technical documentation (including but not limited to designs, testing, calculations, reports, standards, etc.)
  • Without appreciable direction exercises considerable latitude in determining ongoing technical support for project activities within areas such as Operations, Maintenance, Testing/diagnostics and Regulatory. Provides field engineering oversight and direction for activities such as support, testing, installation, inspections, commissioning etc.
  • Coordinates/leads multiple projects or portions of projects (including phases such as research, design, equipment selection, procurement, installation and commissioning). May lead more critical projects with oversight of a higher-level engineer or supervisor.
  • Represents the organization as the prime technical contact in the bid/evaluation processes including preparation of bid documents, completion of technical evaluations for proposals and providing recommendations for selection. Interacts with senior external personnel on significant technical matters often requiring coordination with internal and external organizations.
  • Effectively and with precision resolves difficult technical/business matters both inter-organizationally and with outside customer/vendors with all formats of communication.
  • May assign tasks to and/or direct engineers, technicians, craft personnel and other support staff including coordination and review of work assignments. Provides guidance and mentoring to less experienced engineers. Responsible for continuous self-development of technical skills and competencies.
  • Leads activities such as budgeting, estimating, forecasting, accounting, work order management, in support of engineering projects.

Entry Engineer Level (Salary Range: $70,000-$88,667)

Minimum Requirements

  • Required bachelor's degree in engineering from ABET accredited curriculum.
  • 0+ years relevant engineering experience Ability to demonstrate the unique technical skills and core competencies for this engineering level established & documented by the organization.
  • Preferred EIT/FE (Engineer in Training/Fundamentals of Engineering) preferred.

Staff Engineer Level (Salary Range: $81,000 -106,267)

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering from ABET accredited
  • 2+year's relevant engineering experience. Demonstrated broad knowledge & proficiency in specialty area, knowledge of related specialties, & general knowledge of other related disciplines.
  • Ability to demonstrate the unique technical skills & core competencies for this engineering level established & documented by the organization.
  • EIT/FE (Engineer in Training/Fundamentals of Engineering) strongly preferred.

Senior Engineer Level (Salary Range: $97,000-$129,267)

Minimum Requirements

  • Required bachelor’s degree in engineering from ABET accredited curriculum
  • 5+ years relevant engineering experience with EIT/FE (Engineer in Training/Fundamentals of Engineering) required; 7+ years relevant engineering experience without EIT/FE.
  • Ability to demonstrate the unique technical skills and core competencies for this engineering level established & documented by the organization.
  • Preferred PE (Professional Engineer) registration may be required depending on business need.

Principal Engineer (Salary Range: $112,000-$156,600)

Minimum Requirements

  • Required bachelor’s degree in engineering from ABET accredited curriculum
  • 9+ years relevant engineering experience with PE (Professional Engineer) registration required; 15+ years relevant engineering experience without PE.
  • Ability to demonstrate the unique technical skills and core competencies for this engineering level established & documented by the organization.

Preferred

  • Mechanical, Civil or Chemical Engineering degree is preferred
  • Natural gas experience

title: Business Security Partner (L5)
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

The Team

Netflix’s Business Security Partner (BSP) team is a team of senior security advisors organized around business proximity rather than technical domains. Each BSP partner owns relationships with a defined portfolio of business units, builds long-term relationships with BU leadership, and serves as the security export who understands those businesses well enough to advise on decisions before they are made. We sit in business reviews, participate in architecture conversations, and build the kind of trust with stakeholders that makes security a resource rather than a requirement.


Across all of our relationships, the goal is the same: every major business decision at Netflix should have access to clear, usable security risk context; not a compliance output buried in a document, but actionable guidance from a partner who understands both the risk and the business.


About the Role

This role covers two distinct, fast-moving areas within Netflix: Marketing and Animation. BSP aligns coverage based on need and often rotates business units. You may cover other areas during your time at Netflix. BSP right-sizes risk while enabling business outcomes.


On the Marketing side, you will be the primary security partner for teams spanning Consumer Products, Brand, Events, Experiences, and Social Media, as well as the external agency and vendor ecosystems that touch pre-release campaign content. You will advise on the security risk of GenAI tools Marketing teams are actively building and adopting, assess vendors and Business Process Outsourcing partners handling sensitive creative assets, and govern the access controls that protect Netflix’s social media accounts.


For Animation, you will partner with Netflix Animation as its dedicated security partner. Your work will span security risk assessment of the animation production pipeline, advancing the alignment of legacy systems with Netflix standards, and advising on architectural decisions that affect how pre-release animated content is protected. The pace of change is high, both in the business and in the legacy integration work. Your ability to engage credibly with engineering and leadership on complex, technically interdependent risk is essential.


This role also carries M&A responsibilities. BSPs at Netflix are expected to support technical security due diligence for acquisitions and subsidiaries.


What You Will Work On:

  • Own the security partnership for Marketing and Animation, building stakeholder relationships, learning how these businesses operate, and translating that context into opinionated security guidance.
  • Lead security risk assessments and treatment strategies with cross-functional teams as they launch new capabilities and tools.
  • Evaluate and advise on the security risk of GenAI tool adoption across both business units. Set conditions of approval, assess training data provenance and data handling, and partner with Legal and Privacy on unified guidance.
  • Maintain and evolve the Business Risk Profile for each business unit, prioritizing and driving remediation of the risks that matter most.
  • Advance pre-release content protection in partnership across both business units: campaign assets and creative content in Marketing, and animation production pipelines and studio workstation environments. Coordinate with Content Security and partner SPA teams to ensure controls match the sensitivity of what’s in scope.
  • Support M&A technical security due diligence for acquisitions and subsidiaries.
  • Develop reporting and metrics that communicate risk posture and business security initiatives to SPA leadership and business unit stakeholders.

Desired Background:

  • Experience operating as a security partner or advisor. You’ve built trust with business stakeholders, translated technical risk into business language, and driven decisions without direct authority.
  • GenAI security depth. You have direct experience advising on or assessing security risks in GenAI systems. You can identify real risks and engage credibly with technical teams, legal, and privacy partners to mitigate them.
  • Broad security domain knowledge across application security, cloud security, identity and access management, and data governance. You are comfortable operating across all of them and know when to go deep versus when to synthesize, practicing business awareness on how to communicate. You pull in domain experts from across the wider security organization, where needed, to help assess and address risks.
  • Strong stakeholder partnership instincts. You build trust with the business by demonstrating that you understand their context, not just their security posture. You know how to translate a technical finding into a business decision, and back to the Security department for support.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and novel technology environments. You have a framework for reasoning under uncertainty and for making recommendations when the answer isn't fully known.
  • M&A or technical due diligence experience is a plus and not required.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $400,000.00 - $680,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.

Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.

Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled.

title: Direct Materials Sourcing Intern - The Toro Company
description:
The 2027 Summer Internship Program will run from May 17, 2027, through August 6, 2027. Candidates must be available to start on May 17 and participate through the duration of the program.


Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a school/employment or any other visa, regardless of expiration date, now or in the future.

Who Are We?

The Toro Company (TTC) has delivered market-leading, innovative products and outstanding customer care for more than 100 years. With over 11,000 employees worldwide, TTC is headquartered in Bloomington, Minnesota, USA.


Our company designs and manufactures turf maintenance equipment; turf irrigation systems; landscape and lighting products; snow and ice management solutions; agricultural irrigation systems; rental, specialty and underground construction equipment; and residential turf and snow equipment. We market and sell TTC products worldwide through a network of distributors, dealers, mass retailers, hardware retailers, equipment rental center and home centers—as well as online direct to end users.


What Will You Do?

Make an impact this summer! This position will be involved in the development and leadership of several projects that will contribute positively to Toro’s overall business. Potential projects include:

  • Define, develop, and implementing future cost saving opportunities

Our team is responsible for building the end-to-end member experience for Live and delivering innovative Sports features to market. In the past two years, Netflix has been home to record-breaking NFL Games, Boxing Events, and the World Baseball Classic Tournament. As the ambitions for Live and Sports are growing bigger and bolder in the years to come, a truly innovative product experience plays a critical role in bringing the magic to our members.

As Product Manager for the Sports Experience, you will own the end-to-end execution of new features for our Sports content slate. You will work in close partnership with the Product Lead for Live and Sports to align on the overall roadmap and priorities. You will directly own portfolio features across the roadmap spanning the Discovery and Playback experience. As we look to onboard new content experiences, you will be at the forefront of scaling our Sports features to those partners. You’ll interface closely with a broad cross-functional team including Design, Engineering, Data Science, Marketing, Content and Product.


You must be comfortable at the hub of a fast-paced environment where you interface daily with cross-functional experts across both the tech and entertainment sides of the business, with proven success in balancing requirements/tradeoffs effectively. You must be passionate about building alignment, while not being afraid to push ahead when there remain some critics, influencing and keeping momentum in the face of ambiguity.

  • Proactively identify new investments by leveraging consumer insights, market trends, and platform data to uncover new product opportunities for Sports, actively shaping the broader strategic roadmap for our rapidly expanding live ecosystem.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Job Summary

Forward Deployed Engineers take a defined use case from nothing to a working, production-grade system inside the customer's environment. That starts with knowing our platform deeply enough to combine its capabilities into solutions more complex than any single feature was designed for - and where a customer's specific needs call for something beyond the standard functionality, building that missing piece themselves. This is the role that builds the use case: not a prototype handed to someone else to production, but the system that goes live.

This is a customer-facing role. Understanding the customer's needs and the realistic possibilities of their technical environment - and working in close, daily collaboration with them - is what makes a deployment succeed. We're in daily working contact with the customer's engineers and executives, mostly online, with our team and theirs operating as one delivery unit with shared planning. Success is measured on the customer's numbers - resolution rate, containment, response latency, CSAT, cost per contact - and accountability continues past go-live.

Forward Deployed Engineering brings together two disciplines that used to sit apart: conversation design and integration engineering. An engineer who can build the technical logic behind a scenario; a conversation designer who can design the flow of the conversation itself - that is what an FDE is. We hire people who are genuinely strong in one of the two and want to grow the other - expert in both is a direction of travel, not an entry bar. The role is based in Prague and is part of a global function with teams in EMEA and North America.

Please note this is a hybrid role with significant customer on-site availability required.

Responsibilities

  • Own the solution design: translate a stated business problem into a technical architecture that fits the customer’s actual processes, constraints and systems.
  • Build the agent 0→1: design, build and iterate the first working version end to end - the system that goes into production, not a hand-off.
  • Close product gaps: build the custom extensions, integrations, services and tooling the deployment requires, without waiting for core roadmap prioritization.
  • Own the integration surface: systems of record, contact channels and data flows - and, for voice deployments, the telephony path from carrier to agent.
  • Evaluate, iterate, improve: define the workflow-specific tests that determine whether this deployment actually works, and iterate against real traffic until the numbers move.
  • Work as the customer’s technical counterpart: deploy alongside their engineers, monitor against the agreed KPIs, tune, and stay accountable past go-live.
  • Feed the platform: capture what you built as a reusable pattern and push recurring patterns toward the core product - the field is our sensing arm.

Requirements

  • 2+ years building and shipping software in a customer-facing role - solutions or forward-deployed engineering, professional services delivery, integration engineering, or product engineering with direct customer exposure.
  • Genuine depth in at least one of our two disciplines, and the appetite to grow the other: conversation and agent design (dialogue logic, prompting, flows, evaluation) or integration engineering (APIs, services, systems of record, data flows).
  • Strong hands-on coding in JavaScript/TypeScript, Python and/or C#/.NET - comfortable writing and maintaining production services, not only scripts.
  • Solid working experience of SQL, Linux and Docker - just as important as the languages above.
  • Solid grasp of software architecture and API integration: authentication, webhooks, queues, error handling and failure modes.
  • Experience distributing data across critically loaded infrastructure, and the ability to account for race conditions, deadlocks and thread safety when designing systems.
  • Ability to work directly with customer engineers and executives - distil a complex system into a clear explanation, present a design, and defend a trade-off.
  • A track record of owning a complex project end to end, against real deliverables and real dates.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and with non-deterministic systems: forming a hypothesis, building the evaluation that tests it, and iterating to a number.
  • Willingness to travel.
  • Professional English, used daily with colleagues in EMEA and North America; Czech strongly preferred for work with regional customers.

Preferred Experience

  • Conversational AI or voice agents in production - flow and prompt design, retrieval, tool calling, and evaluation harnesses against real traffic.
  • Contact centre and CCaaS platforms (Genesys, Avaya, NICE, Five9, Amazon Connect) plus telephony fundamentals - SIP, DTMF, transfer, failover.
  • Integration with enterprise systems of record: CRM, ERP, data warehouses, custom internal APIs.
  • Cloud and container deployment (Azure, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2 and data residency handled as architectural constraints, not paperwork.
  • Using AI tooling as a core part of how you build, not a side tab you open occasionally.
  • Additional Central European languages, particularly Slovak, Polish or German.

Benefits

About CallMiner

Does the possibility of using artificial intelligence to improve human connection excite you? We agree!

CallMiner is the global leader in AI-powered conversation intelligence and customer experience (CX) automation. Our industry-recognized platform captures and analyzes 100% of omnichannel customer interactions delivering the insights organizations need to improve CX, enhance agent performance, and drive automation at scale. By combining advanced AI, industry-leading analytics, and real-time conversation intelligence, we empower organizations to uncover customer needs, optimize processes, and automate workflows and interactions. The result: higher customer satisfaction, reduced operational costs, and faster, data-driven decisions. Trusted by leading brands in technology, media & telecom, retail, manufacturing, financial services, healthcare, and travel & hospitality, we help organizations transform customer insights into action.

CallMiner's core set of values – from maniacal customer focus and radical candor to team mentality and transparency – serve as a touchstone for what we strive to create in a workplace culture and weave through everything we do as a company. We believe that by building a team of brilliant, inspired people, we can truly accomplish amazing things together. We are committed to providing an inclusive and equitable workplace where everyone feels accepted, valued, and understood.

Our strong commitment to a positive environment continually earns us recognition as a top workplace, including Boston Globe Top Place to Work.

The highest level of professional demeanor and conduct, both in direct patient care and in communication with family members, other health care professionals, and support staff, is expected at all times.

Responsibilities:
Residents are directly responsible to the faculty attending to whom they have been assigned for all matters related to the professional care of patients. Under the supervision of attending physicians, general responsibilities of the Resident may include:
• Initial and ongoing assessment of patient’s medical, physical, and psycho social status
• Performing history and physical
• Developing assessment and treatment plan
• Performing rounds
• Recording progress notes
• Ordering tests, examinations, medications, and therapies
• Interpreting results of tests
• Arranging for discharge and after care
• Writing or dictating admission notes, progress notes, procedure notes, and discharge summaries
• Providing patient education and counseling health status, test results, disease processes, and discharge planning
• Performing procedures
• Assisting in surgery
• Attendance at didactic sessions
• Residents must recognize that under certain circumstances, the best interests of the patient may be served by transitioning that patient’s care to another qualified and rested provider.
• Residents must be competent in communicating with team members in the hand-over process.
• Satisfy all requirements by accrediting body as applicable.

Desired Attributes:

• Positive attitude and team approach to safety and patient care.
• Committed to culture of scholarly inquiry

Completion of Medical/Professional School

• BLS/ACLS/ATLS/PALS as required by specialty
For Podiatry:
o Certification in Administration of Topical Diagnostic Pharmaceuticals (DPAS) as required by their specialty.

EDUCATION:

LICENSES / CERTIFICATIONS:

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Moderate - Clinical - Moderate clinical roles are patient facing roles that require continual movement, including standing, walking, and lifting 20–50 lbs., along with pushing and pulling medical equipment and assisting with patient positioning. Employees perform frequent bending, twisting, and reaching while completing fine motor tasks in busy or confined clinical environments. High sensory acuity is essential for monitoring patient status and responding to alarms or safety concerns. Emotional and cognitive demands are substantial, involving decision-making under pressure, responding to emergencies, and maintaining sustained focus. Environmental exposures include infectious agents, bodily fluids, chemicals, and radiation. TB testing, mask-fit testing, and physical exams are common requirements.

Job Description:

Orders inoculations and vaccinations for patients to immunize from communicable diseases. Refers patients to medical specialist or other practitioner for specialized treatment.

title: Associate Director
description:
Forvis Mazars is a leading global professional services network providing audit & assurance, tax, and advisory services. Forvis Mazars in the UK spans 14 offices across the nation and has over 3,400 professionals, with 190 partners. We have a clear purpose and a shared commitment to shape a better future.

About the Team

Our Accounting Advisory Services team provides technical accounting support and practical financial reporting solutions to a broad range of clients across multiple industries. We help organisations navigate complex accounting challenges, implement new accounting standards and achieve high-quality financial reporting outcomes under IFRS and UK GAAP.

As an Associate Director, you'll play a key leadership role in delivering complex advisory engagements while contributing to the continued growth and development of the team. #LI-JH2


About the Role

As an Associate Director within Accounting Advisory Services, you'll lead the delivery of a diverse portfolio of technical accounting projects, supporting clients through complex transactions, changes in accounting standards and financial reporting challenges.

You'll work closely with Partners, Directors and clients, providing technical expertise, managing teams and helping develop new business opportunities. This role offers significant exposure to varied accounting issues and the opportunity to establish yourself as a trusted advisor to a broad client base.

We're seeking an experienced accounting professional who combines exceptional technical expertise with strong client relationship and leadership skills. You'll be passionate about solving complex accounting challenges, developing people and supporting the growth of a successful advisory practice.


  • Lead the delivery of complex accounting advisory engagements from proposal stage through to completion, ensuring excellent client outcomes and commercial success.
  • Provide technical accounting advice on a wide range of client matters, including complex transactions, financial reporting issues and accounting framework implementation.
  • Prepare and review high-quality technical accounting papers, reports and formal accounting opinions.
  • Build trusted relationships with clients, understanding their needs and delivering practical, tailored solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to expand client relationships and contribute to business development activities across the Accounting Advisory Services team.
  • Support clients through the implementation of new accounting standards and changes in financial reporting requirements.
  • Manage, coach and develop team members, fostering a collaborative and high-performing culture.
  • Work closely with colleagues across Audit, Tax and Advisory to deliver integrated solutions for clients.
  • Contribute to the team's profile through networking, technical publications and thought leadership activities.
  • Demonstrate strong project management skills, balancing multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional quality and attention to detail.

What We're Looking For

  • ACA, ACCA or equivalent professional qualification.
  • Strong technical expertise in IFRS, UK GAAP (FRS 102) and UK Company Law.
  • Experience gained within a professional services environment in a technical accounting, financial reporting or accounting advisory role.
  • A proven ability to analyse complex accounting matters and deliver practical, client-focused advice.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including drafting formal technical accounting conclusions and recommendations.
  • Strong research and analytical capabilities.
  • Experience producing technical publications, guidance or thought leadership content.
  • Experience building and managing client relationships, with a track record of delivering high-quality service and winning repeat work.
  • Strong commercial awareness, including managing engagement budgets and supporting fee negotiations.
  • A collaborative leadership style and a genuine commitment to developing and mentoring others.
  • The ability to think innovatively and deliver solutions tailored to individual client needs.

At Forvis Mazars diversity, equity and inclusion are central to our values. We value our people's unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experience, and know this diversity create better outcomes for our clients. We seek to attract, develop, and retain the best talent, inclusive of sex, ethnicity, disability, socio-economic background, sexual orientation, gender identity, nationality, and faith. We select candidates based on skills, knowledge, qualifications, and experience and aim to support all our team members to reach their potential. At Forvis Mazars, we promote an environment in which you can grow your skills, belong to a team that values your ideas, and make an impact that matters.

title: Product - Intern, Product Integration
description:
THE BUSINESS

We are Everyday Luxury™.

It's what we do and how we do it — together.

It's working alongside world-class talent in pursuit of world-class results.

It's maximizing your potential in a high-performance culture.

It's knowing that wherever you are, you belong.

It's elevating your world — and the world of those who love and will love Aritzia.

It's You. And an endless runway of opportunity.

With a Global Support Campus in Vancouver and additional Support Office hubs in major cities across North America — including Toronto, New York, Los Angeles and Seattle — our workplace network is strategically designed to support our People and serve our Clients a frictionless experience. So, you can do what you do best — with us.

THE TEAM

The mission of the Product Integration Department is to effectively drive the development of our exclusive brand portfolio to deliver beautiful, high-quality products to our clients.

THE OPPORTUNITY

This is a unique opportunity to be part of the team responsible for partnering with Product teams to ensure our vertically integrated brand collections are being designed, manufactured, and delivered on time and to the highest quality. As an Intern in Product Integration, you will have a front-row seat to witness how fashion lines are brought to life as you ensure all cross-functional activities in the product lifecycle are completed on time to enable success of the product line. As one of our business operations functions, this is a special opportunity to develop subject matter expertise in a coveted business area as you grow your operational skill set. Our goal is that you will come out of your internship inspired, with meaningful experience and an enhanced skill set you can carry forward into your bright future.

THE ROLE

As an Intern in Product Integration, you will support to:

  • Drive and organize critical product lifecycle activities for various brands (e.g. Babaton, Wilfred, TNA, etc.) and product lines (e.g. Sweat fleece, Contour, etc.) across planning, design, and manufacturing teams
  • Schedule and facilitate seasonal product and brand meetings, supporting cross-functional department teams to ensure clear meeting objectives, deliverables, timelines, and outcomes
  • Identify potential risks to seasonal brand development and work with teams to mitigate and resolve issues
  • Leverage data and reporting to analyze brand performance against key product development deadlines

THE QUALIFICATIONS

The Intern, Product Integration has/is:

  • Currently enrolled in a post-secondary institution, with a preferred graduation date of April 2027 to April 2028
    • Preferably pursuing a degree in Business or a related field
  • A commitment to learn and apply Aritzia's Values and Business and People Leadership principles
  • The ability to collaborate fluently with cross-functional partners
  • A commitment to quality and investing in results that add value to the business
  • Passion for Aritzia and the fashion industry, with a special interest in all things to do with our product
  • A logical, organized approach with an appreciation for structure and details
  • A problem solver who thinks critically to develop insightful solutions
  • Work experience in Aritzia Boutiques, Concierge, or Distribution Centres is highly valued

THE DEPARTMENT

Product Integration offers you a behind-the-scenes view into the world of Product at Aritzia from an operational lens, providing you with a deeper understanding of the Product Lifecycle and day-to-day business operations that support bringing our product to market.

Ensure the seamless running of day-to-day business operations in Product

  • Participate in weekly status meetings (i.e., brand meetings), ensuring the successful execution of the Product Lifecycle
  • Identify opportunities for operational efficiency, and build tools and processes to support
  • Support teams by efficiently removing roadblocks in development

Learn how the product lifecycle connects end-to-end, from creative concept all the way to product launch

Build your business acumen and operational toolkit

  • Support in project managing strategic Product initiatives and learn how to bring ideas from concept to reality

THE PERKS

title: Nuclear Med Tech - Per Diem
description:
About Our Company

We’re a physician-led, patient-centric network committed to simplifying health care and bringing a more connected kind of care.

Our primary, multispecialty, and urgent care providers serve millions of patients in traditional practices, patients' homes and virtually through VillageMD and our operating companies Village Medical, Village Medical at Home, Summit Health, CityMD, and Starling Physicians.

When you join our team, you become part of a compassionate community of people who work hard every day to make health care better for all. We are innovating value-based care and leveraging integrated applications, population insights and staffing expertise to ensure all patients have access to high-quality, connected care services that provide better outcomes at a reduced total cost of care.

Please Note: We will only contact candidates regarding your applications from one of the following domains: @summithealth.com, @citymd.net, @villagemd.com, @villagemedical.com, @westmedgroup.com, @starlingphysicians.com, or @bmctotalcare.com.

Job Description

This role is per diem, our per diem rate is $67.18 hourly

Essential Job functions:

  • Prepares and injects radiopharmaceuticals for diagnostic imaging procedures according to Nuclear Regulatory Commission regulations and department policies.

  • Measures concentrations of radioactive isotope in specific body areas to obtain information for use by the Radiologists in diagnosing patients’ illness.

  • Performs cardiac nuclear studies including stress MUGA, Thallium and non-gated Technetium studies. Assists physician with procedures as required.

  • Gives reports to physician for review/interpretation within the time frame specified by the department.

  • Programs computer for each procedure.

  • Documents reason for test and any known allergies.

  • Employs proper aseptic techniques in IV insertion and administration.

  • Manages nuclear schedule for best utilization of time, patient flow and patient needs. Performs daily/weekly quality assurance procedures, calibration and flood analysis on the equipment according to manufacturer’s guidelines.

  • Troubleshoots minor problems, reports other problems and those requiring repair service to Supervisor of Cardiology Techs, Clinical Manager and Physician.

  • Performs cardiac nuclear studies including stress MUGA, Thallium and non-gated Technetium studies. Assists physician with procedures as required.

  • Acquires clear images appropriate for the studies. Accurately gates the study when required.

  • Performs departmental surveys to ensure compliance with radiation standards for SMG, NRC, and EPA.

  • Follows proper procedures for spill and decontamination; reports contamination to appropriate authorities and regulatory commissions.

  • Orders and logs appropriate information regarding receipt of radioactive materials and pharmaceuticals and dispose of radioisotopes according to industry standards and regulations.

  • Updates nuclear Policies and Procedures to reflect current techniques and best practices. Adheres to the nuclear/ProSolv workflow including preparing the preliminary report for the Cardiologist.

  • Archives images according to SMG procedure.

General Job functions:

  • Perform QA on a daily basis, as required.

  • Demonstrates understanding of emergency procedures.

  • Demonstrates knowledge of safety-related work behaviors to ensure safe job performance and maintenance of safe work environment.

  • Other duties as required.

Education, Certification, Computer and Training Requirements:

  • High School Diploma/GED required. Associates or Bachelor’s degree preferred.

  • BLS certification required.

  • 0 – 1 years’ experience. 2-4 years’ experience preferred.

  • IV Certification required. ARRT and CNMT required.

  • Ability to perform nuclear medicine procedures.

  • Ability to prepare and inject radioactive isotopes.

  • Ability to communicate in English, both orally and in writing required.

  • Strong interpersonal and organizational skills required. Ability to perform diverse work assignments with time limitations with a high degree of accuracy required.

  • Ability to use problem solving, critical thinking and priority setting skills required. Experience with Imaging Equipment, Dose Calibrator, Geiger counter – cutie pie CGM meter preferred.

  • Experience with Well & Probe Uptake System and Lead Syringe Shields & Lab Coats preferred.

  • Experience with Standard Office Equipment (Phone, Fax, Copy Machine, Scanner, Email/Voice Mail) preferred.

  • Experience with Standard Office Technology in a Window based environment preferred.

Travel:

Ability to commute to satellite offices as needed.


Pay Range: $46.73 - $58.41 Hourly



The provided compensation range is based on industry standards and salary determinations will be made based on numerous factors including but not limited to years of experience and location of position.

title: Associate Director, Competitive Intelligence
description:
Who We Are:

Neurocrine Biosciences is a leading biopharmaceutical company with a simple purpose: to relieve suffering for people with great needs. We are dedicated to discovering, developing and commercializing life-changing treatments for patients with under-addressed neurological, psychiatric, endocrine and immunological disorders. The company's diverse portfolio includes FDA-approved treatments for tardive dyskinesia, chorea associated with Huntington's disease, classic congenital adrenal hyperplasia, hyperphagia in Prader-Willi syndrome, endometriosis* and uterine fibroids*, as well as a robust pipeline including multiple compounds in mid- to late-phase clinical development across our core therapeutic areas. For more than three decades, we have applied our unique insight into neuroscience and the interconnections between brain and body systems to treat complex conditions. We relentlessly pursue medicines to ease the burden of debilitating diseases and disorders, because you deserve brave science. For more information, visit neurocrine.com, and follow the company on LinkedIn, X, Facebook and YouTube. (*in collaboration with AbbVie)



At Neurocrine, strong leadership drives both business results and team success. We look for leaders who think strategically, anticipate what’s ahead and set clear direction, while building and empowering high-performing teams. Successful leaders foster an environment where people are motivated to do their best work and deliver meaningful, measurable impact through sound decision-making and accountability.



About the Role:

The Associate Director, Competitive Intelligence will play an important role in advancing Neurocrine's competitive intelligence capability across the commercial portfolio, clinical pipeline, research programs and external innovation activities.

This individual will provide strategic competitive intelligence and counsel to senior leaders and cross-functional teams, translating complex and rapidly evolving scientific, clinical, regulatory, commercial and competitive information into clear insights and recommendations that inform portfolio decisions, business development, R&D strategy and commercial execution.

The successful candidate will help advance a forward-looking CI capability that goes beyond traditional monitoring and reporting. They will identify emerging competitive threats and opportunities, develop perspectives on where markets and therapeutic areas are heading, anticipate competitor actions and support earlier, better-informed decisions.

This individual will also be expected to effectively use and champion modern AI tools to enhance how Neurocrine collects, analyzes, synthesizes and disseminates competitive intelligence. They should be comfortable developing strategic competitive insights and using AI-enabled tools to interrogate large volumes of scientific, clinical, regulatory, financial and market information to identify relevant patterns and insights.

_

Your Contributions (include, but are not limited to):

  • Contributes to the development and leads execution of competitive intelligence initiatives across marketed products, development-stage assets, research programs and emerging areas of strategic interest
  • Develops competitive landscapes across Neurocrine's therapeutic areas, integrating scientific, clinical, regulatory, commercial, market access and financial perspectives
  • Identifies emerging competitors, mechanisms, technologies and market developments and assesses their potential implications for Neurocrine
  • Provides competitive intelligence, strategic insights and recommendations to Corporate Strategy, Business Development, R&D, Commercial, Medical Affairs and senior leadership
  • Translates complex competitive information into clear strategic implications and recommendations rather than simply reporting developments
  • Develops competitor and asset-level scenarios, including likely clinical-development strategies, regulatory paths, launch timing, positioning, commercial potential and potential competitor responses
  • Leads competitive assessments around major catalysts, including clinical readouts, regulatory decisions, medical congresses, product launches, earnings calls and business development transactions
  • Develops and maintains competitive landscapes, company profiles, pipeline databases, catalyst calendars and other decision-support tools across assigned areas of the portfolio
  • Partners with Business Development and Corporate Strategy on external innovation, transaction evaluations, market landscapes and strategic opportunity assessments
  • Partners with R&D teams to understand emerging biology, modalities and development strategies and identify competitive implications early in the research and development lifecycle
  • Partners with Commercial and Medical teams to understand evolving standards of care, physician behavior, market dynamics and competitor positioning
  • Designs and leads competitive simulations and war-gaming exercises around important clinical, regulatory and commercial events
  • Develops effective approaches for rapidly communicating material competitive developments to leadership while avoiding information overload
  • Contributes to the development of an AI-enabled competitive intelligence capability, using modern tools to increase the breadth, speed and depth of competitive analysis
  • Uses large language models and other AI-enabled research and analytical tools to synthesize scientific literature, clinical-trial information, regulatory documents, patents, company disclosures, medical-congress data, market research and other structured and unstructured information
  • Develops workflows and approaches for competitive monitoring, catalyst tracking, landscape development, signal detection and synthesis of large information sets
  • Uses AI to connect information across therapeutic areas and datasets, identify emerging patterns, generate and pressure-test hypotheses, and surface competitive developments that traditional CI approaches may miss
  • Evaluates new AI tools and data sources that may improve Neurocrine's competitive intelligence capabilities
  • Partners with Digital/IT, Legal, Compliance and other stakeholders to support appropriate and responsible use of AI and external information
  • Builds strong relationships across functions and therapeutic areas and contributes to effective information sharing across the organization
  • Influences decisions without direct authority and appropriately challenges assumptions with senior stakeholders
  • Manages external CI vendors and consultants and helps maintain internal knowledge and strategic judgment
  • Mentors colleagues and contributes to the development of CI capability and talent as the function grows
  • Contributes to the development and implementation of standards and best practices for competitive intelligence
  • Develops competitive insights and contributes to executive-level updates, portfolio reviews, governance materials and Board materials as needed
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements:

  • BS/BA degree in life sciences, business or related discipline and 10+ years of relevant pharmaceutical, biotechnology, consulting, investment research, competitive intelligence, strategy or related experience OR
  • Master's/MBA and 8+ years of relevant experience OR
  • PhD/PharmD/MD or other advanced degree and 6+ years of relevant experience
  • Significant experience in biopharmaceutical competitive intelligence, corporate strategy, business development, commercial strategy, consulting, investment research or a related strategic function
  • Deep understanding of drug discovery and development, clinical trials, regulatory pathways and commercialization
  • Demonstrated ability to understand complex scientific and clinical information and translate it into business and strategic implications
  • Ability to operate across multiple therapeutic areas, mechanisms and stages of development rather than remaining narrowly specialized in one asset or market
  • Demonstrated hands-on proficiency with modern generative AI tools and experience incorporating AI into day-to-day analytical workflows
  • Ability to use AI to conduct research, synthesize large information sets, automate repetitive workflows and improve the quality and speed of strategic analysis
  • Strong understanding of the limitations of AI and ability to independently validate sources, identify unsupported conclusions and apply appropriate human judgment
  • Ability to synthesize scientific, clinical, regulatory, commercial, market access, financial and competitive information into differentiated strategic insights and recommendations
  • Demonstrated ability to identify emerging competitive threats, opportunities and weak signals and assess their potential implications for portfolio and business strategy
  • Experience developing competitive landscapes, scenarios, strategic assessments and other decision-support analyses for senior leadership
  • Curiosity and a demonstrated tendency to ask "what does this mean?" and "what happens next?" rather than simply summarizing what has already happened
  • Experience managing external partners and vendors preferred
  • Emerging internal thought leader with strong technical and/or business expertise
  • Applies strategic judgment and in-depth expertise to complex and ambiguous business problems
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex information into clear, actionable recommendations
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex issues clearly and concisely to senior audiences
  • Demonstrated ability to influence decisions without direct authority and effectively challenge assumptions when appropriate
  • Strong relationship-building and collaboration skills across functions and levels of the organization
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional projects, initiatives and relationships
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment, manage competing priorities and focus attention on the issues with the greatest business impact
  • Strong mentoring and leadership capabilities, with the ability to support the development of colleagues and lead through influence

title: Senior BI Analyst
description:
Senior BI Analyst

Location: High Wycombe

Working Pattern: 37.5 hours per week, Monday-Friday

Turn complex data into insight that drives a more sustainable future

At Biffa, we're transforming how data is used across our business, moving beyond traditional reporting towards trusted insight, advanced analytics, automation and AI-driven decision making. As a Senior BI Analyst, you'll lead the design and delivery of high-quality reports, dashboards and analysis that help teams across operations, customer services, finance and commercial functions make better decisions.

You'll combine strong Power BI, Fabric and analytical expertise with the ability to understand business needs, turn them into clear information products and communicate complex findings to senior stakeholders. Acting as a technical lead within the BI team, you'll also mentor business colleagues, promote best practice and help ensure our reporting delivers measurable business value.

Your core responsibilities:

• Design and deliver management reports, dashboards and analysis for stakeholders across Biffa.

• Present complex analysis clearly to senior stakeholders, highlighting critical issues, trends and opportunities.

• Create and enhance Power BI products and Fabric data models that are accurate, intuitive, performant and trusted.

• Drive effective use of BI products through stakeholder engagement, training, usage monitoring and continuous improvement.

• Act as a technical specialist within the BI team, reviewing outputs and mentoring and supporting other business teams.

• Keep up to date with Microsoft data technologies, software developments and BI best practice.

Our essential requirements:

• 5+ years’ experience in a business-facing BI, reporting or analytical role.

• Advanced experience developing reports, dashboards and semantic models in Power BI.

• Proven success leading and delivering BI or management information projects.

• Strong SQL, data modelling and analytical skills, including experience working with Fabric.

• Experience eliciting business requirements and translating them into clear technical specifications and valuable information products.

• Ability to interpret complex data and present clear, compelling insights to non-technical and senior audiences.

• Strong stakeholder management, communication, planning and problem-solving skills.

• Experience coaching, mentoring or providing technical guidance to other analysts.

title: Student Assistant for the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation Project
description:
Interested in a career that matters?




Would you like to help drive one of the most significant packaging regulations in Europe while gaining hands-on experience in global program and project management?


Join the PPWR Team in Novonesis' Supply Chain organization and become part of a newly established team responsible for driving our global PPWR Program and supporting compliance with the EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation. This is a unique opportunity to join a team at the beginning of an important journey, helping Novonesis prepare for a more sustainable packaging future.


Today, we are five colleagues representing four nationalities, and we are growing as the program moves into execution. We combine a structured PMO setup and strong project management framework with an open, curious, and pragmatic way of working, creating an environment where learning and collaboration are at the heart of everything we do.


The role & your impact
As a Student Assistant in the PPWR Team, you will provide dedicated support to the PMO Manager and contribute to creating structure, transparency, and progress across a global transformation program.

You will gain valuable insight into how large-scale programs are managed while supporting projects that span multiple functions, stakeholders, and geographies across Novonesis.


In this role, you will make an impact by:


  • Collecting, consolidating, and following up on project status updates, milestones, risks, actions, and decisions across the program.
  • Supporting financial tracking and reporting by gathering inputs, validating data quality, and preparing clear overviews for decision-making.
  • Preparing steering committee presentations, agendas, meeting materials, and other decision-support documentation.
  • Supporting program communication and helping ensure information is accurate, current, and accessible to stakeholders.
  • Providing day-to-day PMO support, including meeting documentation, action follow-up, coordination of inputs, and stakeholder communication.

What you will need to be successful
We imagine that you are currently enrolled in a relevant higher-education program and are looking to gain practical experience within program management, business operations, finance, or supply chain.


To succeed in this role, you bring:


  • Enrollment in a relevant degree program such as business administration, economics, finance, supply chain management, project management, communication, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical skills and an interest in understanding how projects, finances, compliance requirements, and business priorities connect.
  • Experience working with data and the ability to organize information, identify inconsistencies, and create structured overviews.
  • Good skills in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint and professional written and spoken English.

We are looking for someone who:


  • Is structured, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Is proactive and able to work independently while knowing when to seek guidance and reliable and committed to delivering high-quality work with accuracy and attention to detail.

While not required, it would be an advantage if you have:


  • Experience with Teams, SharePoint, or similar collaboration and documentation tools.
  • An interest in project management, PMO processes, compliance, or supply chain operations.
  • Experience supporting administrative, coordination, or back-office activities.
  • An interest in working across functions and engaging with stakeholders from different parts of the organization.
  • Curiosity about sustainability, packaging regulation, and business transformation initiatives.

What we offer
You will become part of a purpose-driven company where biology powers solutions to some of the world's biggest challenges.


In this role, you can expect:


  • A unique opportunity to join a newly established global program team and contribute to an important strategic initiative.
  • Hands-on experience with PMO disciplines, program governance, project reporting, stakeholder management, and business communication.
  • Close collaboration with experienced project and program professionals.
  • Exposure to senior stakeholders and cross-functional collaboration across Novonesis.
  • A supportive, international, and collaborative team environment with strong opportunities for learning and development.

Ways of working
You will be based in Lyngby and working closely with the PPWR Team. Working arrangements can be agreed together with the hiring manager based on business needs and study commitments.


Application deadline: October 4th, 2026. We will screen in-coming applications and invite for interviews continuously during the application period, so please apply as soon as possible.

Contact information : Jens Herping Ellegaard, Head of Global PPWR Strategy & Compliance at JNHE@novonesis.com.

Our purpose guides the way

In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.

Opportunities for everyone

title: Psychiatric Technician -Nights
description:
Work schedule: Full-time Nights 3/12 (36 hours/week), 7:00 p.m.–7:00 a.m., with rotating weekends and holidays.

Primary Purpose
Provides assistance and monitoring of patient activities and procedures, under the direction of a registered nurse, ensuring a safe and secure environment for both patients and employees.


Minimum Specifications: Education

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.
  • Associate’s degree in healthcare related field preferred.
  • Bachelor's Degree healthcare related field preferred.


Experience

  • One year of experience in a healthcare setting, OR
  • One year of experience as a psychiatric technician, OR
  • One year of experience as a residential treatment/group home worker, OR
  • A nursing student who has had basic fundamentals of nursing, OR
  • Successfully completed Parkland's job specific training program


Equivalent Education and/or Experience

  • May have an equivalent combination of education and experience to substitute for both the education and the experience requirements.


Certification/Registration/Licensure

*Please Note: All certification cards must provide an expiration date. The expiration date must be more than 30 days from date of hire. Completion of course certificates will not substitute this requirement.

  • Must have a current Heartsaver CPR course completion card within 90 days of hire and/or placement in job from one of the following: American Heart Association, American Red Cross Rescuer, Military Training Network
  • Must obtain Satori Alternatives for Managing Aggression (SAMA) certification, level 1-4, within 60 days of hire. Must be in place prior to first clinical orientation shift.


Skills or Special Abilities

  • Must be able to demonstrate basic patient care skills, clerical/administrative duties, and the use of supplies and assigned equipment.
  • May be required to handle aggressive patients using Client Management methods.
  • Must be able to do some heavy lifting and moving.
  • Must be able to communicate effectively with departmental personnel, other hospital personnel, physicians, patients and families.
  • Must be able to demonstrate patient centered/patient valued behavior.

Responsibilities

  • Provides a safe environment for patients, nurses, doctors and others by collecting firearms from patients and officers, scanning patients, securing sharp items, and physically restraining uncooperative patients to minimize the risk of injury to patients, property and others. Monitors and assesses patients’ physical and emotional status, applying Client Management procedures as
    necessary (including the restraining and secluding of patients when appropriate), to provide a safe, stable environment for all patients.
  • Provides direct patient care, including recording vital signs, phlebotomy tasks, monitoring patients’
    dietary intake, monitoring and recording sleep behaviors, to ensure optimal patient healthcare management consistent with the Parkland mission of patient centered/ patient valued care.
  • Monitors ongoing patient status and responds to a patient's change in condition by notifying and assisting nurses and other health team members in handling patient care needs.
  • Collects, stores, documents, and secures patient valuables and non-valuables to facilitate the administration of patient services.
  • Interviews, counsels, and advise patients of their rights, while establishing and maintaining rapport with the patient.
  • Cleans patients, patient possessions, and patient areas to comply with established cleanliness standards.
  • Transports patients to and from test locations, and transports medicines and other items to help service patients during their stay.
  • Monitors and documents of patient behaviors and care given to patients in seclusion, restraint, or on 1:1 to reduce the risk of injury to the patient and provide a record of the patients’ behavior.
  • Serves as a patient advocate by responding to a patient's needs and special requests. Maintains open communication, and honors patient's rights and confidentiality, while providing optimum service to patients.
  • Maintains the confidentiality of patient information obtained in the performance of the job, while adhering to established policies and procedures for communicating patient information, to protect the privacy of the patient.
  • Conducts security rounds, inspects patient rooms for contraband, and performs quality management audits, as requested, to ensure the safety of patients and employees.
  • Maintains a positive working relationship with management, employees, outside agencies, and other hospitals to ensure effective communication and cooperative working relationships.
  • Works directly with Charge Nurse and RN’s carrying out special orders and providing assistance to meet the needs of patients.
  • Performs all other duties as assigned by manager or manager's designee.

Job Accountabilities

  • Identifies ways to improve work processes and improve customer satisfaction.
  • Makes recommendations to supervisor, implements, and monitors results as appropriate in support of the overall goals of the department and Parkland.
  • Stays abreast of the latest developments, advancements, and trends in the field by attending seminars/workshops, reading professional journals, actively participating in professional organizations, and/or maintaining certification or licensure. Integrates knowledge gained into current work practices.
  • Maintains knowledge of applicable rules, regulations, policies, laws and guidelines that impact the
    area. Develops effective internal controls designed to promote adherence with applicable laws,
    accreditation agency requirements, and federal, state, and private health plans. Seeks advice and
    guidance as needed to ensure proper understanding.

The Large Power Systems Division in Lafayette, IN currently has an opening for a Supplier Quality Technician.

In this role you will be responsible for providing assembly and machine shop quality support for suspected nonconforming material; accomplished through the inspection and documentation of engine components. You will compare the non-conforming part to the Caterpillar print, applicable quality standard and document any variations as it relates to the form, fit, and/or function of the part.

title: Home Medical Equipment Representative
description:
Job Description:

The Home Medical Equipment Coordinator is responsible for the intake, coordination, and timely implementation of Home Medical Equipment (HME) and supply orders. Acting as a key liaison among referral sources, providers, patients, and internal service lines, this role ensures accurate documentation, verifies medical necessity, and maintains clear communication throughout the order process. The coordinator manages patient orders from start to finish, including reviewing referrals, coordinating deliveries, and providing essential patient education. They also facilitate one-on-one equipment set-ups or fittings, ensuring patients and caregivers are properly instructed on the use, care, and safety of the equipment provided. If in a Field / Delivery role the coordinator is responsible for making timely deliveries of Home Medical Equipment (HME) products and supplies to customers.

Schedule: Monday - Friday

Hours: 8:30am - 5:00pm

*8 to 10 On call shifts per month

Essential Functions

  • Delivers exceptional customer service by promptly and courteously responding to phone calls, emails, chats, and in-person inquiries; accurately triages and routes communications to appropriate departments or staff.
  • Coordinates patient intake and order processing by gathering referral information, entering data into the Electronic Medical Record (EMR), and verifying insurance benefits or self-pay status at the time of intake.
  • Manages the delivery and fulfillment of medical equipment and supplies, selecting appropriate delivery methods to meet patient and company needs, and ensuring timely coordination with delivery staff or services.
  • Supports patient discharges and transitions of care by working closely with hospital liaisons and case managers to ensure timely and appropriate equipment setup for home use.
  • Provides one-on-one patient support, including equipment education, fittings, and verifying that equipment selections align with physician orders and patient-specific needs.
  • Processes Point of Sale (POS) transactions by entering orders, receiving payments, and coordinating delivery or patient pick-up in both clinical and retail settings.
  • Collaborates across departments to ensure seamless service delivery, maintains effective internal and external relationships, and contributes to daily workflow organization and prioritization.
  • Demonstrates strong problem-solving and compliance knowledge, addressing concerns promptly while maintaining a working understanding of Medicare, Medicaid, and third-party billing requirements, as well as privacy and confidentiality regulations.

  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with diverse individuals.
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and dependability in managing tasks and documentation.
  • Effective organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities.
  • Proficiency in using basic computer applications, including word processing, spreadsheets, databases, internet, email, and scheduling tools.

  • Read plans and specifications to be able to ensure construction is in accordance with plans and specifications.

  • May serve as Project Manager for large complex projects requiring intergroup skills and consultants.

  • Conduct pre-construction conferences.
  • Support the design phase process and risk management efforts for projects as assigned (constructability reviews, advisor, etc…)

  • Responsible for tasks related to sales and marketing including supporting business development efforts.

Qualifications

description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other.
