Cybersecurity Manager – IAM Platform Operations


This position manages the engineering, operations, reliability, automation, and service delivery of Caterpillar's Identity and Access Management (IAM) platform ecosystem. The role leads globally distributed teams and offshore delivery partners to ensure IAM platforms are secure, dependable, scalable, and operationally efficient.


What You Will Do:

  • Lead IAM platform operations and engineering teams responsible for platform availability, reliability, performance, and resiliency.
  • Manage globally distributed teams and offshore service delivery partners, driving accountability, operational excellence, and customer-focused outcomes.
  • Establish and support operational standards for monitoring, incident response, service restoration, platform health, and operational readiness.
  • Drive automation and DevOps practices that reduce manual effort, improve efficiency, and increase platform stability and scalability.
  • Enable AI-powered operational capabilities that improve monitoring, operational insights, knowledge management, anomaly detection, and automated remediation.
  • Define and measure service performance through KPIs, SLAs, SLOs, and platform health metrics.
  • Lead platform lifecycle activities including upgrades, patching, modernization, capacity planning, resiliency improvements, and technical debt reduction.
  • Partner with cybersecurity, infrastructure, cloud, and application teams to deliver secure and dependable IAM platform services.
  • Manage vendor relationships, managed service providers, operational budgets, and workforce planning activities.
  • Build and develop high-performing teams while fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement.

What You Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience managing platform operations, infrastructure, cloud, or enterprise technology teams.
  • Proven experience leading globally distributed teams, offshore delivery organizations, and managed service providers.
  • Strong understanding of service management, platform operations, monitoring, observability, and reliability engineering principles.
  • Experience working highly available business-critical platforms in large-scale enterprise environments.
  • Demonstrated success driving automation, operational transformation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

We are extremely proud of our legacy of excellence and constantly work to fulfill our mission to "protect people, enhance lives, and preserve the planet."

What do our Pest Control Technicians do?


The primary purpose of this role is to perform our industry leading pest management services for residential customers. You will be responsible for identifying and eliminating pests from residential properties by conducting thorough inspections, determining the type of pest infestation, applying appropriate treatments like pesticides and traps, and providing preventative measures to prevent future infestations, all while adhering to safety regulations and communicating with clients about pest control solutions.


Responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:

  • Conduct thorough inspections of client properties to identify signs of pest infestations, damage, and entry points
  • Apply approved pest control products, including chemicals, baits, and traps, to effectively eliminate pests while adhering to safety standards
  • Educate customers on pest prevention methods and the importance of maintaining a pest-free environment. Provide advice on how to reduce the risk of future infestations.
  • Build relationships with customers, schedule and confirm their appointments, help with sales to current customers, and expand our product to new customers
  • Ensure that all pest control equipment is properly maintained, stocked, and in good working condition
  • Adhere to all local, state, and federal regulations regarding pest control products and safety protocols
  • Drive and safely operate a company provided service vehicle (we provide routine maintenance)

Essential Job Functions:

  • Working in tight, confined spaces such as basements, attics, crawl spaces, narrow aisles, or passageways
  • Working around animals, insects and termites
  • You’ll sometimes be working around mechanical parts, vehicles, electrical current, heights and scaffolding, fumes, dust, and chemicals, and we’ll train you how to handle all of these conditions safely
  • Able to work both inside and outside in your local climate in company-provided weather gear
  • Lots of moving around — regularly sitting, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, and crawling, up and down stairs, ladders, scaffolding, ramps, and poles
  • You’ll need to wear personal protective equipment (PPE), like an OSHA-compliant respirator

What do you need?

  • Clean shaven face- for safety reasons (rebreathers have to be able to seal your face)
  • High school diploma or GED; related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Possess a valid driver’s license from state of residence.
  • Licenses/certificates as required by federal, state, and/or local regulations (covered by us)
  • Available to work Monday-Friday and weekends as needed
  • Open to learning and becoming knowledgeable in all areas of pest control
  • Solid reading, writing, and verbal communication skills
  • Basic math skills — You’ll need to be able to follow instructions for mixing on product labels
  • Customer-facing experience preferred

title: Assistant Supervisor - Winergy Assembly Group
description:
Assistant Supervisor- Winergy Assembly Group

Company Description

Flender is a leading global supplier for mechanical drive systems and has the reputation for highest performance, innovation, quality, and reliability of mechanical components for 125 years.

We're now hiring a talented Assistant Supervisor- Winergy Assembly Group for our team in Elgin, IL on a full-time basis. If you're eager for your next challenge, Flender is a great place to grow your career.

For more information on Flender, please see website:


Equal Employment Opportunity Statement
Flender is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, family responsibilities, pregnancy, genetic information, protected veteran or military status, other categories protected by federal, state, or local law, and regardless of whether the qualified applicants are individuals with disabilities.

Position Overview:

The Assistant Supervisor supports the Production Manager and provides day-to-day operational leadership for the assigned assembly area to ensure safe, efficient, on-time, and high-quality production. This role provides day-to-day direction to assembly workers, ensures safety procedures are followed, trains new employees, assigns daily work, and assists with performance reviews and disciplinary actions.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Safety and Compliance

  • Ensure all team members follow company safety rules, procedures, and PPE requirements at all times.
  • Verify employees are properly trained and authorized before performing assigned work or operating equipment.
  • Conduct daily safety checks of work areas, tools, and equipment; report hazards and help correct them.
  • Stop work and take immediate action if unsafe conditions or behaviors are observed.
  • Participate in safety meetings and support continuous improvement of safety practices.

2. Daily Leadership and Work Coordination

  • The Assistant Supervisor provides direct day-to-day operational leadership to assigned employees but does not independently hire, terminate, suspend, or issue formal disciplinary action unless specifically authorized by the Production Manager.
  • Assign daily tasks and workstations to assembly team members based on skills, experience, and production needs.
  • Communicate production goals, priorities, and schedule changes at the start of each shift.
  • Monitor workflow and reassign resources as needed to avoid bottlenecks and meet deadlines.
  • Coordinate with supervisors, maintenance, and other departments to support smooth operations.

3. Training and Employee Development

  • Train new hires and cross-train existing employees on assembly processes, work instructions, and safety procedures.
  • Demonstrate proper use of tools, equipment, and materials; verify understanding and competency.
  • Maintain up-to-date training records and provide feedback to the Supervisor on employee progress.
  • Serve as a first point of contact for questions about procedures or quality standards.

4. Quality and Documentation

  • Ensure team members follow work instructions, drawings, and quality standards.
  • Perform spot checks and visual inspections of assembled products; report and help resolve quality issues.
  • Support continuous improvement activities to increase efficiency and reduce waste or rework.
  • Assist in tracking production data (counts, scrap, downtime) and reporting results to management.

5. Leadership, Performance, and Employee Relations

  • Lead by example with a strong focus on safety, quality, attendance, and work ethic.
  • Provide clear, respectful instructions and feedback to team members.
  • Assist in conducting performance evaluations by providing input, documentation, and observations on employee performance.
  • Support in administering disciplinary actions, including documenting incidents, coaching employees, and participating in disciplinary meetings in accordance with company policies.
  • Help resolve minor conflicts or issues within the team and escalate when necessary.
  • Support a positive, respectful work environment that encourages teamwork and accountability.

6. Continuous Improvement and 5S

  • Support continuous improvement activities focused on safety, quality, delivery, productivity, cost, and workplace organization.
  • Identify deviations from standard work and support corrective actions.
  • Participate in root-cause analysis and implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
  • Recommend improvements to assembly methods, tooling, workplace organization, safety, quality, material flow, and production processes.
  • Support lean manufacturing initiatives and implementation of standardized work.
  • Maintain and promote company 5S standards within assigned work areas.

Marginal Job Functions:

  • Work in Production, Service, Test, Paint, or other operational areas as needed, provided the employee has the required skills, training, and qualifications for the work.
  • Support special projects, audits, inventory activities, equipment moves, or other operational requirements as assigned.
  • Provide input to the Production Manager or Plant Manager regarding employee performance, training needs, operational issues, and improvement opportunities.

Necessary Prior Experience:

  • Typically, 5 or more years of relevant experience in wind gearbox, power transmission, heavy equipment, industrial assembly, test, paint, or a comparable manufacturing environment.
  • Equivalent combinations of relevant assembly experience, technical knowledge, training, and demonstrated leadership ability may be considered.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate hourly employees in a manufacturing environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to train, coach, and cross-train employees.
  • Ability to prioritize work and make routine decisions in a production environment.
  • Ability to identify problems, coordinate available resources, and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Working knowledge of mechanical assembly practices, drawings, tools, measuring equipment, and quality requirements.
  • Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word and Excel.
  • Working knowledge of SAP or a similar ERP system preferred.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Good oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate production priorities and technical requirements clearly.
  • Good organizational and problem-solving skills.

Educational Requirements:

High school diploma or GED required.

Additional technical training, apprenticeship, vocational education, manufacturing certifications, or equivalent relevant manufacturing experience preferred.

Physical and Work Environment Requirements:

  • Ability to regularly work in a manufacturing/shop-floor environment.
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Ability to climb stairs and access production areas as required.
  • Ability to wear required PPE.
  • Ability to safely lift and handle materials within company-established limits.
  • Ability to work around industrial machinery, cranes, forklifts, tooling, oils, and other normal manufacturing conditions.

Summary:

About the Role:
Are you passionate about quality, compliance, and ensuring the highest standards in laboratory operations?

Roswell Park Comprehensive Cancer Center is seeking a Senior Clinical Laboratory Technologist to help drive quality and regulatory excellence across the Department of Pathology and Laboratory Medicine. In this role, you'll partner with laboratory leaders and staff to support quality management initiatives, regulatory compliance, performance improvement efforts, and accreditation requirements that help ensure accurate and reliable laboratory results.

This position is ideal for an experienced laboratory professional who enjoys combining technical expertise with quality oversight, process improvement, and staff education to make a meaningful impact on patient care, research, and operational excellence.

The starting annual salary for this position is $73,755 and this can include a full comprehensive benefits package. This will also include an additional geographic differential of $4.60/hr and an additional assignment differential of $4.00/hr.

What You'll Do:
As a Senior Clinical Laboratory Technologist, you will:
Support quality assurance and regulatory activities across Pathology and Laboratory Medicine.
Partner with laboratory leadership to maintain and strengthen the Laboratory Quality Management System.
Review laboratory testing procedures and processes to ensure compliance with regulatory and accreditation requirements.
Conduct audits, analyze findings, and identify opportunities for quality improvement and operational excellence.
Monitor quality indicators and assist with corrective and preventive action initiatives.
Provide technical guidance, training, and support to laboratory staff on quality-related processes and best practices.
Assist with document management activities, including policy, procedure, and record review.
Help assess compliance with laboratory standards, regulations, and internal quality requirements.
Collaborate with laboratory teams to investigate and resolve quality-related issues.
Serve as a quality and compliance resource for laboratory staff and departments across the organization.
Perform laboratory technology duties as needed while supporting departmental quality goals.

What You'll Bring:
We're looking for a detail-oriented laboratory professional who is committed to quality, continuous improvement, and teamwork.

Successful candidates will bring:
Clinical Lab background that encompasses experience within the Pathology lab disciplines
Clinical laboratory experience with a strong understanding of laboratory operations and testing processes.
Knowledge of quality assurance, quality management systems, and regulatory compliance requirements.
Experience reviewing procedures, conducting audits, and evaluating process performance.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Effective written and verbal communication skills.
The ability to educate, mentor, and support colleagues in a collaborative environment.
A commitment to accuracy, patient safety, and continuous improvement.

You'll thrive in this role if you enjoy:
Identifying opportunities to improve quality and efficiency.
Working with data to drive informed decisions.
Collaborating with diverse teams to solve complex challenges.
Helping maintain high standards of excellence in laboratory services.
Supporting an environment focused on learning, development, and accountability.

Why You'll Love Working Here:
At Roswell Park, every team member contributes to a mission larger than themselves: eliminating cancer's grip on humanity through research, education, prevention, and exceptional patient care.

When you join our team, you'll enjoy:
Meaningful work that supports life-changing patient care and groundbreaking research.
Opportunities to influence quality and operational excellence across a nationally recognized cancer center.
A collaborative culture where your expertise and ideas are valued.
Ongoing professional development and career growth opportunities.
The chance to work alongside highly skilled laboratory, clinical, and research professionals.
A mission-driven environment dedicated to innovation, discovery, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications:

Required Education and Experience
License Requirement
1. Possession of a full license to practice as a Clinical Laboratory Technologist in the State of New York; or
2. Eligibility for full licensure as a Clinical Laboratory Technologist in the State of New York; or
3. Physician licensed to practice medicine or osteopathy in the State of New York.

Education and Experience
1. Doctorate degree in one of the chemical, physical or biological sciences and the equivalent of one (1) year of full-time experience as a Clinical Laboratory Technologist in a clinical laboratory or blood bank; or
2. Master’s degree in one of the chemical, physical or biological sciences and the equivalent of two (2) years of full-time experience as a Clinical Laboratory Technologist in a clinical laboratory or blood bank; or
3. Bachelor’s degree in one of the chemical, physical or biological sciences and the equivalent of four (4) years of full-time experience as a Clinical Laboratory Technologist in a clinical laboratory or blood bank; or
4. Bachelor’s degree in medical technology or laboratory science and the equivalent of four (4) years of full-time experience as a Clinical Laboratory Technologist in a clinical laboratory or blood bank.

NOTES:
1. As a condition of continued employment, full license eligible incumbents must obtain and maintain the full Clinical Laboratory Technologist licensure in the State of New York within six (6) months of their appointment to this title.
2. Possession of the Clinical Laboratory Technologist licensure supersedes educational requirements listed above, as stated in section 58-1.5 (b) of the NYS Codes, Rules and Regulations.
3. The applicable clinical laboratory or blood bank experience must be from a clinical laboratory or blood bank as defined in Section 571 of the New York State Public Health Law.
4. Degrees must be conferred by an accredited school, college, or university, or by an institution recognized by Roswell Park Comprehensive Cancer Center and/or Health Research Incorporated as adhering to acceptable educational standards.

The preferred candidate will possess a clinical lab background that encompasses experience within the Pathology lab disciplines. The preferred candidate will have experience with equipment and method validation including standard operating procedure development and document control. The preferred candidate will have knowledge of laboratory regulatory standards, experience with key performance indicators and process improvement, and experience with lab accreditation surveys and auditing. The preferred candidate will possess leadership/team building skills, possess excellent communication skills, and attention to detail. The preferred candidate will be proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, Laboratory Information Systems, and have experience with data analysis.

title: Family Services Counselor
description:
Centerstone is among the nation’s leading nonprofit behavioral health systems with thousands of employees dedicated to delivering care that changes people’s lives. A dynamic, well-established organization, we offer rewarding opportunities to serve all ages in a variety of settings. Come talk to us about joining the Centerstone team!


JOB DESCRIPTION:

SUMMARY OF POSITION

Provides therapeutic interventions to promote personal growth and resiliency in the form of emotional, cognitive, behavioral and/or psychological changes in clients with a primary behavioral health diagnosis. Performs continuing assessment of the client’s needs and functioning, maintenance of appropriate documentation and development, and implementation of personal growth plans consistent with the client’s therapeutic needs.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provides community-based services utilizing evidence-based methodologies to provide excellent clinical services. Prepares for and conducts individual, group, and family mental health services for assigned caseload. Assists client in developing an individualized service plan, must be person centered, family centered, and service centered. Monitors client progress in treatment and participates in service plan reviews as assigned. Updates service plans as appropriate.
  • Submits service plans at all stages for medical review, if applicable. Conducts intake for client entering services, including explaining services, gathering information needed on intake materials, ensuring client understands all forms, assuring signature on appropriate contracts and consents, and submitting materials for processing, as assigned. Conducts assessment and writes assessment summaries, as assigned. Assists clients with making linkage with internal and external resources as outlined in service plan and in coordination with Integrated Healthcare Services. Maintains appropriate contact with referral sources including providing information on client progress, behavior, and needs (with appropriate releases), and maintaining ongoing consultation when appropriate.
  • Assists client in making discharge plans and provide follow up services as assigned. Demonstrates commitment to all assigned clients and families at various stages of change by using motivational interviewing and outreaching clients who have disengaged from services. Provides assertive outreach, advocacy and follow-up to assigned clients. For disengaged clients and families, a minimum of 2 attempted phone outreaches, 1 attempted home visit outreach and 1 letter of interest are completed and documented in the Electronic Health Record. Ensures services provided are driven by client personal growth goals.
  • Links all clinical documentation to identified personal growth goals and objectives as indicated on the individual service plan. Ensures documentation of Progress Contact Note (PCN) activities reflect personal growth plan objectives and demonstrate medical necessity. Utilizes PCN completion as a personal growth tool to celebrate client successes and identify growth areas by completing progress notes concurrently with clients. Completes and submits all required clinical documentation within established timeframes (generally within 24 hours of service provision). To ensure a complete clinical record, completes Progress Contact Notes for all contacts, canceled/failed appointments and attempted contacts with clients and collaterals within established timeframes.

title: VP of Clinical
location: New Narrative East OP - Portland, OR
description:
At New Narrative, we believe mental health care is community care. As a nonprofit organization, we partner with individuals to promote healing, housing stability, and long-term wellness through compassionate, equitable support.


If you’re passionate about community impact, we invite you to join our team.

PLEASE APPLY DIRECTLY ON OUR CAREER SITE TO ENSURE YOUR APPLICATION IS VIEWED


Pay Rate: Starts at $135,000 but can go up considering relevant experience




Purpose (General Description and Summary)


The VP of Clinical Services provides strategic and operational leadership for New Narrative's clinical and treatment-focused community services, including outpatient behavioral health services, access and benefits, intensive case management (ICM), psychiatric security review board (PSRB), residential team-based care programs, and future clinical service lines.


Serving as the Chief of Community Services' primary operational partner, this position is responsible for translating organizational strategy into effective service delivery, leadership development, and sustainable program operations. The VP of Clinical Services oversees implementation of integrated, recovery-oriented, trauma-informed, and culturally responsive services that advance participant outcomes and organizational priorities.


This role plays a central leadership function in New Narrative's matrix management model, ensuring effective partnership between operational leaders and subject matter experts, including peer and clinical practice leaders. The position is accountable for integrating discipline-specific expertise, lived experience perspectives, and best practices into program design, workforce development, and service delivery.

The VP of Clinical Services provides senior leadership for implementation, sustainability, and continuous improvement of the Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinic (CCBHC) model while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement across Community Services.


Accountabilities (Responsibilities of the Job)

Strategic Leadership & System Development

  • Partner with the Chief of Community Services to shape and implement organizational strategy across clinical and treatment-focused service lines.
  • Translate strategic priorities into operational plans, measurable outcomes, and sustainable service models.
  • Contribute to agency-wide planning, organizational decision-making, and implementation of strategic initiatives as a senior member of Community Services leadership.
  • Represent New Narrative with funders, community partners, healthcare systems, county and state agencies, and regulatory stakeholders as assigned.
  • Identify emerging service needs, funding opportunities, and innovations that strengthen New Narrative's continuum of care and support organizational growth.
  • Lead and contribute to the development and implementation of new programs, service expansions, and system improvements aligned with organizational strategy and approved priorities.
  • Promote organizational values, mission alignment, equity, and participant-centered care across all supervised programs.

Clinical Operations & Program Integration

  • Provide leadership oversight for outpatient behavioral health services, access and benefits, ICM, PSRB, residential team-based care programs, and other assigned clinical services.
  • Ensure consistent implementation of recovery-oriented, trauma-informed, culturally responsive, and evidence-informed practices.
  • Promote integration across clinical, peer, housing, medical, and community-based services to support whole-person care and continuity of services.
  • Provide consultation and support regarding complex clinical situations, operational challenges, high-acuity participants, and systems-level service concerns.
  • Ensure programs maintain effective systems supporting access, engagement, care coordination, service transitions, and participant outcomes.

description:
Job Description:


Global Enablement Executive | dentsu | London | 12-month FTC | Hybrid Working

Purpose of the Role


The Global Enablement Executive will provide practical coordination and delivery support to the Global Client Enablement team. The role will help teams and markets use dentsu products, tools, learning materials and enablement resources effectively, supporting key priorities including internal product rollout, adoption activity, client and market learning programmes, and wider enablement initiatives.


Working closely with the Global Enablement team, the role will support rollout planning, documentation, reporting, training logistics, market follow-ups and day-to-day enablement requests. The role will help ensure activities are well coordinated, information is kept up to date, and stakeholders receive the materials and support they need. Day-to-day responsibilities will include maintaining project plans and trackers, coordinating meetings and follow-ups, preparing presentations and communications for client teams, supporting training sessions, tracking programme progress and helping respond to enablement requests from markets and stakeholders.

This is a hands-on delivery role with a strong focus on organisation, coordination and consistent execution across clients, teams and functions. It offers a strong introduction to enablement, client management and dentsu’s product suite, while building practical experience in programme support and cross-market delivery.

What you’ll do

  • Work closely with the Global Enablement Manager and Program Director to maintain rollout plans, track actions, monitor follow-ups and coordinate readiness activity across markets and enablement workstreams.
  • Maintain programme documentation and trackers, ensuring key information, actions, decisions, timelines and dependencies are captured accurately and kept up to date.
  • Support programme reporting by consolidating inputs, preparing status updates and contributing to regular team and leadership updates.
  • Coordinate training and learning logistics, including session planning, invitations, attendance tracking, asset coordination and post-session follow-up.
  • Support market and client enablement requests by coordinating responses, updating enablement materials and helping prepare clear market-facing communications.
  • Support internal product enablement activity, including rollout preparation, adoption support, market coordination and the maintenance of relevant materials and information.
  • Provide operational support for learning programmes and capability-development initiatives, helping the team coordinate activities and deliver agreed workstream priorities.
  • Work with Product, Marketing, Global Operations and other relevant teams to gather information, support the development of enablement materials and assist with internal and market communications.
  • Respond to day-to-day enablement needs, helping the team prioritise requests, follow up on actions and maintain progress across agreed activities.

What you’ll bring

Essential Skills:

  • Strong organisational and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks, actions and deadlines.
  • Good attention to detail and confidence maintaining accurate trackers, documentation and programme information.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare simple updates, follow-ups and stakeholder communications.
  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the confidence to work with colleagues across teams, functions and markets.
  • Ability to gather, organise and consolidate information from multiple stakeholders.
  • A proactive, service-minded approach and willingness to support the team where needed.

Desirable Skills:

  • Experience of, or interest in, enablement, learning, technology, product adoption or programme delivery.
  • Experience working in a media, technology or international business environment is desirable.

What we offer


This is a 12-month Fixed Term Contract role. The team is based from our London office on a hybrid working basis.

At dentsu, we’ve built a benefits package that supports every chapter of your life. title: BSA/AML Investigator
description:
Job Description:

Job Title: BSA/AML Investigator

Location: Topeka, KS/Wichita, KS

Employment Type: Full-Time



About Capitol Federal

At Capitol Federal Savings Bank, we're committed to helping individuals, families, and communities achieve financial success. Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, and we strive to create an environment where team members can grow, contribute, and build rewarding careers.



Position Summary

The BSA/AML Investigator is responsible for investigating transactions and account alerts across all business lines for potential Bank Secrecy Act/Anti Money Laundering (BSA/AML) red flags. This position requires strong analytical/research skills for conducting customer risk analysis, behavior reviews and account monitoring of high-risk customers. This role is responsible for investigating complex suspicious activity cases to ensure that potentially suspicious transactions are appropriately identified within the specified timeframes. The position focuses on enhanced due diligence (EDD) relating to BSA/AML risks involving customers and products. Ability to grasp complex processes quickly and identify risks while applying critical thinking and risk-based analysis skills. Ensures compliance with the Bank Secrecy Act/Anti-Money Laundering (BSA/AML), Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC), USA Patriot Act and related laws and regulation.



Key Responsibilities

  • Maintains a case workload to conduct ongoing monitoring and investigations of high risk accounts and transaction activity through analysis of EDD, transactional data, historical data, internal and external searches in accordance with leading practices and bank's policy and procedures. Supports departmental quality standards and workload.
  • Investigates transaction and customer alerts, reports and referrals for unconventional customer behavior to identify potentially suspicious financial activity to include money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud and/or other financial risks or crimes. Makes risk-based recommendations on appropriate actions to be taken to maintain compliance with BSA/AML regulatory reporting requirements.
  • Use strong written communication skills to create detailed documentation of reviews of suspicious activity and/or customer risk analysis to make appropriate recommendations, such as SAR filing or ongoing monitoring.
  • Work with departments and branches to collect and update account records related to enhanced due diligence. Review risk parameters in Fraud/AML software and research account records to ensure accuracy.
  • Prepare suspicious activity reports (SAR) for filing with regulatory agencies. Prepares currency transaction reports (CTR) and monitors cash sales of monetary instruments.
  • Maintain current knowledge of BSA/AML trends and guidelines. Review guidance and regulatory advisories to stay abreast of industry changes and trends.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Participate in proactive team efforts to achieve departmental and company goals.
  • Must comply with current applicable laws, regulations and bank policies and procedures. Comply with all safety policies, practices and procedures. Report all unsafe activities to supervisor and/or Human Resources.

Qualifications Required

  • A high school degree or equivalent.
  • CAFP, CAMS, CFE or similar preferred.

Skills

  • Excellent analytical and organizational skills. Knowledge of BSA and USA Patriot Act requirements. Advanced Excel required.
  • Experience with Verafin Financial Crime Management Platform preferred.
  • A significant level of trust and diplomacy is required to be an effective subject matter expert in the position. In-depth dialogues, conversations and explanations with customers, direct and indirect reports and outside vendors of a sensitive and/or highly confidential nature is a normal part of the day-to-day experience. Communications can involve motivating, influencing, educating and/or advising others on matters of significance.

Why Join Capitol Federal?

Capitol Federal offers a collaborative culture, opportunities for professional development, and a competitive benefits package that may include:

  • Medical, dental, life, and disability insurance
  • Retirement and savings plans
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Parental leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities

CapFed® is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Butikkmedarbeider
description:
Vil du hjelpe våre kunder å fange og bevare livets øyeblikk?

Til vår butikk på Byporten søker vi en butikkmedarbeider med godt humør som har interesse for bildeprodukter og salg.


Kvalifikasjoner og profil

Vi ser etter deg som har interesse for bilder, interiør og kreative produkter, og som synes det er gøy å hjelpe andre med å finne løsninger som betyr noe for dem. Du vil jobbe som tilkallingsvikar, og vii ser derfor etter deg som er fleksibel, og som har tid og lyst til å jobbe ekstra i den travle julesesongen.

Du har gjerne erfaring fra salg eller service, men det er ikke et krav. Det viktigste for oss er at du har et genuint engasjement, en positiv innstilling og et ønske om å lære og utvikle deg. Har du interesse for våre produkter og et ønske om å gjøre en forskjell for kundene våre, tror vi du vil passe godt inn hos oss.

Arbeidsoppgaver

CEWE Japan Photo Byporten er en fullsortiments fotobutikk som tilbyr det du trenger av kameraprodukter enten du er amatør, entusiast eller profesjonell fotograf.

Arbeidet vil bestå i å yte topp service og å selge fotoprodukter som vår prisvinnende CEWE FOTOBOK, CEWE veggbilder (bildeforstørrelser, lerret, akryltrykk), rammer, bilder og andre fotoprodukter så interesse for interiør og bilder er en fordel. Du vil også hjelpe våre kunder til å finne det beste kameraet til sitt bruk sammen med det rette tilbehøret, til dette er det en fordel med teknisk forståelse og foto-interesse.

Som butikkmedarbeider vil du også ta del i den daglige driften av butikken. Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet være salg og kundebehandling, mottak og utlevering av kundeordrer, betjening av kasse, varepåfylling og rydding. Du vil også bidra til at butikken alltid fremstår innbydende og inspirerende, blant annet gjennom oppfølging av kampanjer, vareeksponering og utstillinger.

Har du prøvd å lage en CEWE fotobok selv og kunne tenke deg å hjelpe andre med å få noe ut av deres digitale bilder og gi gleden av produktene videre?

Vi håper du ønsker å bidra til at flotte blinkskudd ikke blir liggende på mobilen eller bortgjemt på en harddisk. Vi tror at ett bilde på veggen er bedre enn 10 på mobilen, og at gode minner gjør seg aller best i en personlig og unik CEWE FOTOBOK.



Vi tilbyr

  • Et hyggelig arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte og dyktige kollegaer
  • Mulighet for videre utvikling og interne karrieremuligheter
  • Gode personalrabatter på våre produkter
  • Spennende produkter i Nordens ledende kjede innenfor fotoutstyr og bildeprodukter
  • Lønn etter avtale

Oppstart: Snarest!


Vi gleder oss til å lese søknaden din, og ber om at du legger ved både CV og søknadsbrev.


CEWE-merket har siden 1961 stått for innovasjon, kreativitet og fotoprodukter av høy kvalitet som begeistrer mennesker over hele Europa.

Klar til å ta neste steg? Vi gleder oss til å høre din historie.

Bli med i teamet vårt og form fremtiden sammen med oss

Come build something that matters.

It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. · Learn: Have access to a wealth of learning resources, including our digital learning portal.

What’s more, you’ll get that pride that comes from empowering makers, doers, protectors, and everyday heroes all over the world. We’re more than the #1 tools company. More than a driving force in outdoor power equipment. More than a global leader in industrial. We’re visionaries and innovators. As successful as we’ve been in the past, we have so much further to go. That’s where you come in. Join us!

description:
Särmääjä Poriin

Etsimme kokenutta särmääjää pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.

Tehtävässä korostuu erityisesti ohjelmointiosaaminen – etsimme tekijää, joka osaa tehdä särmäysohjelmat itse, eikä työ ole pelkästään valmiiden ohjelmien ajamista.

Työtehtävät

  • Särmäys Bystronicin särmäyskoneilla

  • Särmäysohjelmien tekeminen

  • Kappaleiden valmistaminen teknisten piirustusten mukaisesti

  • Piirustusten ja mittojen tulkitseminen

  • Kappaleiden laadun ja mittojen tarkistaminen

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

  • Aikaisempaa kokemusta särmäyksestä

  • Kykyä tehdä särmäysohjelmia itsenäisesti – tämä on tehtävässä kriittinen vaatimus

  • Hyvää teknisten piirustusten lukutaitoa

  • Tarkkaa ja huolellista työotetta

  • Valmiutta kolmivuorotyöhön

  • Englannin kielen taitoa vähintään perustasolla

Bystronicin koneiden tuntemus on eduksi. Ohjelmointijärjestelmän ei tarvitse olla ennestään juuri sama – jos olet tehnyt ohjelmia jollain toisella järjestelmällä, uuden oppiminen onnistuu perehdytyksellä.

Kansainvälinen tausta ei ole este, kunhan pystyt työskentelemään englanniksi ja ymmärrät työohjeet.

  • Sijainti: Pori

  • Työsuhde: Pitkäaikainen

  • Työaika: Kolmivuorotyö, valmius tarvitaan

description:
Job Summary

This position is primarily responsible for executing shipping and receiving tasks to ensure timely and accurate delivery of products. It also includes light production duties to support on-time production and uphold high standards of quality, safety, and customer service.

Job Description

About Us

At Quaker Houghton, we are experts in the development, production and application of industrial process fluids, lubricants and coatings for the manufacturing industry. We have been an integral part in the growth of the world’s largest industrial and manufacturing companies from aerospace and automotive to primary metal and energy. Today, we have a global presence, with our corporate headquarters located in Conshohocken, PA. Quaker Houghton is a global publicly traded company with a unique collaborative culture that supports career growth for its colleagues and offers competitive compensation and benefit programs.

Position Summary:

This position will focus primarily on shipping and receiving responsibilities. Additional responsibilities for performing occasional, light production duties to ensure on-time production and shipment of product while adhering to high standards of quality, safety and customer service.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Loading and unloading trucks and moving finished goods/raw materials throughout facilities, including the use of fork trucks.
  • Assist in tracking material inventory and performing inventory counts.
  • Store and retrieve raw materials, finished goods, and supplies in the warehouse.
  • Clean up spills of non-hazardous items.
  • Prepare and inspect drums/bins, etc. for shipment.
  • Assist in maintaining a clean and safe facility through performance of general housekeeping duties.
  • Confirm paperwork is complete for all shipments and correct when needed.
  • Loading and unloading of overseas containers.

Education/Experience:

  • High school diploma/GED
  • Previous shipping and receiving preferred

title: Emergency Department EMT

description:
Job Description:

This position is responsible for providing both basic and advanced life support to patients in an efficient, knowledgeable, and cost-effective manner, which is accurately documented and properly coordinated with other health care personnel.

**A Current Basic EMT or Paramedic License in the State of Montana is required**


Essential Functions

  • Obtains patients' vital signs, including blood pressure, pulse, and temperature, and understands normal ranges and changes. Informs RNs or Physicians of changes in vital signs.
  • Collects blood, urine, saliva, and stool samples for laboratory analysis.
  • Inserts Foley catheters, performs straight catheterizations, provides wound care, and fits patients for casts, hard splints, crutches, and other devices.
  • Performs 12-lead EKGs and provides instruments to doctors and nurses during procedures.
  • Assists with the safe movement of patients, applying principles of safe patient handling.
  • Assists with admitting patients into the ER, schedules patient transfers, reinforces patient education, and assists with discharge instructions as given by the RN.
  • Applies and checks on restraints as directed by the RN or Physician.
  • Performs the duties of unit secretary, including maintaining patient charts, responding to phone calls, maintaining the daily assignment board, providing equipment care/cleaning, performing errands associated with patient care, and providing accurate information to the interdisciplinary team.
  • Demonstrates and adheres to the standards of infection prevention, following principles and upholding the Standards of Infection Prevention.

Skills

  • Patient Care
  • Life Support
  • Vital Signs
  • Patient Education
  • Safe Patient Handling
  • Patient Transfers
  • Patient Information
  • Blood Pressure
  • Paramedic Training
  • Communication

Posting Specifics

  • Entry Rate: Depending on experience
  • Benefits Eligible: Yes
  • Shift Details: Full Time, Night Shift
  • Department: Emergency Department, St. Vincent Healthcare

Minimum Qualifications

  • Current Basic EMT or Paramedic license in state of Montana
  • Basic Life Support (BLS-HCP) Certification for Healthcare Providers upon hire
  • EMTs must obtain IV certification within six months of their hire date.

Preferred Qualifications

  • One (1) year of related experience

Physical Requirements

  • Ongoing need for employee to see and read information, labels, assess patient needs, operate monitors, identify equipment and supplies.
  • Frequent interactions with patient care providers, patients, and visitors that require employee to verbally communicate as well as hear and understand spoken information, alarms, needs, and issues quickly and accurately, particularly during emergency situations.
  • Manual dexterity of hands and fingers to manipulate complex and delicate equipment with precision and accuracy. This includes frequent computer use and typing for documenting patient care, accessing needed information, medication preparation, etc.
  • Expected to lift and utilize full range of movement to transfer patients. Will also bend to retrieve, lift, and carry supplies and equipment. Typically includes items of varying weights, up to and including heavy items.
  • Need to walk and assist with transporting/ambulating patients and obtaining and distributing supplies and equipment. This includes pushing/pulling gurneys and portable equipment, including heavy items. Often required to navigate crowded and busy rooms (full of equipment, power cords on the floor, etc.)
  • May be expected to stand in a stationary position for an extended period of time.
  • For roles requiring driving: Expected to drive a vehicle which requires sitting, seeing and reading signs, traffic signals, and other vehicles.

description:
Clorox is the place that’s committed to growth – for our people and our brands. Guided by our purpose and values, and with people at the center of everything we do, we believe every one of us can make a positive impact on consumers, communities, and teammates. Join our team. #CloroxIsThePlace

Your role at Clorox:

Clorox R&D turns consumer needs into trusted products that improve everyday life. In Brita, that work has a direct connection to people, water, and the planet—helping millions of consumers to access better-tasting water while reducing reliance on single-use bottles. As a Senior Scientist on the Brita R&D team, you will help shape the future of Brita product systems by leading devices (for example, pitcher systems) development and commercialization across one of Clorox’s most recognized brands. This is a highly cross-functional, hands-on technical leadership role for someone who wants to combine engineering depth, consumer empathy, manufacturing partnership, and business impact.

Evergreen Position Summary (Mission/Purpose):

Brita’s mission is to enable better water for people and the planet. As a Senior Scientist in Brita R&D Product Development, you will lead complex and often ambiguous technical work focused on device, rigid systems, and packaging innovation and commercialization across the Brita portfolio.

You will serve as the technical lead for programs that span concept development, product system design, molded part and assembly development, prototyping, testing, risk assessment, design for manufacturing, tooling qualification, packaging development, scale-up, and start-of-production. This role requires translating consumer needs, business priorities, technical feasibility, quality requirements, sustainability goals, and manufacturing realities into robust product and process solutions while leading technical collaboration with internal teams, external development partners, suppliers, plants, and manufacturing partners.

This evergreen role is expected to build and apply deep Brita systems and device expertise, influence cross-functional and leadership decisions, elevate technical best practices, and strengthen organizational capability through knowledge capture, training, and improved ways of working.

This evergreen position will be in our Pleasanton, CA office, and the individual will be expected to be in the office for a minimum of 3 days a week. Relocation assistance will be offered.

In this role, you will:

In this role, you will provide senior-level technical leadership for Brita device, systems, and packaging product development across the portfolio, with accountability for complex initiatives that influence the broader Brita business:

  • Own Device, Systems, and Packaging Development and Scale-Up: Develop and refine product system designs, molded part and assembly specifications, color/material/finish requirements, indicator/electronic device requirements, packaging specifications, process parameters, and performance requirements through prototyping, lab testing, supplier trials, tooling qualification, and full-scale manufacturing. Apply strong technical judgment, structured problem solving, statistical analysis, tolerance assessment, and design-of-experiment approaches to deliver consumer delight, product quality, manufacturability, sustainability, and supply continuity.
  • Lead Complex Technical Programs: Identify, lead, and execute new product development and technical initiatives where consumer metrics, product architecture, molded part design, packaging needs, supplier capability, tooling approach, or manufacturing location may be undefined. Bring clarity to ambiguity, shape technical plans, and drive decisions that advance Brita business priorities.
  • Lead Cross-Functional Technical Decisions: Serve as the R&D technical lead and “one R&D voice” across Marketing, Insights, Design, Sales, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Legal, project teams, suppliers, plants, and external manufacturers. Translate consumer, business, regulatory, quality, manufacturing, cost, sustainability, and customer needs into technical requirements, specifications, claims support, risk assessments, validation plans, and commercialization-ready decisions that balance impact, speed, feasibility, and execution risk.
  • Drive External Partner Development and Manufacturing Excellence: Lead technical collaboration with external product design firms, development partners, tooling partners, packaging suppliers, technology suppliers, domestic and international manufacturers, and Clorox plants. Define technical requirements and success criteria, manage partner workstreams, review and challenge design solutions, guide prototyping and validation plans, resolve technical issues, and ensure external partners deliver against quality, cost, timing, regulatory, sustainability, and commercial launch expectations.
  • Elevate Best Practices and Capability: Create, approve, and educate teams on product development, test method, specification, risk assessment, packaging development, tooling qualification, trial, and commercialization best practices. Capture technical learning, train others on Brita device and systems development, and strengthen the broader department’s ability to deliver with speed and rigor.
  • Champion Digital, Data, and AI-Enabled R&D: Use digital tools, data analysis, models, and emerging AI-enabled ways of working to improve speed, quality of decisions, technical learning, knowledge management, documentation, and delivery of R&D work outputs.
  • Provide organizational leadership beyond project work through mentoring, recruiting support, communities of practice, training, and knowledge sharing.
  • Travel up to approximately 25% to suppliers, plants, and manufacturing partners, including international travel.

What we look for:

  • 5+ years of R&D, product development, product design, device engineering, systems engineering, packaging, process development, molded part or small consumer electronics development, consumer product systems, manufacturing scale-up, or related technical experience.
  • Product development, product design, commercialization, packaging development, or applied technology development experience is strongly preferred. Please see the next bullet points for more details.
  • Knowledge of injection molding, rigid consumer product systems, small electronics, sensors, packaging development, DFM, tooling qualification, tolerance analysis, ASTM packaging test methods, CAD, FEA, basic electronics, or process validation is preferred but not required if the candidate brings strong technical depth, product development orientation, and relevant transferable experience.
  • Highly relevant experience may come from consumer products, durable goods, beverage systems or appliances, medical devices/medtech, diagnostics devices, applied engineering, packaging, plastics, molded components, regulated products, manufacturing scale-up, supplier technical management, or adjacent technical industries—especially where the candidate has led product design, verification/validation, tooling qualification, small electronics commercialization, or technology transfer work.

Skills and Abilities

  • Demonstrated ability to lead undefined, complex technical work and bring clarity to ambiguous product, system, packaging, supplier, tooling, or manufacturing challenges.
  • Strong technical judgment with hands-on testing, methodical problem solving, data analysis, statistics, DOE, tolerance assessment, capability analysis, reliability evaluation, and sample-size rationale.
  • Ability to translate consumer needs, business priorities, brand/design intent, regulatory requirements, quality expectations, sustainability goals, and manufacturing constraints into technical specifications and execution plans.
  • Strong systems-thinking capability; able to integrate molded parts, assemblies, indicators/electronics, packaging, user experience, manufacturability, cost, quality, and sustainability into coherent product systems.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, leadership teams, suppliers, tooling partners, and manufacturing partners through clear technical recommendations and risk-based decision making.
  • Ability to manage external technical partners by setting clear expectations, translating business and consumer needs into technical direction, reviewing partner outputs, driving decisions, and holding development partners accountable for milestones and deliverables.
  • Experience developing or improving best practices, test methods, technical standards, packaging specifications, knowledge capture, training, or capability-building approaches for a broader technical team.
  • Ability to leverage digital tools, CAD or related technical software, data analysis, models, and AI-enabled ways of working to improve speed, learning, documentation, and quality of technical decisions.
  • Strong communication, organization, learning agility, and ownership mindset; able to work independently and cross-functionally with minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment.

Education Level/Degree:

Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Packaging, Product Design Engineering, Mechatronics/Electromechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science/Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

Blackgrange is a key site within the Scotch spirit supply chain. The site consists of warehousing, disgorging for malt and grain spirits. title: SDET
description:
#WeAreTradeStation
Who We Are:
TradeStation is the home of those born to trade. As an online brokerage firm and trading ecosystem, we are focused on delivering the ultimate trading experience for active traders and institutions. We continuously push the boundaries of what's possible, encourage out-of-the-box thinking, and relentlessly search for like-minded innovators.
At TradeStation, we are building an AI-First culture. We expect team members to embrace AI as a core part of their daily workflow, whether that’s using AI to accelerate development, enhance decision-making, improve client outcomes, or streamline internal processes. We hire, grow, and promote people who can harness AI responsibly and creatively. We treat AI as a partner in problem-solving, not just a tool; following our governance standards to ensure AI is used ethically, securely, and transparently. If you join us, you’re joining a culture where AI is how we work.
Are you ready to make yourself at home?
What We Are Looking For:
Do you enjoy tackling interesting problems with other smart people? Have you ever wondered how a major player in the Financial Technology industry operates? At TradeStation, you'll enjoy working in a supportive environment with the latest in microservices and streaming technology — all from the comfort of your home office.
We are seeking a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join the Order Execution – Streaming (OXS) team. OXS builds low-latency, scalable, and extensible services that deliver order, position, and balance data to TradeStation and Monex clients across web, desktop, mobile, and third-party APIs.
This is a growth role on an established quality engineering group. OXS has already invested in a purpose-built C# regression framework that replaced the team's legacy Postman suites, and your work will center on extending that framework, broadening its coverage, and making it reliable enough that developers trust it and run it themselves. You will be paired with senior SDETs rather than left to figure out a complex distributed system alone. We are looking for someone with a genuine instinct for breaking software, the patience to chase down an intermittent failure, and the judgment to tell a real defect from a flaky test.
What You’ll Be Doing:
Test Automation and Framework Work
  • Write, extend, and maintain automated tests in the OXS C# regression framework covering many domains
  • Create and manage automated testing suites including unit, component, integration, and end-to-end regression tests
  • Create, automate, and execute test plans that generate artifacts validating proper functioning of OXS services and provide quality-related metrics
  • Turn user stories and acceptance criteria into concrete test cases, including negative and failure-path scenarios
  • Contribute to framework extensibility and reusable test libraries rather than one-off scripts
  • Help build and maintain mocks, stubs, and simulated upstream dependencies so tests can run without contending for shared environments
  • Partner with Engineering Managers and Technical Leads to improve software quality and testability
  • Evaluate and introduce new testing tools, methodologies, and automation capabilities to improve engineering efficiency and product quality
Validating a Streaming Platform
  • Test gRPC streaming interfaces, REST APIs, and event-driven message flows the way our customers actually consume them
  • Validate correctness of streamed state — ordering, duplication, staleness, and reconciliation between OXS state and what downstream consumers receive
  • Verify behavior across account provisioning, sharding, and multi-tenant scenarios
  • Participate in load, stress, and soak testing to confirm the platform holds its latency and throughput expectations
Quality in the Delivery Pipeline
  • Execute functional and regression testing across the environments as work moves toward production
  • Support the team's change management flow, including validating change requests and recording test evidence for releases
  • Maintain test runs, results, and evidence in TestRail so every ticket has a traceable quality record
  • Support and improve regression execution in GitLab CI pipelines, including scheduled and on-demand runs
  • Help developers outside the SDET group run the regression suite locally — improve setup tooling, documentation, and onboarding so quality shifts left
  • Manage test account pools and reservations responsibly in shared environments, and help identify where additional capacity is needed
  • Identify quality risks early in the software development lifecycle and recommend mitigation strategies to engineering leadership
  • Identify quality risks early in the software development lifecycle and recommend mitigation strategies to engineering leadership
  • Represent quality engineering during planning, architecture, and release readiness discussions
Defects, Documentation, and Support
  • Identify, document, reproduce, and track defects with enough detail that another engineer can act without a conversation
  • Investigate test failures to determine whether the cause is a product defect, a framework issue, an environment problem, or a data problem
  • Participate in code reviews and provide guidance to the team on designing for testability
  • Contribute to production support and post-incident verification, including validating fixes and adding regression coverage for anything that reached customers
  • Raise quality and risk concerns early — developers write tests too, but this role is completely focused on quality
The Skills You Bring:
  • Hands-on experience with C# and .NET; ability to read and write production-quality test code, not just scripts
  • Experience with at least one test framework (xUnit, NUnit, MSTest, or equivalent)
  • Ability to translate requirements and acceptance criteria into thorough test cases
  • Experience testing REST APIs, and familiarity with streaming or bidirectional protocols (gRPC, WebSockets)
  • Database experience sufficient to validate data and state (SQL Server, NoSQL, Redis)
  • One or more scripting languages suitable for automation, such as Bash, PowerShell, or Python
  • Source control with Git, and familiarity with continuous integration tooling (GitLab CI preferred; Azure DevOps or Jenkins acceptable)
  • Familiarity with containerization and cloud-native technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS)
  • API and network debugging tools (Postman, curl, Wireshark, browser developer tools)
  • A genuine passion for analysis and testing, with strong organization and prioritization skills
  • Demonstrated oral and written communication skills, and the ability to adapt and learn quickly
  • Willingness to be responsive during US equity and futures market hours, when release and support activity is concentrated
  • Demonstrated ability to write automated tests in an object-oriented language, whether from professional experience, internships, or substantial personal projects
  • Practical asynchronous programming and multithreading understanding preferred
  • Familiarity with event streaming or messaging systems, especially Apache Kafka or AWS MSK, preferred
  • Experience with mocking, stubbing, or service virtualization to isolate upstream dependencies preferred
  • Exposure to performance, load, or stress testing tools (k6, JMeter, Gatling, Locust) preferred
  • Familiarity with observability tooling for diagnosing failures (Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry) preferred
  • Experience with a test management tool such as TestRail preferred
  • Familiarity with audited change management processes (e.g. ServiceNow) preferred
  • Comfort using AI tooling as part of daily engineering workflow — test generation, failure triage, and documentation — preferred
  • Agile development and Test-Driven Development practices preferred
  • Brokerage/trading platform experience preferred
  • Experience testing distributed, event-driven, or microservice-based systems preferred
  • Experience validating streaming or real-time data flows rather than request/response APIs alone preferred
  • Exposure to Kafka topics, partitions, consumer groups, and lag troubleshooting preferred
  • Experience building or maintaining a test automation framework, not only writing tests within one preferred
  • Experience in financial services, brokerage, trading, or another regulated, high-availability domain preferred
Minimum Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent work experience
  • 3+ years of application testing or development experience
  • Ability to work core hours aligned to US market hours (approximately 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET)
Desired Qualifications:
  • 2+ years of professional SDET, QA automation, or software development experience
  • Professional working proficiency in English and Spanish
What We Offer:
  • Collaborative work environment
  • Competitive Salaries
  • Yearly bonus
  • Comprehensive benefits for you and your family starting Day 1
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off
  • Flexible working environment
  • TradeStation Account employee benefits, as well as full access to trading education materials

title: People & Culture - Intern, People & Culture Enablement
description:
THE BUSINESS

We are Everyday Luxury™.

It's what we do and how we do it — together.

It's working alongside world-class talent in pursuit of world-class results.

It's maximizing your potential in a high-performance culture.

It's knowing that wherever you are, you belong.

It's elevating your world — and the world of those who love and will love Aritzia.

It's You. And an endless runway of opportunity.

With a Global Support Campus in Vancouver and additional Support Office hubs in major cities across North America — including Toronto, New York, Los Angeles and Seattle — our workplace network is strategically designed to support our People and serve our Clients a frictionless experience. So, you can do what you do best — with us.

THE TEAM

The mission of the People & Culture sub-division is to cultivate engaged, high performance talent to drive business results.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Aritzia is growing and our People & Culture team is growing with it. This is a unique opportunity to be part of the team responsible for cultivating engaged, high-performing talent that drives business results. As an Intern, People & Culture, you will gain exposure to the end-to-end employee lifecycle by supporting programs, processes, and initiatives across multiple areas of People & Culture. By providing administrative, operational, and project coordination support, you will help deliver exceptional employee experiences and contribute to the successful execution of People & Culture priorities. Our goal is that you will come out of your internship inspired, with meaningful experience and an enhanced skill set you can carry forward into your bright future.

THE ROLE

As an Intern in People & Culture, you will support with:

  • Support the attraction and selection of world-class talent by coordinating key activities across the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle.
  • Contribute to programs and processes that enable effective people decisions and help build high-performing teams.
  • Support the development of learning, onboarding, assessment, and career experiences that grow employee capability and performance.
  • Help deliver meaningful total rewards programs that support talent attraction, retention, and the employee experience.
  • Provide accurate and consistent People & Culture support through employee transactions, documentation, records, and knowledge resources.
  • Enable the seamless execution of People & Culture priorities through administration, coordination, reporting, and communications.

THE QUALIFICATIONS

The Intern, People & Culture, has/is:

  • Currently enrolled in a post-secondary institution, with a preferred graduation date of April 2027 to April 2028.
    • Preferably pursuing a degree in Human Resources, Business, etc.
  • A commitment to learn and apply Aritzia's Values and Business and People Leadership principles.
  • The ability to collaborate fluently with cross-functional partners.
  • A commitment to quality and investing in results that add value to the business.
  • A resourceful and entrepreneurial way of working.
  • A passion for Aritzia and the fashion industry.
  • A logical, organized approach with an appreciation for structure and details.
  • A problem solver who thinks critically to develop insightful solutions.
  • Work experience in Aritzia Boutiques, Concierge, or Distribution Centres is highly valued.

THE DEPARTMENT

People & Culture offers you an experience unlike any other by giving you the opportunity to contribute to the programs, processes, and initiatives that support our people and enable business growth. The People & Culture team provides the unique advantage of gaining rotational exposure to multiple areas of the employee lifecycle and helping deliver meaningful solutions as we continue to scale.

Gain exposure across the employee lifecycle

  • Gain hands-on experience across Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Organizational & Talent Development, Compensation & Benefits, People Concierge, and People & Culture Enablement

Help scale our business through our people

  • Contribute to the programs, tools, and processes that support Aritzia’s continued growth
  • Support initiatives that improve how we hire, develop, support, and engage our people

World-class team and mentorship opportunities

  • Learn from People & Culture leaders and subject matter experts across a variety of specialties
  • Develop hard skills such as project coordination, reporting, process improvement, alongside soft skills such as stakeholder management, collaboration, and problem solving

THE PERKS

Some of the industry-leading benefits you will receive working at Aritzia:

  • Product Discount — Maybe you’ve heard of our famous product discount? Or our exclusive private shopping events? You have now.
  • A-OK Commissary & Cafe — Everyday Luxury dining, exclusive to Aritzia. Our in-house bistro and cafe is a private oasis where employees can enjoy curated, subsidized Everyday Luxury dining.
  • The SET — Our in-office fitness studio and gym with state-of-the-art equipment, custom-created classes and optional personal training. Open 7 days a week, it works out well.
  • Aritzia Virtual Wellness — Because your health, happiness and safety matter, we provide 24/7 resources to support you in your wellbeing goals, whether they’re physical, mental, social or financial.
  • Aspirational Workplace — Our offices are specially designed to be spaces of creativity, productivity and inspiration. They’re also dog friendly. Woof.
  • Amenities — Additional amenities include a private parent’s room, shower facilities with elevated complementary conveniences, bike rooms and more.
  • The Extras — We also offer a multitude of other perks like dry-cleaning, hotel and restaurant discounts, self-care promos and on-site medical care.

THE LOGISTICS

  • Internship Dates: May 10 – July 30, 2027 (12 weeks)
  • Location: Aritzia’s Vancouver Support Campus located in Vancouver, BC
    • Successful candidates must be able to work at the primary work location and self-relocate if necessary
  • Application Deadline: Sunday, September 27. 2026
  • Application Process:
    • Apply online – be sure to have your cover letter, resume, and unofficial transcript ready
    • Applicants moving onto the next stage will be contacted by October

ARITZIA

Aritzia is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Our goal is to be inclusive, diverse, and representative of the communities where we work while creating an environment where every person can enjoy a successful career. This commitment applies to all candidates and employees regardless of race, ethnicity, citizenship, creed, place of origin, religion, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, family status, marital status, disability, age, and any other protected characteristic.

Requests for accommodation due to a disability or any other protected characteristic can be made at any stage of the recruitment process and during employment by contacting our People & Culture Team.

We’re committed to making your experience positive and transparent. Please note, our recruiters will only contact you using an @aritzia.com email address. If you receive recruitment-related messages from other domains, please disregard them.

title: Carpintero
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

On the stunning southern coast of Mexico’s Baja peninsula, experience Cabo’s Golden Corridor with Mexican chic and a cool Mediterranean vibe. In the heart of all the action, the coveted community of Cabo Del Sol is home to our modern hacienda-style village, with sparkling ocean views throughout. Create magical memories as hearts beat to the rhythm of Mexican music, art and culture – embraced by the warmth of our Four Seasons “familia.”

¡Sé parte de algo realmente especial! Únete al equipo Four Seasons Cabo Del Sol como Carpintero. Esta amplia propiedad incluirá 96 habitaciones bellamente decoradas y 61 residencias, ubicadas en el "corredor turístico" entre Cabo San Lucas y San José del Cabo en la cima de la impresionante Baja California Sur con impresionantes vistas del mar, donde el Mar de Cortés se encuentra con el Océano Pacífico. Las instalaciones incluirán tres restaurantes, tres piscinas del resort, un gimnasio al aire libre, Spa & Spa Garden y una sala de eventos en la casa club.

Se tú

El candidato ejecutara y llevara a cabo de manera profesional, eficiente y amable las acciones y procedimientos que le indique su supervisor, para la fabricación y mantenimiento de muebles, puertas, cocinas, vigas, plafones y cualquier elemento de madera, con esto lograr los objetivos diarios, semanales y mensuales del departamento.

Siendo estas sus funciones principal mas no exclusivas, ya que como miembro del departamento de Ingeniería podrá atender los reportes que generen los diversos departamentos, basado en su profesionalismo, experiencia y conocimiento técnico, buscando siempre la máxima satisfacción del cliente y cumplir con todas las políticas y estándares de Four Seasons.

Conocimientos y Habilidades

Requisitos:

  • Experiencia mínima de 5 años, en el área operativa de mantenimiento como carpintero.

  • Habilidades comprobadas, para solucionar los diversos solicitudes o requerimientos y situaciones, con los acabados decorativos del hotel.

  • Debe tener conocimientos avanzados en reparaciones de carpintería, es decir, saber hacer reparaciones y fabricación de todo tipo de elementos de madera en cualquier aplicación que este vaya a tener, cualquier tipo de acabado, o madera, manteniendo un aspecto visual del hotel en perfectas condiciones sin que se noten parches o que este está deteriorado.

  • Debe tener precisión y destreza manual, evaluación de riesgos, pensamiento crítico, resolución de problemas, gestión del tiempo.

¿Que esperar?

  • Ser parte de un equipo solidario con espíritu familiar

  • Tener oportunidades para construir una carrera exitosa con potencial global

  • Trabajar en un entorno diverso y desafiante e interactuar con el equipo de liderazgo

  • Sea reconocido por sus logros

Acerca de Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts:

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts abrió su primer hotel en 1961 y su historia es una historia de innovación continua, expansión notable y una dedicación decidida a los más altos estándares. Durante casi 50 años, Four Seasons ha transformado la industria de la hospitalidad al combinar amabilidad y eficiencia con las mejores tradiciones hoteleras internacionales. Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts ha sido clasificado CADA AÑO como "Las 100 mejores empresas para trabajar" de la revista FORTUNE desde 1998 y ha sido nombrado "Leyenda del gran lugar para trabajar", un honor que actualmente solo tienen 12 empresas en el mundo.

Cultura de servicio

Actualmente operando 126 hoteles y resorts, y 45 propiedades residenciales en los principales centros de las ciudades y destinos turísticos en 47 países, y con más de 50 proyectos en planificación o desarrollo, Four Seasons se ubica constantemente entre los mejores hoteles del mundo y las marcas más prestigiosas en las encuestas de lectores, críticas de viajeros y premios de la industria. Nuestro mayor activo, y la clave de nuestro éxito, es nuestra gente. Creemos que cada uno de nosotros necesita un sentido de dignidad, orgullo y satisfacción en lo que hacemos.

¿Cómo es trabajar para Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts?

En Four Seasons, guiamos todas nuestras acciones por la regla de oro: “Trata a los demás como te gustaría ser tratado”. Aquí, podrá trabajar en un equipo que se basa en el respeto mutuo, la colaboración, el excelente servicio y la pasión por el servicio. Como marca de lujo, su trabajo también se guiará por estándares muy estrictos para garantizar un alto nivel de calidad y servicio en todo momento. Espere trabajar duro pero diviértase y aprenda en el camino, llevando su carrera, experiencia y habilidades al siguiente nivel. Como beneficio adicional, trabajar con Four Seasons le brinda la oportunidad de trabajar para una empresa internacional y viajar por todo el mundo mientras se hospeda en propiedades increíbles de forma gratuita.
