title: R&D Senior Staff Consultant
description:
As we create a colorful, capable and cleaner world through chemistry, we invite you to join our team to harness the power of chemistry to shape markets, redefine industries and improve lives for billions of people around the world.

Chemours está buscando un R&D Senior Staff Consultant para unirse a nuestro equipo de Tecnología e Innovación en Altamira, México.

Esta posición reportará directamente al Gerente de Tecnología y será responsable de proporcionar liderazgo técnico en iniciativas estratégicas relacionadas con la optimización de procesos, resolución de problemas complejos, mejora continua e implementación de nuevas tecnologías dentro de las operaciones de manufactura.

El candidato seleccionado actuará como un referente técnico de la organización, liderando proyectos multidisciplinarios enfocados en mejorar la seguridad, calidad, productividad, confiabilidad, sustentabilidad y competitividad de la planta. Asimismo, deberá utilizar metodologías avanzadas de análisis y resolución de problemas para identificar oportunidades de mejora, desarrollar soluciones innovadoras y garantizar una ejecución efectiva de los proyectos estratégicos del negocio.

Este rol requiere una sólida combinación de conocimiento técnico, habilidades analíticas, capacidad de liderazgo e influencia organizacional para trabajar de manera efectiva con equipos locales y globales.


Responsabilidades del Puesto:


Las responsabilidades incluyen, pero no se limitan a:

  • Proporcionar liderazgo técnico y soporte especializado a las operaciones de manufactura para mejorar el desempeño operativo, la calidad de los productos y la confiabilidad de los procesos.
  • Liderar investigaciones técnicas y aplicar metodologías estructuradas de resolución de problemas para identificar causas raíz e implementar soluciones sostenibles a problemas complejos de proceso, calidad, seguridad y productividad.
  • Identificar, desarrollar y liderar iniciativas estratégicas de mejora continua enfocadas en optimizar costos, incrementar capacidad productiva, mejorar la eficiencia operativa y reducir el impacto ambiental.
  • Liderar equipos multidisciplinarios integrados por personal de Operaciones, Mantenimiento, Ingeniería, Calidad, Seguridad y Tecnología para la ejecución de proyectos de mejora e innovación.
  • Desarrollar estudios técnicos, análisis de factibilidad y evaluaciones de riesgo para soportar decisiones de inversión, cambios tecnológicos y proyectos de optimización.
  • Diseñar, desarrollar e implementar proyectos de mejora de procesos y proyectos de capital desde la conceptualización hasta su ejecución y validación.
  • Fungir como experto técnico en áreas relacionadas con operaciones unitarias, reactores químicos, transferencia de calor y masa, sistemas de mezcla, separación, filtración, secado y manejo de sólidos.
  • Utilizar herramientas estadísticas y análisis avanzado de datos para identificar tendencias, validar hipótesis, cuantificar oportunidades de mejora y apoyar la toma de decisiones.
  • Desarrollar y administrar indicadores y dashboards de desempeño para monitorear la estabilidad y capacidad de los procesos.
  • Colaborar con áreas de Mantenimiento y Confiabilidad para mejorar el desempeño de equipos críticos mediante la optimización de estrategias operativas y de mantenimiento.
  • Participar activamente en revisiones de tecnología, gestión de cambios (MOC), análisis de riesgos y procesos de preparación para la operación.
  • Proporcionar mentoría y desarrollo técnico a ingenieros y personal técnico de la organización.
  • Colaborar con equipos globales para compartir mejores prácticas, implementar tecnologías emergentes y acelerar iniciativas de innovación.

Requisitos:


Educación

  • Licenciatura en Ingeniería Química.
  • Deseable Maestría en Ingeniería Química, Ingeniería de Procesos, Manufactura, Operaciones o disciplina relacionada.

Experiencia

  • De 5 a 8 años de experiencia en la industria química, petroquímica, manufactura de procesos o industrias relacionadas.
  • Experiencia demostrada liderando proyectos de optimización de procesos, mejora continua, productividad o innovación tecnológica.
  • Experiencia en la aplicación de metodologías de resolución de problemas y análisis de causa raíz.
  • Experiencia gestionando proyectos multidisciplinarios y coordinando equipos de trabajo diversos.
  • Experiencia participando en proyectos de capital, ampliaciones de capacidad, implementación de nuevas tecnologías o mejoras de procesos.
  • Historial comprobado de implementación exitosa de iniciativas con impacto en seguridad, calidad, productividad o reducción de costos.

Conocimientos Técnicos

  • Optimización y control de procesos químicos.
  • Análisis estadístico y toma de decisiones basada en datos.
  • Metodologías de resolución de problemas y causa raíz (DMAIC, RCA, Kepner-Tregoe, Fishbone, 5 Why's o similares).
  • Gestión y administración de proyectos.
  • Análisis de riesgos y gestión de cambios (MOC).
  • Operaciones unitarias y procesos químicos industriales.
  • Manejo avanzado de Microsoft Excel, Power BI y herramientas estadísticas.
  • Conocimiento de Minitab.
  • Conocimiento de Aspen Process Control u otras herramientas de simulación, modelado y control de procesos.

Competencias

  • Liderazgo técnico e influencia organizacional.
  • Pensamiento crítico y analítico.
  • Resolución de problemas complejos.
  • Administración efectiva de proyectos.
  • Toma de decisiones basada en datos.
  • Capacidad para liderar equipos multidisciplinarios.
  • Comunicación efectiva a todos los niveles de la organización.
  • Orientación a resultados y mejora continua.
  • Capacidad para gestionar múltiples prioridades simultáneamente.

Idiomas

title: Research Associate Biophysics / Protein Science

What You’ll Do:

Who You Are:

If you’ve read this far, then chances are you’ve got a curious mind—just like us. So, what are you waiting for? Take the leap and apply today. We can’t wait to see where your curiosity leads you—and how it will shape the future of Evotec.

description:
SECR Assigner

Description -

Job Summary
The SECR Assigner is responsible for the intake, review, classification, and assignment of customer complaints and escalations to the appropriate resolution teams. This role serves as the first point of operational review, helping ensure that cases are routed accurately, prioritized appropriately, and actioned within established service level expectations. The role supports operational efficiency, timely resolution, reduced routing rework, and stronger complaint-handling outcomes through disciplined queue management and clear communication.

Beyond core assignment responsibilities, this position is expected to operate as a subject matter expert within the intake process, providing guidance on assignment criteria, monitoring operational trends, identifying process improvement opportunities, and supporting knowledge management initiatives. The Assigner is expected to maintain awareness of business, policy, and process changes, proactively communicate updates to stakeholders, and contribute to the continuous improvement of complaint handling operations.


Responsibilities

Intake & Assignment Management

  • Review incoming complaints, escalations, and service requests from assigned intake channels.
  • Assess available case information and determine the appropriate routing path.
  • Assign cases to the correct resolution team, owner, or business group.
  • Ensure incoming cases are reviewed and routed within established turnaround expectations.
  • Monitor assignment queues and maintain workflow continuity.

Quality & Accuracy

  • Apply assignment guidelines consistently and accurately.
  • Minimize reassignment caused by incorrect routing decisions.
  • Validate case information before assignment to reduce downstream delays and avoidable rework.
  • Escalate unclear, sensitive, or high-risk situations to leadership for review.

title: Senior Analyst, Strategic Analytics
location: 1720 W Rio Salado Pkwy Tempe, AZ 85281
description:
What’s Under the Hood

DriveTime Family of Brands includes in-house financing and servicing through Bridgecrest, which is one of the country’s leading financial servicing providers. Bridgecrest services roughly $25+ billion in finance receivables for DriveTime and other third parties. We service auto loans across a wide credit spectrum with the intent of creating a strong path to vehicle ownership for our customers.

That’s Nice, But What’s the Job?

This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas or who need sponsorship now or in the future are not eligible for hire at this time.

In long, our Senior Analyst , Strategic Analytics are responsible for

  • Innovate on existing products and processes while using emerging technologies and data analysis to identify new opportunities to improve customer experience and profitability in our ancillary products division.
  • Create in-depth analyses, collaborate with stakeholders, and leverage resources skillfully to capitalize on those new opportunities
  • Create, maintain, and automate reporting to help partner teams produce value-add strategies and optimize their business segment.
  • Demonstrate strong communication skills in making recommendations to senior executives across DriveTime’s family of companies.
  • Constructing in-depth quantitative analysis by processing, manipulating, and studying large datasets by leveraging strong Excel skills and coding languages such as SQL, Snowflake, and R.
  • Designing, developing, testing, and implementing new products and solutions.
  • Effectively communicating with concise insights and/or visualizations utilizing software such as Tableau while partnering collaboratively with colleagues and senior leaders in DriveTime.
  • Being self-driven and able to take initiative to further the success of the business.

So What Kind of Folks Are We Looking for?

  • Killer analytical and reporting abilities. You’ll need the capability to analyze data and in return, prepare timely reports on your findings.
  • A mind for the details. Okay we know “detail-oriented” is on about every job description – but we really mean it!
  • Intellectual curiosity. Why? What? How? Do you find yourself always wanting to learn more and broaden your knowledge base? If so, this could be the role for you.
  • Passionate and goal oriented. We are looking for someone that is enthusiastic about their work and is passionate about not only meeting their goals but exceeding them.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills.

The Specifics.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, statistics, engineering, computer information systems or other STEM field.
  • 3+ years of experience in data, financial, and/or strategic analytics.
  • Experience using analysis to create value-added strategies and make recommendations to the business to improve organizational performance
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills, collaborative teamwork, intellectual horsepower, curiosity, initiative, and attention to detail.
  • Strong statistical skills and experience focused on business decision making and problem solving.
  • Experience managing multiple project streams.
  • Demonstrated skill in SQL/Snowflake and extensive experience developing analysis in Excel

So What About the Perks? Perks matter

  • We take a hybrid work approach, finding balance between the benefits of in-person and work-from-home environments. This position has an on-site expectation of a minimum of three days a week.
  • Medical, dental, and vision, oh my! DriveTime Family of Brands covers a sizable amount of insurance premiums to ensure our employees receive top-tier healthcare coverage.
  • But Wait, There’s More. 401(K), Company paid life insurance policy, short and long-term disability coverage to name a few.
  • Growth Opportunities. You grow, I grow, we all grow! But seriously, DriveTime Family of Brands is committed to providing its employees with every opportunity to grow professionally with roughly over 1,000 employees promoted year over year.
  • Tuition Reimbursement. We’re as passionate about your professional development as you are. With that, we’ll put our money where our mouth is.
  • Wellness Program. Health is wealth! This program includes self-guided coaching and journeys, cash incentives and discounts on your medical premiums through engaging in fun activities!
  • Gratitude is Green. We offer competitive pay across the organization, because, well… money matters!
  • In-House Gym. We want our employees to be the best versions of themselves. So come early, take a break in your day or finish strong with a workout!
  • Give Us a Reason (or not), and We’ll Celebrate. Regardless of whether there is a holiday or not, we are finding ways to kick back and enjoy each other’s company outside of day-to-day work.
  • Smart-Casual Dress. Come dressed in jeans (you’ll fit right in with the rest of us).
  • Paid Time Off. Not just lip service: we work hard, to play hard! Paid time off includes (for all full-time roles) wellness days, holidays, and good ole' fashioned YOU time! For our Part-timers, don't fear you get some time too...vacation time is available - the more you work, the more you earn!

Anything Else? Absolutely.

DriveTime Family of Brands is Great Place to Work Certified! And get this: 90% of our rockstar employees say they feel right at home here. We could spend a lot of time having you read about ALL our awards, but we’ll save time (and practice some humility) just naming a few others; Comparably Awards: Best Company for Diversity, Best Company Culture and Best Company Leadership, oh and don’t forget Phoenix Business Journal Healthiest Employers (okay, we’ll stop there)!

Hiring is contingent upon successful completion of our background and drug screening process. DriveTime is a drug-free, tobacco-free workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer.


And when it comes to hiring, we don't just look for the right person for the job, we seek out the right person for DriveTime. Buckle up for plenty of opportunities to grow in a professional, fun, and high-energy environment!

title: Social Services Designee (with SSD certification) Full-Time
description:
Social Worker or Social Services Designee with SSD certification
Reports to: Administrator.
Position Status: Full-time.
Hours of Operation: The hours will be set by the Administrator; does include evenings and weekends as necessary.
Job Summary: The Social Worker’s primary function is to provide residents and families with the psychosocial support needed to cope with chronic, acute, or terminal illnesses. Duties include advising family care givers, providing education to residents and counseling, and making referrals for other services. In addition, this position coordinates and leads care plan meetings designed to promote health and address barriers to healthcare.
Essential Functions / Duties:
  • Coordinate, participate, and facilitate care plan meetings.
  • Explain resident’s rights to residents and their representatives.
  • Develop one-on-one relationships with residents and families as needed for counseling.
  • Meet with residents and families to discuss their feelings about death or dying and other emotional, mental, environmental or physical limitations.
  • Document interactions with resident and/or family in the assessment and care plan as required by state standards.
  • Assess and document the social and emotional needs of residents.
  • Responsible for completing the social service portion of the MDS within 14 days of resident’s admission to the facility.
  • Document the social care component of the Comprehensive Care Plan for each resident as identified by the interdisciplinary team within 7 days of completion of the MDS.
  • Participate in the admission of residents; understand and implement pre-admissions screening process.
  • Responsible for the completion of discharge plan in accordance with facility discharge policy.
  • Act as a liaison with social, health, and community agencies.
  • Refer residents to social, health, and community agencies and ensure documentation is in the resident’s record concerning the results of such referrals.
  • Coordinate family and community resources as needed to solve financial needs and promote emotional security.
  • Comply with federal, state, and company policies, procedures, and regulations.
  • Operate computers programmed with software needed to record, store, and analyze resident information; operate copy/fax/printer machines to send documents and produce documents.
  • Perform other related duties as directed by the Administrator.
  • Please refer to the Physical and Other Requirements section for abilities that are essential as they relate to the ability to do duties listed above.
Education and Experiences: Prior experience in a similar working environment is preferred, but not a requirement of the position. This position requires a degree from an approved Social Work program (bachelors or masters) and be licensed by the Kansas Board of Behavioral Sciences.
Abilities: The successful candidate will have a poised, professional demeanor, and a positive attitude. They will be resourceful and have the ability to take the initiative in a changing workplace and adapt to varying requirements and needs. Specific abilities include:
  • Ability to understand, observe, and enforce infection control proce­dures related to facility services.
  • Ability to observe all facility safety policies and procedures.
  • Ability to understand and recognize potential physical, chemical, and electrical hazards and take immediate corrective action as appropriate.
  • Ability to understand and enforce the Exposure Control Plan as this position risks occupational exposure to blood borne patho­gens and other infectious material as an essential function of the job.
  • Ability to safeguard the privacy of Residents’ health information.
  • Ability to speak and read English, and follow oral and written directions.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with the public, residents, and staff.
  • Ability to use computers; the ability to use the designated facility computer system (or systems) at a proficient level.
  • Ability to perform other related duties as directed by administration.
  • Must attend staff meetings, in-service classes, and committee meetings as assigned or required.
Physical and Other Requirements: Primarily this position operates in a professional office environment and routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets, and fax machines. In addition, this position interacts with residents, family members, staff, etc., under all conditions and circumstances and must be constantly alert for resident safety. This position is also subject to exposure to infectious diseases, conditions, etc., including the Hepatitis B viruses.
This position requires the following abilities as essential to for the position:
  • Ability to stand, stoop, crouch, kneel, balance, finger, grasp, push, pull, reach, or walk.
  • Ability to lift objects from a lower to higher posi­tion or moving objects along a horizontal level but from position to position. This includes lifting and carrying weights up to 25 pounds.
  • Ability to exert force upon an object in order to draw, drag or tug objects toward the source of the force in a sustained motion.

IT Security Analyst II


The IT Security Analyst II serves as the organization’s primary internal coordinator for cybersecurity procedures, monitoring, reporting, and continuous improvement.

description:

Job Description

Essential Functions and Job Responsibilities:

  • Mammography Technologist must follow physicians’ orders precisely and conform to regulations concerning the use of radiation to protect themselves, their patients, and their coworkers from unnecessary exposure.

  • Verify proper patient identification on the study and route it PACS.

  • Maintains a daily log of patients seen.

  • Operate the equipment to produce high quality images.

  • Obtains essential information from patients, medical records, and previous scans for clinical correlation.

  • Prepare and assist patients for Mammographic imaging as requested by a physician.

  • Provide patient care with dignity and respect for the individual.

  • Educate patients about the procedures to be performed.

  • Obtain optimum quality images through employment of proper anatomical positioning, and other required techniques in accordance with the protocols designed by the radiologists.

  • Observe and follow safety procedures to include radiation protection and universal precautions.

  • Follow proper Quality assurance by performing daily check and weekly QA.

  • Complete all documentation when performing Quality Assurance.

  • Must be able to work independently and demonstrate flexibility in work assignments.

  • Demonstrate commitment of total quality management and the tenets of service excellence by acting in accordance with the organizational mission at all times.

  • Keep familiar with changes regarding technology and safety for self, patients, and visitors.

  • Process studies onto CD or Film format for patient study requests while maintaining proper HIPPA compliance.

  • Maintain cleanliness of equipment and working area.

  • Maintain familiarity of the emergency drugs and equipment's location.

  • Maintain familiarity with the departments booking, scheduling, duplication, and PACS systems.

  • Maintain professional and technical knowledge through training and fulfillment of continuing education requirements.

  • Ability to maintain a great knowledge in human anatomy and cross section anatomy, proper positioning skills, and appropriate utilization of protocols and scanning techniques.

  • High knowledge with variety of routine procedures and applications.

  • Practices regulatory standards of MQSA and ACR.

  • Ability to maintain continuing education credits and professional licenses required by the Connecticut State Department of Health, Bureau of Environmental Protection and The American Registry of Radiologic Technologists.

  • Candidates will be cross trained upon hire to perform any applicable modalities to meet department needs

  • Promote and follow WMG policies, rules, and regulations.

  • Execution of related duties as necessary or as assigned.

Required Qualifications:

  • Connecticut State License and ARRT Certification with Mammography modality.

  • Maintaining superior diagnostic imaging in accordance with standardized procedures.

  • Excellent patient and people skills.

  • Ability to maintain a great knowledge in human anatomy and cross section anatomy, proper positioning skills and appropriate utilization of protocols and scanning techniques.

  • High knowledge with variety of routine procedures and applications.

  • Ability to maintain continuing education credits and professional licenses required by the New York State Department of Health, Bureau of Environmental Protection and The American Registry of Radiologic Technologists.

title: Operations Executive
description:
Job Title

Operations Executive

Job Description Summary

Executive Summary :
The Operations Executive role is a hands-on IT operations and support position responsible for ensuring smooth technology services, asset management, vendor coordination, and end-user support across the Singapore market. The position reports to the Territory Manager (TM) and serves as both an operational coordinator and technical support resource, including acting as backup leadership for site services when required.

Key Purpose:
The role supports the IT function by managing technology assets, procurement, telecommunications services, vendors, user training, and incident resolution. It also provides second-line technical support, assists with IT projects, and ensures compliance with service management processes and service level agreements (SLAs).

Primary Areas of Responsibility:
IT Asset & Procurement Management: Oversee asset inventories, audits, procurement activities, device deployment, and disposal processes.
Vendor & Telecommunications Management: Coordinate with local vendors, internet service providers, and telecommunications providers while managing billing and procurement activities.
End-User Technology Support: Provide desktop, mobile device, conferencing, and audio-visual support, including troubleshooting hardware, software, network, and access-related issues.
Service & Incident Management: Manage requests and incidents through ServiceNow, maintain documentation, ensure SLA compliance, and escalate issues appropriately.
Technology Training & Adoption: Deliver onboarding sessions, user training, and technology adoption programs to improve employee productivity and reduce recurring issues.
Project Support: Participate in testing, office moves, infrastructure refreshes, software deployments, and other IT initiatives.
Leadership Support: Assist in managing Site Services Technicians and local IT Champions during the Territory Manager's absence.

Success Factors:
The ideal candidate combines strong technical support capabilities with operational coordination, customer service excellence, and stakeholder management skills. They must be comfortable working independently, supporting executives, managing multiple priorities, and collaborating with global IT teams, vendors, and business users.

Key Qualifications:
Diploma/Degree in Computing or related field (or equivalent experience).
At least 5 years' experience in a corporate IT environment.
Knowledge of IT service management, asset management, project support, and incident management processes.
Proficiency in Windows OS, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Teams, Active Directory, Intune, Azure fundamentals, and ServiceNow or similar ticketing systems.
Strong communication, customer service, analytical, problem-solving, and time-management skills.
ITIL Foundation certification and technical certifications are advantageous.
Executive Assessment

This position is best described as an IT Operations and End-User Services role with responsibility across asset lifecycle management, procurement, vendor relations, telecommunications, technical support, and user enablement. The role requires a blend of technical expertise (approximately 40%), operational/vendor management (50%), and people coordination/leadership support (10%), making it well suited for an experienced IT professional who is capable of both operational execution and frontline business support.

description:
RaceTrac Company Overview

Job Description:

The Warehouse Associate is responsible for supporting the daily functions of the RaceTrac warehouse. This individual works to ensure quality orders are processed and shipped to the designated locations in a timely fashion. This position requires working until end-of-shift until all product is loaded onto trucks in a safe and efficient manner. Working weekends and holidays are required in order to successfully fulfill store orders. Job requires working in areas with temperature and humidity variations based on different work environments (Dry, Cooler, & Freezer).

Responsibilities:

Carries out daily warehouse tasks to ultimately support an efficient and effective warehouse. These tasks include, but are not limited to:

  • Using WMS unit technology to pick product within various warehouse environments of fluctuating temperatures, including Dry, Cooler, and Freezer (up to -8) areas for the store orders
  • Stacking product on pallets in accordance with proper selecting procedures
  • Operates an electric/ manual pallet jack and/or forklift to transport products
  • Maintains and safely operates all assigned equipment, including but not limited to pallet jack, WMS unit technology, and personal protective equipment. Performs pre- and post-trip inspections and safely operates all mechanical equipment.
  • Code dating product
  • Cleaning the warehouse and associated equipment
  • Staging product in designated locations for shipping purposes
  • Loading product from designated locations onto delivery trucks
  • Labeling totes with routing information
  • Shrink-wrapping product onto pallets
  • Baling cardboard and disposing of garbage
  • Sorting totes and trays
  • Adhering to all safety regulations, including both food and warehouse safety regulations, and immediately advises management of any unsafe conditions
  • Safely and efficiently receive product from vendors
  • Put received product into designated location in the warehouse




Physical Requirements/ Expectations (Describes the physical; requirements necessary to perform the essential duties of the role e.g. sitting, standing lifting, travel or other job-related activities)

  • Ability to lift, carry, push, or pull up to 75 pounds regularly throughout the shift.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and twist for extended periods of time with minimal breaks.
  • Ability to reach up to 72 inches to retrieve and stack product.
  • Ability to work in environments with temperature variations, including Dry, Cooler, and Freezer areas (as low as –8°F).
  • Ability to operate warehouse equipment such as pallet jacks and forklifts safely and efficiently.
  • Ability to work at a sustained, fast pace for the duration of the shift.
  • Ability to work varying schedules, including weekends and holidays, as business needs require.

Qualifications:

  • 1+ years relevant experience required
  • Knowledge of warehouse operations a plus
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel and Access required
  • Highschool Diploma/ GED
  • Has the ability to lift up to 75 pounds; frequently reach up to 72 inches, and repeatedly bends, stands, and reaches while operating a pallet jack and/or forklift, retrieving items from lower shelf areas, with no or infrequent breaks

title: Associate Service Consultant
description:
Where Ambition Meets Innovation

Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.

Job Overview:

The Associate Service Consultant-Estate Team serves as a subject matter expert for advisors, clients, and internal business partners on the inheritance and divorce process, assisting our clients with the distribution of assets to beneficiaries who are inheriting an account from an LPL client. Responsibilities for this role include taking inbound calls from our advisors, clients, and internal partners focused on resolving estate and divorce inquiries related to an LPL account. In addition to phone calls, service consultants also spend time reviewing and processing documents and paperwork submitted by advisors and clients to facilitate the distribution of assets to named beneficiaries from an LPL account. This requires great attention to detail, and may involve reviewing legal documentation, assessing and mitigating risks to the firm, and communicating needs and requirements to complete the distribution process.

This role also handles escalated inquiries and assists with information sharing, as well as coaching and guidance for our advisors on how to navigate the complexities of the inheritance and divorce processes. Our team’s main priority is to create a reliable support system for our advisors so they can easily navigate through estate-related inquiries on behalf of their clients and ultimately grow and strengthen their practice. This role requires a strong customer focus and work ethic to provide top-tier service experience.

Additionally, the Cash Management Operations department offers opportunities to participate and contribute to team projects and training that supports your career development and advancement.

Responsibilities:

  • Providing outstanding service through phone support with complex inheritance/divorce-related issues via an inbound call center environment, by taking ownership of each inquiry as the main point of contact and providing “First Call Resolution” when possible.
  • Taking ownership and following through with complex and escalated cases that result in follow-up calls and processing. Ensuring that requirements are being accurately communicated and answering questions related to the inheritance process.
  • Use excellent decision making and communication skills to process estate and divorce claims through to completion; this includes reviewing paperwork to ensure that documents comply with regulatory requirements and department standards for distribution, processing paperwork received accurately to mitigate risk to the firm.
  • Communicating in an empathetic and professional manner due to the sensitive nature of Estate and Divorce situations.
  • Reviewing documentation such as letters of testamentary, trust agreements, Qualified Domestic Relations Order, divorce decrees, and other estate-related paperwork as it pertains to both death and divorce situations.
  • Keeping apprised of and promoting new processes and controls; provide feedback and process improvements to drive the business forward.
  • Contributing to a team environment by demonstrating the ability to interact, support and engage with coworkers to achieve team and department goals.

What are we looking for?

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.

LPL Financial Holdings Inc. description:

Commensurate

Job Description

Tarleton State University, a distinguished Doctoral National Comprehensive University, invites applications for the position of Crisis Counselor - Advocate in the Department of Student Counseling Services. As part of a vibrant academic community dedicated to excellence in teaching, research, and service, this role offers the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to a university that values innovation, collaboration, and inclusive growth. Join us in advancing knowledge and transforming lives—on campus and beyond. Tarleton State University continues to grow its impact across Texas, with four distinct campuses located in Stephenville, Fort Worth, RELLIS-Bryan and Waco, along with a robust online community that extends our reach even further.

At the heart of it all is Stephenville, where Tarleton State offers a dynamic environment for faculty and staff. From a lively live music scene and numerous local festivals to rich traditions rooted in the surrounding community, Stephenville provides a vibrant and welcoming atmosphere.

No matter where you're located—on campus or online—you are part of a mission that transforms lives and makes a difference across the state of Texas and beyond.

________________________________________________________________________

Important Immigration Information:

A Presidential proclamation issued on September 19, 2025, imposes a $100,000 fee on new H-1B petitions filed after September 21, 2025. Please be advised that Tarleton State University will NOT pay this fee. Therefore, if you need immigration sponsorship for your employment, we recommend that you consult with your private immigration counsel at your own expense to ascertain whether your current immigration status would make a potential offer of employment from Tarleton State University subject to this fee.

In addition, on January 27, 2026, Texas Governor Abbot issued a moratorium on the filing of any new H-1B unless approved by the Texas Workforce Commission. Accordingly, if you will now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status this moratorium may affect our ability to employ you should you be selected as the final candidate.

________________________________________________________________________



Under the leadership of the Director of Student Counseling Services (SCS), the Crisis Counselor - Advocate provides confidential, comprehensive services to students through SCS as part of the Crisis, Advocacy, and Outreach team. The primary focus of this role is mental health crisis response and support, while also completing required advocacy training in compliance with state requirements and providing advocacy services to students as needed. The position contributes to education initiatives related to violence prevention and mental health and wellness, and may shift between crisis response and advocacy functions based on departmental needs. The Crisis Counselor – Advocate position is designed to allow for flexible scheduling and service delivery as needed to support the priorities of leadership and the evolving needs of the campus community. This position reports directly to the Assistant Director for SCS.

This is an in-office position located in Stephenville, Texas. Standard work hours are Monday, Thursday, and Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM, and Tuesday and Wednesday from 10 AM to 7 PM, to provide after-hours coverage and availability based out of Residence Halls. The role is partially mobile to allow for meetings with students, faculty, staff, and/or community members, and may include remote work when directed by leadership. Occasional travel to the Fort Worth campus, conferences, after-hours outreach, and weekend support for university events will be required.


Responsibilities

Direct Client Support: Provide risk assessment, crisis management, and brief treatment services for students seeking help for emotional and behavioral concerns. Provide crisis follow-up appointments, transition planning for students accessing or leaving inpatient care, and support accessing post-crisis / ongoing care either through SCS or through another appropriate avenue. Support advocacy services when crisis needs are lower including providing options, referrals, and information to students who experience crime, violence, or abuse. Provide emergency assistance in the immediate aftermath of violence and related follow-up services. Provide education to survivors on their rights and responsibilities.

Indirect Advocacy & Crisis Support: Provide consultation to faculty, staff, and students. Coordinate care and services, which may include coordination with campus departments and / or local agencies and accompaniment to appointments on or off-campus. Serve on appropriate on and off-campus committees. Liaison with Dean of Students Office, CARE team, campus and community law enforcement and others as appropriate to support student victims and students experiencing crises.

Data collection and reporting: Keep appropriate records; collect and share de-identified aggregate data as appropriate with campus and community stakeholders including Title IX and Clery committees, community Sexual Assault Response Team, community High Risk Domestic Violence Task Force, etc.

Case Management & Consultation: Provides timely clinical documentation of counseling services in accordance with Texas Behavioral Health Executive Council (BHEC) licensure requirements and SCS policies. Participates in clinical consultation and staffing activities and provides mentoring and support to undergraduate and graduate staff / interns.


Performs other duties as assigned, including participation in recurring campus initiatives supporting the Division of Student Engagement and Success and the University as a whole, such as Duck Camps, Transition Week, and Commencement. Responsibilities related to advocacy and crisis response may require additional evening and weekend availability.


Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Ability to remain calm and respond effectively in crisis and emergency situations, including those involving graphic or sensitive circumstances. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to maintain strict confidentiality, prioritize competing demands, and remain organized and detail-oriented. Demonstrated ability to work respectfully with individuals from varied backgrounds and experiences while upholding client dignity.

Must maintain appropriate Texas licensure in good standing and comply with all applicable laws, regulations, ethical standards, and professional conduct requirements established by BHEC, the State of Texas, and Tarleton State University as a condition of continued employment. Employees must also successfully complete all required background screenings in accordance with university policies and complete required advocacy training in compliance with state requirements.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Full licensure preferred. Experience in survivor advocacy and educational outreach, with demonstrated knowledge of Title IX, the Violence Against Women Act (VAWA), the Clery Act, and related federal guidance, as well as criminal and civil law enforcement and court processes. Experience working with college students in a higher education setting is strongly preferred, along with familiarity with on- and off-campus support resources and reporting options. Crisis response experience is preferred.

Required Education and Experience:

To be qualified as a Professional Counselor I:

  • Master’s or doctoral degree in counseling, psychology, social work, or a related field.
  • Must hold a provisional clinical license (e.g., LPC-Associate, LMFT-Associate, LMSW) or obtain one within one year of hire.
  • Employees holding a provisional license must obtain full licensure within the timeframe required by the Texas Behavioral Health Executive Council (BHEC) and remain in compliance with Student Counseling Services standards to maintain eligibility for continued employment.

Proposed Salary Range for Professional Counselor I: $49,000 to $68,330.50


To be qualified as a Professional Counselor II:

  • Master’s or doctoral degree in counseling, psychology, social work, or a related field.
  • Minimum of two years of related professional experience.
  • Must hold a current, unrestricted Texas license as a Licensed Psychologist (LP), Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC), Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT), or Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW), and maintain the license in good standing with BHEC as a condition of continued employment.

Proposed Salary Range for Professional Counselor II: $53,745 to $76,321


Position level (I or II) will be determined by the candidate's qualifications and professional experience.


All clinical staff must maintain appropriate Texas licensure in good standing and comply with all applicable laws, regulations, ethical standards, and professional conduct requirements established by BHEC, the State of Texas, and Tarleton State University as a condition of continued employment. Employees must also successfully complete all required background screenings in accordance with university policies and procedures.

      • As-is architecture documentation
      • To-be architecture and detailed engineering designs
      • Implementation and migration plans
DESIRED SKILLS
  • Observability and monitoring tools (logging, metrics, tracing)
  • Zero Trust and modern security architectures
  • Data analytics, AI/ML platform exposure
  • Experience supporting regulated or mission-critical environments
  • Relevant certifications (cloud, systems, security, or architecture)

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Perform hands-on systems engineering across network, compute, storage, operating systems, middleware, databases, and applications

    • DevOps / DevSecOps Engineers

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

Als verkoper ga je aan de slag in de Media Markt en voor de grote merken Samsung of Microsoft. In de MediaMarkt werk je binnen jouw eigen shop-in-shop. Enthousiast geworden over deze bijbaan en ben jij er helemaal klaar voor om aan de slag te gaan als promotor voor Samsung en of Microsoft? Solliciteer dan via de link. Daarna kun je het volgende verwachten:

  3. Je neemt deel aan de volledig betaalde introductiedagen en training.

Producttraining:

Voordat je van start kunt gaan in de winkel volg je een training. Deze training, verdeeld over twee volledig betaalde werkdagen vinden plaats in oktober. Tijdens deze dagen wordt je getraind in productkennis en verkoopvaardigheden. De training is een belangrijk onderdeel van je inwerkproces en is essentieel om met de werkzaamheden te starten.

Werken bij CPM Benelux:

Bij CPM Benelux draait alles om sales en merkbeleving. Wij werken samen met toonaangevende merken in consumentenelektronica en zorgen dat hun producten tot leven komen in de winkel. CPM Benelux geeft jou de kans om namens topmerken in de MediaMarkt te werken, terwijl jij deel uitmaakt van een internationaal fieldmarketingbureau met volop trainingen, doorgroeimogelijkheden en een team van collega’s dat samen gaat voor resultaat!

title: Butikkmedarbeider
description:
Motiveres du av å skape gode kundeopplevelser, jobbe med salg og bruke ditt kreative blikk?

Til vår butikk på Sandvika søker vi en butikkmedarbeider med godt humør som har interesse for salg og bildeprodukter.


Kvalifikasjoner og profil

Vi ser etter deg som har interesse for bilder, interiør og kreative produkter, og som synes det er gøy å hjelpe andre med å finne løsninger som betyr noe for dem. Du vil jobbe som tilkallingsvikar, og vii ser derfor etter deg som er fleksibel, og som har tid og lyst til å jobbe ekstra i den travle julesesongen.

Du har gjerne erfaring fra salg eller service, men det er ikke et krav. Det viktigste for oss er at du har et genuint engasjement, en positiv innstilling og et ønske om å lære og utvikle deg. Har du interesse for våre produkter og et ønske om å gjøre en forskjell for kundene våre, tror vi du vil passe godt inn hos oss.


Arbeidsoppgaver

CEWE Japan Photo Sandvika er en rendyrket bildebutikk som spesialiserer seg på våre prisvinnende produkter. Arbeidet vil bestå i å yte topp service og å selge fotoprodukter som vår prisvinnende CEWE FOTOBOK, CEWE veggbilder (bildeforstørrelser, lerret, akryltrykk), rammer, bilder og andre fotoprodukter. Interesse for interiør og bilder er derfor en fordel.


Som butikkmedarbeider vil du også ta del i den daglige driften av butikken. Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet være salg og kundebehandling, mottak og utlevering av kundeordrer, betjening av kasse, varepåfylling og rydding. Du vil også bidra til at butikken alltid fremstår innbydende og inspirerende, blant annet gjennom oppfølging av kampanjer, vareeksponering og utstillinger.


Har du prøvd å lage en CEWE fotobok selv og kunne tenke deg å hjelpe andre med å få noe ut av deres digitale bilder og gi gleden av produktene videre?

Vi håper du ønsker å bidra til at flotte blinkskudd ikke blir liggende på mobilen eller bortgjemt på en harddisk. Vi tror at ett bilde på veggen er bedre enn 10 på mobilen, og at gode minner gjør seg aller best i en personlig og unik CEWE FOTOBOK.




Vi tilbyr

  • Et hyggelig arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte og dyktige kollegaer
  • Mulighet for videre utvikling og interne karrieremuligheter
  • Gode personalrabatter på våre produkter
  • Spennende produkter i Nordens ledende kjede innenfor fotoutstyr og bildeprodukter
  • Lønn etter avtale

Oppstart: Snarest!


Vi gleder oss til å lese søknaden din, og ber om at du legger ved både CV og søknadsbrev.


CEWE-merket har siden 1961 stått for innovasjon, kreativitet og fotoprodukter av høy kvalitet som begeistrer mennesker over hele Europa.

Klar til å ta neste steg? Vi gleder oss til å høre din historie.

Bli med i teamet vårt og form fremtiden sammen med oss

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Harvest Group is an integrated commerce agency that helps high-growth consumer brands win in today's complex retail landscape. Since 2006, we've partnered with some of the world's most recognized brands to navigate the intersection of in-store and digital commerce, retail media, and social platforms across leading retailers including Walmart, Sam's Club, Target, Amazon, Costco, and Kroger.

What sets Harvest Group apart is our connected approach. By aligning strategy, execution, and insights across every stage of the retail journey, and powering that work through our proprietary technology platform, we help brands create sustainable growth in an increasingly dynamic marketplace.

But our success starts with our people.

At Harvest Group, our culture and values shape how we work, serve our clients, and support one another. We believe in building meaningful relationships, pursuing excellence with humility, and creating an environment where talented individuals can do their best work while continuing to grow professionally and personally.

Our Values

Integrity – Doing what is right in all things
Relationship – Pursuing depth, trust, and collaboration
Service – Laboring for others with humility and care
Excellence – Delivering extraordinary performance and results with humility
Journey – Embracing our past and planning for our future with faith
Harvest Group Tunisia is the third branch of the Harvest Group company, which opened in 2016. Its main responsibilities are:

Data reporting and insights: standardized and optimized reports and performance trackers for U.S. teams and clients
Analytical storytelling: leveraging data to tell a compelling story
Software development: supporting the dynamic needs of our team
Tool creation: building easy-to-use solutions to complex data problems
Data operations and cloud data management: building and maintaining data pipelines from source systems to cloud data storage, and retrieving data from a wide variety of sources
About the Role

The Senior Data Engineer is a technical leader responsible for the architecture, quality, and reliability of the data pipelines and models within an assigned data product team, supporting retail partners including Walmart, Sam's Club, Target, Amazon, Costco, and Kroger. This role owns major subsystems of the data platform, designs solutions that span multiple data domains, and sets the engineering standards the team follows. The Senior Data Engineer applies deep expertise in data architecture and data operations alongside the ability to mentor others, influence the roadmap, and drive continuous improvement. This role serves as the primary technical authority on the team, partnering with product managers, analysts, and platform engineers to deliver data products that meet Harvest Group's standards for quality, performance, and reliability.

What You'll Do

Design and own the data architecture for complex, multi-domain data products.
Review and evolve warehouse structures, including data models, schemas, and naming and metadata conventions, to ensure clear business semantics and consistent definitions.
Architect and maintain semantic and metadata layers that enable governed, scalable access to data for business users and analytics tools.
Partner with business stakeholders to understand key questions, decisions, and workflows, then translate those needs into durable data structures and models.
Lead technical design reviews and backlog refinement within Agile/Scrum delivery, establishing architecture patterns the team adopts.
Set and enforce engineering quality standards: testing strategies, code review expectations, and documentation norms.
Optimize cloud warehouse performance: query tuning, warehouse sizing, materialization strategies, and cost management.
Build advanced transformation patterns: custom macros, reusable packages, and complex incremental and snapshot strategies.
Design orchestration architectures for reliability, observability, and SLA compliance.
Stand up proofs of concept to evaluate new data patterns or approaches, then harden successful designs into production-ready solutions.
Ensure data quality, performance, security, and governance practices are embedded in the solutions the team ships.
Identify systemic data quality issues and implement preventive solutions.
Mentor Data Engineer I and II team members, conducting code reviews and leading technical discussions.
Partner with product managers to translate business strategy into a technical data engineering roadmap.
Collaborate with platform engineering on shared infrastructure and tooling, and contribute to cross-team engineering standards and architecture decision records.
What We're Looking For

Required
5+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or analytics engineering.
Expert SQL skills, including advanced query optimization for cloud data warehouses.
Strong data modeling skills for analytical use cases (dimensional modeling, slowly changing dimensions, data vault).
Deep production experience with a SQL-based transformation framework (dbt preferred).
Experience designing and operating data pipelines at scale with an orchestration platform (Airflow preferred).
Experience working across the full data lifecycle, from raw ingestion to analysis-ready datasets.
Advanced version control and CI/CD practices (Git), including branching strategy and release standards.
Advanced Python for production data engineering workloads.
Track record of mentoring engineers and raising team engineering quality.
Proven ability to take solutions from concept through production with attention to reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Ability to collaborate effectively with U.S.-based teams and clients across time zones.
Ownership mindset with a proactive approach to problem solving and continuous improvement.
Nice to Have.
Experience building or managing semantic layers (dbt Semantic Layer, Looker semantic models, AtScale, Cube, or similar).
Experience building and maintaining shared transformation packages or frameworks.
Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code for data platform resources (Terraform preferred).
Experience with data observability and monitoring platforms.
Background in data governance, metadata management, and access controls.
Deep expertise with CPG or retail data across multiple retailers (Kroger / 84.51, Walmart / Luminate, Nielsen, Circana).
Experience building data structures and pipelines that support AI and LLM applications, including retrieval over both structured and unstructured data.
We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

Please note that we only accept resumes submitted in English.

What you'll be doing


Simplii Financial is a modern, customer-first organization, and great design is one of the most powerful ways we build trust with the people who bank with us. As a Senior Product Designer at Simplii, you play a key role in shaping the future of our digital experiences. You lead the design of complex, customer-facing products and services, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, Accessibility, and business stakeholders to define, design, and deliver meaningful solutions.

You own and drive initiatives from discovery through delivery, leveraging customer insights, research, and data to influence product strategy and create intuitive, high-quality experiences that address real financial challenges for Canadians. Beyond delivering exceptional design work, you help elevate design excellence across teams through mentorship, collaboration, and advocacy for customer-centered design. Your work contributes to the evolution of our products, design systems, and ways of working, ensuring we continue to deliver accessible, innovative, and impactful experiences for our customers.


At CIBC, we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You'll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you'll spend 2-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote.


How you'll succeed

  • Design You lead the design of end-to-end, best-in-class experiences by delivering high-fidelity UI designs, wireframes, prototypes, and other design outputs. You apply systems thinking to solve complex customer and business problems while driving design quality across initiatives.
  • Research and Validation You leverage user research, usability testing, analytics, and customer insights to identify opportunities, validate solutions, and ensure experiences are grounded in real customer needs.
  • Collaboration You partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, Accessibility, and business stakeholders to align on priorities, solve complex challenges, and deliver meaningful customer outcomes.
  • Stakeholder Management You present and clearly communicate design rationale, recommendations, and findings to peers, senior leaders, and cross-functional partners to build alignment, influence decisions, and drive outcomes.
  • Project Management You lead complex initiatives through ambiguity, balancing customer needs, business goals, and technical considerations while delivering against objectives, timelines, and priorities.
  • Data-Driven You leverage analytics, experimentation, customer feedback, and qualitative and quantitative insights to inform strategy, measure success, and continuously improve experiences.
  • Leadership and Mentorship You provide coaching, guidance, and constructive feedback to designers and peers. You contribute to design standards, best practices, and a culture of continuous learning and excellence.
  • Ownership You demonstrate a proactive and strategic mindset, taking accountability for outcomes, driving initiatives forward, and identifying opportunities to improve customer experiences and team effectiveness.
  • Customer Centric You champion customer needs and advocate for exceptional experiences that address Canadians' financial needs while supporting business goals and accessibility standards.

Who you are:

  • You bring 6 or more years of hands-on experience delivering UX/UI projects for digital products and services, influencing product direction, leading complex initiatives, and delivering measurable customer and business outcomes. You have advanced skills in Figma, actively seek innovative solutions, embrace emerging technologies, contribute to scalable design systems, and adapt quickly to evolving tools and trends. A degree or diploma in Design, Computer Science, Engineering, Industrial Design, Business, Psychology, or a related field is an asset.
  • You put the customer first, always. You champion customer needs and advocate for experiences that address real financial challenges for Canadians. Every design decision you make connects back to the person using the product, and you make it harder for teams around you to lose sight of that.
  • You give meaning to data. You enjoy investigating complex problems, synthesizing research and insights, and translating information into clear recommendations that drive customer and business value.
  • You are motivated by collective success. You know that strong collaboration across disciplines leads to better outcomes. You foster inclusive environments where diverse perspectives contribute to innovative solutions.
  • You are research-oriented. You leverage qualitative and quantitative research methods to uncover customer needs, identify opportunities, and validate solutions throughout the product lifecycle.
  • You bring people with you. You mentor others, raise the quality of work around you, and help shape how teams approach design and problem solving through the clarity of your thinking and the consistency of your standards.
  • You are a change advocate. You embrace ambiguity, continuously evolve your thinking and approach, and drive innovation that improves customer experiences, team practices, and business outcomes.
  • Values matter to you. You bring your real self to work and you live our values — trust, teamwork, and accountability.

title: Butler
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

A secluded oasis at the edge of an idyllic lagoon! On the east coast of Mauritius, lapped by turquoise waters perfect for water sports, our relaxing Resort is filled with lush greenery and dramatic views everywhere you turn. Each stylish villa and residence feature its own private garden and pool – just like the home for the Resort’s resident giant tortoises. After a day exploring the Indian Ocean or playing unlimited golf at both our Ernie Els-designed course and Bernhard Langer signature course, unwind at our award-winning Spa and raise a glass at one of our exciting dining venues. Mauritius is teeming with opportunities for your next day’s adventures. This beautiful resort opened in October 2008, and has 90 one-bedroom villas, 1 Presidential Suite, 45 two-to-five-bedroom residential villas, 5 stunning Food and Beverage venues in addition to managing an off-property beach bar/restaurant, an award-winning over water Spa, 2 tennis courts and a fitness center.

About the role

As a Butler, you are the dedicated point of contact in house for our luxury residences guests, anticipating their needs and delivering personalized, seamless experiences throughout their stay. Through discretion, elegance, and attention to detail, you create memorable moments and ensure every stay exceeds expectations.

What you will do

-Anticipate guests' needs and preferences, including dietary requirements, allergies, special occasions, and personal habits, to deliver exceptional and tailored experiences.

-Coordinate every aspect of the guest journey by working closely with all resort departments, ensuring seamless execution of requests, services, and personalized arrangements.

-Conduct villa inspections in coordination with Housekeeping for arrivals, daily servicing, and turndown preparation.

-Take full ownership of and accountability for the assigned residence, always ensuring the highest standards of presentation and guest satisfaction

-Arrange and oversee all guest services, including dining experiences, amenities, laundry, transportation, spa bookings, concierge services, special celebrations, and other bespoke requests.

What you bring

A-levels or college preferred

Previous experience in a similar environment preferred, preferably foreign language skills (Russian, Arabic, German, Chinese)

What we offer:
• Competitive Salary, wages, and a comprehensive benefits package
• Excellent Training and Development opportunities
• Employee Discount for stays at any Four Seasons worldwide
• Complimentary Dry Cleaning for Employee Uniforms
• Complimentary Employee Meals

Schedule & Hours:

Full time

Flexible to work early mornings, days, evenings & week ends

title: Distribution Planner
description:
Distribution Planner

Department: Hydrogen; Supply Chain

Shifts: Vista/Slingerlands and/or Remote( East Coast) and shift is Wed - Sat 9pm to 7am

Overview

Come join our team as it takes the worldwide lead in the green energy revolution. You will get the opportunity to work directly with some of the biggest companies in the world. This is a great opportunity to learn the industry from the ground up.

Position Summary


This position is responsible for monitoring and maintaining the hydrogen logistics network for Plug Power throughout North America. This role requires excellent internal and external communication, organization, and prompt readiness to handle the day-to-day activities required in the Core Duties and Responsibilities listed below. This position is also critical to interface with customer stakeholders and exceed their expectations for service thereby furthering Plug Power's reputation as the leader in hydrogen fuel cell power solutions.


Core Duties and Responsibilities

  • Work closely with Regional Distribution Managers to complete logistical demands and tasks associated with Plug Power’s logistics network
  • Provide Customer Service for future and existing customers via email and phone
  • Hourly telemetry monitoring, data collection and historical usage review and analysis
  • Maintain an internal tracking report of all telemetry levels and customer correspondence
  • Communicate immediate fulfillment status notification and/or delivery issues within the organization to points including logistics management, operations, and customer service, as well as external customers
  • Use company software to accurately determine forecasted customer demand
  • Ability to adjust to customer demand and plan accordingly to ensure customer supply levels are maintained
  • Communicate and document operations, supplier and customer events to share with team
  • Forecast Liquid Hydrogen deliveries originating from Plug Power Plants, and third-party providers
  • Forecast Compressed Hydrogen deliveries originating from Plug Power Plants, and third-party providers
  • Work closely with vendors to oversee sub-contracted Liquid Hydrogen deliveries to maintain fulfillment for Plug clients.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education and Experience

  • Promote a positive team environment
  • Demonstrate a willingness to develop and grow with Plug Power
  • Bachelor’s degree preferably or with 3+ years’ experience in, supply chain, transportation dispatch, demand planning or forecasting
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Strong computer skills and proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and software a plus
  • Role model for high standards of professionalism
  • Results-oriented and driven work style
  • Problem-solver and the ability to prioritize work assignments
  • Able to work well with all levels of Management and Support Staff
  • Ability to function independently and in a team environment
  • Must be attentive to drivers’ needs and respond to emails and all inquiries
  • Must be attentive to all internal emails and Microsoft teams inquiries

Pay Rate:

$23.50 - $34.00

title: Senior Engineering Technician
description:
Senior Engineering Technician - Onsite

Towson, MD


Come build something that matters.

It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. People who care about making things better For Those Who Make The World™. Sound like you? Join our top-notch team of approximately 43,500 diverse and high-performing professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®.


Who We Are
We’re the World’s largest tool company. We design and develop the tools that are used to change the world every day here in our Engineering headquarters in Towson, Maryland. Our design teams are involved with every step of the process bringing these world class products to life. From conducting end user research to identify new needs, designing and prototyping tools to ensure we meet our customers high expectations, to creating robust tests to guarantee the tools we make stand up to the toughest environments, our engineers own every aspect of the process along the way.


The Job

As a Senior Engineering Technician located in Towson MD you will be an

integral part of professional power tools new product development team.


  • Perform hands-on concept development, prototyping, product testing, and data collection.
  • Perform tests, prepare and analyze test results and provide guidance back to product development team.
  • Works closely with manufacturing and suppliers. Utilizes experience and cross-functional interaction to deliver solutions that are innovative, manufacturable, and cost effective.
  • Investigate design issues and test failures and effectively drives corrective actions.
  • Effectively maintains appropriate documentation for work performed.
  • Perform technical tests, analyze results, and provide actionable design advice to engineering teams.
  • Monitor Engineering data against established performance targets, identify trends, and recommend areas for improvement.
  • Stay abreast of emerging technical and process advancements; support the adoption of state-of-the-art practices across the organization.
  • Provide technical consultation to Engineering Support team members, allied teams, and other stakeholders.
  • Work with other Technicians to create best practices.


The Person:

  • 3-5 years related experience
  • Ability to consult and advise teams for decision-making and problem-solving.
  • Advanced ability to navigate complex and ambiguous test requirements from Design Engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated competence in track scheduling.
  • Skilled in using standard electrical and mechanical measuring instruments.
  • Demonstrates foundational product and user knowledge relevant to Stanley Black & Decker’s portfolio.
  • Skill in 2D3D CAD, diagnostics, and electrical/mechanical design.
  • Communicate with openness and respect for differing perspectives
  • Proven ability to influence others to achieve shared goals.

The Details:

You’ll receive a competitive salary and a great benefits plan, including:

  • Medical, dental, life, vision, disability, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, paid time off, and tuition reimbursement in addition to programs & benefits in support of your well-being.
  • Discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and other partner programs.

And More:

We want our company to be a place you’ll want to be – and stay. Being part of our team means you’ll get to:

  • Grow: Be part of our global company with 20+ brands to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths.
  • Learn: Have access to a wealth of learning resources, including our digital learning portal.
  • Belong: Experience an awesome place to work, where we have mutual respect and a great appreciation for a wide range of perspectives and experiences.
  • Give Back: Help us continue to make positive changes locally and globally through volunteerism, giving back, and sustainable business practices.

What’s more, you’ll get that pride that comes from empowering makers, doers, protectors, and everyday heroes all over the world. We’re more than the #1 tools company. More than a driving force in outdoor power equipment. More than a global leader in industrial. We’re visionaries and innovators. As successful as we’ve been in the past, we have so much further to go. That’s where you come in. Join us!


This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship (H1B, OPT/CPT, TN etc).


#LI-Onsite

#LI-BM1


The Salary range for this position is $52,900.00 - $85,100.00


  • This is the lowest to highest annual full-time salary range we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. The salary offered within the range may vary depending on multiple factors including job level, geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, qualifications, experience and in compliance with local wage requirements. Please note that salary is only one component of total rewards at Stanley Black & Decker. ​

  • The salary range listed in this job posting reflects the range for the primary location specified. The salary range may vary for other locations.​

  • The successful candidate may be eligible for annual merit increases. ​

  • Medical, dental, life, vision, disability,401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, paid time off, and tuition reimbursement in addition to programs & benefits in support of your well-being. ​

  • Discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tool sand other partner programs.

We Don’t Just Build The World, We Build Innovative Technology Too.

Joining the Stanley Black & Decker team means working in an innovative, tech-driven and highly collaborative team environment supported by over 43,500 professionals in 60 countries across the globe. Here, you’ll get the unique chance to impact some of the world’s most iconic brands including STANLEY TOOLS, DEWALT, CRAFTSMAN, MAC TOOLS and Black + Decker. Your ideas and solutions have the potential to reach millions of customers as we work together to write the next chapter in our history. Come build with us and take your career to new heights.


Who We Are

We’re the World’s largest tool company. We’re industry visionaries. We’re solving problems and advancing the manufacturing trade through innovative technology and our Industry 4.0 Initiative. We are committed to ensuring our state-of-the-art “smart factory” products and services provide greater quality to our customers & greater environmental and social value to our planet. We are unique in that we have a rich and storied history dating back to 1843, but that hasn't stopped us from evolving into a vibrant, diverse, global growth company.


What You’ll Also Get

Career Opportunity: Career paths aren’t linear here. Being part of our global company with 60+ brands gives you the chance to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths.


Benefits & Perks

You’ll get a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits plan that includes medical, dental, life, vision, wellness program, disability, retirement benefits, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Paid Time Off, including paid vacation, holidays & personal days, and tuition reimbursement. And, of course, discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and products and well as discount programs for many other vendors and partners.


Learning & Development:
Our lifelong learning philosophy means you’ll have access to a wealth of state-of-the-art learning resources, including our Lean Academy and online university (where you can get certificates and specializations from renowned colleges and universities).


Diverse & Inclusive Culture:
We pride ourselves on being an awesome place to work. We respect and embrace differences because that’s how the best work gets done. You’ll find we like to have fun here, too.


Purpose-Driven Company:
You’ll help us continue to make positive changes in the local communities where we work and live as well as in the broader world through volunteerism, giving back and sustainable business practices.

title: Dir Quality Technology
description:
Job Summary

The Director, Quality Technology leads the strategy, roadmap, and execution of technology solutions that support Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs (QARA). This role drives quality systems, data, analytics, and AI initiatives while ensuring regulatory compliance, operational effectiveness, and alignment with enterprise technology strategies.

Job Description

Key responsibilities

  • Own the quality technology roadmap & AI strategy, defining the multi-year plan for the systems that support QARA and sequencing investment against business priorities and regulatory requirements
  • Align the quality technology agenda with the broader enterprise technology strategy, partnering closely with Enterprise IT on architecture, integration, security, and shared platform decisions
  • Lead selection, implementation, and rollout of quality systems, including requirements definition, vendor evaluation, business case development, configuration, data migration, and user adoption, ensuring systems are validated and maintained in a GxP compliant state
  • Own the ongoing health of the quality technology landscape, including system maintenance, performance tracking against defined metrics, enhancement prioritization, and continuous improvement
  • Own the quality data and reporting layer, delivering dashboards and analytics that support trending, management review, and decision making across QARA
  • Lead the master data management team, defining and governing master data standards for products and related quality domains to ensure consistency and integrity across systems.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in the functional area, including 5 years of management experience.
  • Experience leading technology strategy, system implementations, and digital transformation initiatives in a regulated environment.
  • Knowledge of GxP requirements, computerized system validation, data integrity, and quality management systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence senior stakeholders.
  • Strong strategic planning, communication, and change management skills.

Medline Industries, LP, and its subsidiaries, offer a competitive total rewards package, continuing education & training, and tremendous potential with a growing worldwide organization.

For roles where employees work less than 30 hours per week, benefits include 401(k) contributions, paid time off, as well as access to the Employee Assistance Program, Employee Resource Groups and the Employee Service Corp.
