title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Lyten is leading an industrial revolution through Lyten 3D Graphene™, a breakthrough supermaterial unlocking a new generation of products — from lithium–sulfur batteries and energy storage systems to concrete admixtures, lightweight composites, and next-generation sensors that are revolutionizing industries. Together, these innovations are making a massive global improvement and driving real-world impact across energy, mobility, construction, and defense.

At Lyten, we believe the most meaningful careers begin with purpose — and with people who want to make a difference. We’re not just developing advanced supermaterials — we’re about to change the world as we know it, reshaping how energy is stored, how products are built, and how progress is made.

We’re entering an exciting growth phase, scaling production across the U.S. and Europe and expanding our team of engineers, scientists, and innovators.

Apply now to join our team and be part of something bigger than yourself — where collaboration, creativity, and purpose come together to build the technologies that will define the next century.


Job Scope

Responsible for driving the successful development, validation, and industrial deployment of new battery products from concept through mass production. The role acts as the central coordinator between R&D, engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and external partners to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and according to performance targets.

Key Responsibilities

Lead cross-functional projects related to the development and industrialization of new battery products, processes, and manufacturing technologies.

Ensure seamless transition from product design and prototyping to pilot production and full-scale manufacturing.

Establish and maintain detailed project plans, milestones, and risk registers.

Manage project team resource capacity, timeline and prioritization in the matrix organization with line-managers.

Develop and maintain project financial budgets both operational and CapEx.

Drive project governance through regular status reviews and stakeholder reporting.

Facilitate (technical) issue resolution and decision-making across disciplines.

Coordinate production equipment readiness, process qualification, and factory acceptance activities.

Manage industrialization deliverables including capacity planning, PFMEA, control plans, and process validation.



Requirements

Educational background and previous experience required for the role

Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant Engineering discipline (i.e. Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Industrial, Manufacturing, or related field).

5+ Years of experience of working as a technical project manager within automotive/industrial/advanced manufacturing industry.

Experience of working in a multicultural environment (e.g. working in international teams, international projects, etc.)

Proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional development projects, including capital expenditure management.


Qualifications and Experience

Advanced technical knowledge in an industrial relevant manufacturing field.

Certification in a project management framework (i.e. PMI-PMP) is beneficial.

Knowledge about (European) safety regulations like CE compliance (Machine directive, ATEX, low-voltage, pressure directives, RoHs).

Lean SixSigma or DFSS Greenbelt certification is a plus.

Specific skills & Knowledge

Experienced user of project management software (ERP, PLM, Jira, MS Projects, etc).

Experience with industrial equipment, automation systems, and production ramp-up activities.

Fluent in English both written and verbal. (Additional language, i.e. Swedish or German, is a plus)


Personal Success Factors

Highly organized and result driven.

Good analytical skills and the ability to apply logical thinking to resolve faults and issues with appropriate corrections and measures.

A structured approach to problem solving.

Shows grit and determination in finding the best possible solution.

Passionate about technology and in understanding complex problems.

Why Work at Lyten

At Lyten, you’ll be part of a team that’s redefining what’s possible in energy, materials, and manufacturing. We’re not just imagining the future — we’re building it today with breakthrough technologies that are changing how products are made and how industries innovate.

Our people are the heart of that mission. From world-class scientists and engineers to creative problem-solvers in operations, manufacturing, and commercialization, every member of the Lyten team plays a role in turning bold ideas into real-world impact. We believe that the best work happens when you’re doing great things in the world — with people you like. Collaboration, curiosity, and a shared sense of purpose drive everything we do.

What You’ll Find at Lyten

  • A mission that matters: Contribute directly to solving complex challenges in energy, mobility, and materials innovation.

  • Cutting-edge innovation: Work on technologies at the intersection of materials science, energy storage, and advanced manufacturing that strengthen energy security and local supply chains.

  • Extraordinary people: Join a team of talented, friendly, and down-to-earth innovators who support, challenge, and inspire one another every day.

  • Teamwork and culture: Experience a workplace built on trust, respect, and shared success — where collaboration fuels breakthroughs and everyone’s ideas are heard.

  • Global impact: Help scale new materials and energy solutions that reinforce industrial resilience across the U.S. and Europe.

  • Career growth: Be part of a fast-moving company entering a commercial growth phase, with opportunities to lead, learn, and make your mark.

  • Purpose-driven values: Thrive in an environment that celebrates ingenuity, optimism, and meaningful progress — together.

Lyten offers the opportunity to do the most important work of your career — helping build the technologies that will power the next century of innovation.

Join us, and help transform industries, communities, and the planet with friends who share your drive to make a difference.

title: Emergency Medical Technician - Potsdam, NY
description:
Job Title: Emergency Medical Technician
Department: Emergency Services
Location: Potsdam, NY
Hours Per Week: per diem
Schedule: 12 hour variable shift

SUMMARY:

The Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) provides immediate medical care and transport of patients during emergencies, playing a critical role in stabilizing and ensuring safe transport to medical facilities.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Responds to emergency calls, assess patients’ conditions, and determine appropriate medical interventions, coordinating with dispatch as necessary.
  • Safely transport patients to medical facilities, monitoring their condition and providing necessary care during transit.
  • Administer CPR, control bleeding, manage airways, and provide other life-saving measures to stabilize patients.
  • Utilize essential medical equipment such as, but not limited to, defibrillators, oxygen delivery systems.
  • Work closely with paramedics, firefighters, law enforcement, and hospital staff to ensure coordinated patient care reporting nature of injury as indicated.
  • Maintain accurate and detailed patient care reports, documenting assessments, treatments, and patient responses.
  • Ensure the cleanliness and readiness of emergency vehicles and medical equipment.
  • Interpret oral, written and diagnostic form instructions, including calculating weight and volume ratios.
  • Lift and move patients, often in challenging environments, such as extreme terrain or temperatures.
  • Participate in continuous education to stay current with medical protocols and enhance skills.
  • Ability to maintaining composure and professionalism in high-pressure situations.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements (Expanded):

  • Work in a variety of uncontrolled and potentially hazardous environments (indoor/outdoor, inclement weather, confined spaces).
  • Maintain physical readiness to assist in lifting/moving patients using stretchers (up to 250 lbs with partner assist), medical equipment, and gear.
  • Walk, kneel, crawl, and climb over uneven terrain or in emergency conditions.
  • Transport essential medical equipment (e.g., EKG monitor, ALS/med bags) without assistance.
  • Remain calm and focused in high-stress, emotionally charged situations.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • BLS required at hire, If not AHA, must obtain AHA BLS within 3 months of hire
  • Valid NYS Basic EMT
  • Valid Drivers License
  • Heavy Work - Exerting 50 to 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or 25 to 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or 10 to 20 pounds of force constantly to move objects. Requires constant walking, standing or squatting

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Emergency Vehicle Operator Course (EVOC) or equivalent
  • Strong knowledge of medical procedures and emergency care techniques

EDUCATION:

LICENSES / CERTIFICATIONS:

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Drive - Clinical - Roles in this category require frequent driving combined with mobile clinical care across settings such as emergency response, mobile clinics, and home health environments. Staff must repeatedly enter and exit vehicles, occasionally lift and carry equipment weighing up to 100 lbs. or more, and perform care within patients’ homes or other confined, unpredictable, or uncontrolled environments. These positions demand strong fine and gross motor control, firm grasping, and heightened visual and auditory awareness to ensure safe and effective care delivery. Emotional and cognitive demands are substantial due to rapid decision‑making, direct exposure to critical or sensitive situations, and independently managing patient care in the field or home setting. Environmental exposures may include traffic hazards, infectious agents, extreme temperatures, variable home conditions, and hazardous materials. Valid licensure, physical readiness, and flexibility for extended or on‑call schedules are typically required.

For disease specific care programs refer to the program specific requirements of the department for further specifications on experience and educational expectations, including continuing education requirements.

Job Title

Operating Engineer

Job Description Summary

The Engineer I position is a contributing member to the site level Data Center Operations team assigned to one or more of our data center properties reporting directly to the Manager of Facility Engineering. The Engineer I will have experience in mission critical infrastructure, including Generators, UPS Systems, HVAC Systems, Fire/Life Safety Systems, BMS Systems, and CMMS systems. It is expected that the Engineer I candidate has expertise in either electrical work or mechanical work and it would be expected that he/she would be competent in the area of non-expertise. The responsibilities of the Engineer I are: to contribute to the daily site operation, including creation and modification of site operating procedures, contribute to creation of change management tickets, creation of timely incident reporting, site maintenance and repairs/inspections to help ensure client’s data center operations achieve the highest level of availability.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Gain a complete understanding of the following client and site related items:
    • Facility layout and operation of MEP systems and the ability to illustrate site specific system one-lines with good accuracy.
    • Equipment nomenclature standards and equipment locations
    • Facility drawings and equipment specifications
    • Equipment sequence of operations (SOO’s), standard operating procedures (SOP’s), and emergency operating procedures (EOP’s).
    • Customer SLA’s and engineering specific lease obligations critical to data center operations.
    • Facility top 20 EOP’s.
    • BMS alarm functionality, alarm escalation/acknowledgement, and ability to extract data and trends
    • Client event management, event escalation, and incident reporting procedures
    • Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS), including the ability to create, edit, implement, and close change management work orders.
    • Create/edit/resolve/close incident reports following a site incident
    • Maintenance and Operations Standards
    • Client’s Environmental and Occupational Health and Safety standards
  • Gain a complete understanding of all aspects of data center operations including the operation, maintenance and repair of all mission critical equipment and systems supporting a 24x7 data center operation to achieve 100% uptime and 100% compliance with all customer SLAs.
  • Supervision of construction activity and installations as required.
  • Ability to be the executor in the site specific change management processes including the creation of Method of Procedures (MOPs) for low risk preventative maintenance and repairs as well as the oversight of those maintenances as they are carried out.
  • Ability to effectively troubleshoot site mechanical and electrical systems.
  • Ability to respond to unplanned events without immediate supervision.
  • Ability to efficiently complete rounds/inspections and to detect anomalies during those rounds.
  • Develop or improve SOPs for site specific equipment.
  • Gain a good understanding and knowledge of the local customers business and datacenter operation.
  • Support various accreditation initiatives, including, but not limited to, SSAE16, SOC2, ISO 27001, etc. as may be required by client
  • Complete client Critical Awareness Training

Key Competencies:

  • Strong interpersonal, presentation and communication skills. Ability to respond effectively, verbally in writing to sensitive issues, complex inquiries or complaints.
  • Detail Oriented with strong organizational skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook and familiarity with Microsoft Project, Adobe Acrobat, Visio or AutoCad
  • Basic understanding of emergency situations and escalation processes.
  • Strong quantitative and qualitative reasoning skills, with demonstrated ability to determine event root causes, performance shortfalls and required corrective actions.

Important Experience:

  • At least 1 year experience in mission critical facilities operating / engineering or equivalent equipment experience including assets associated with mission critical engineering relevant to the specific site. (UPS, HVAC, generators, fire/life safety systems).
  • Hands-on electrical or mechanical skill and competence in the area of non-expertise (for example, electrical expertise with mechanical competence, or vice-versa).
  • Strong knowledge of energy efficiency principals.
  • Strong knowledge of various UPS Systems and architectures.
  • Strong knowledge of various cooling systems and architectures.
  • Strong understanding of infrastructure redundancy configurations and equipment and their risks (N+1, 2N, ATS/ STS, Failover Scenarios)
  • Strong knowledge of energy efficiency principals.
  • Strong understanding of Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM), and power metering systems

Keys to Success:

  • Assist in achieving Five 9’s of Availability for all data center operations
  • Assist in achieving 100% compliance with all customer SLAs
  • 100% compliance to all standard operating procedures
  • Internal & external customer communication and relationships maintained to highest standard
  • Achieve 100% compliance with internal escalation protocols for all customer impacting events pursuant to client’s escalation standards
  • 100% compliance with all health & safety standards
  • Contributing to creation/execution/closure/storage of change management tickets, MOPs, and Incident reporting
  • No human error and/or customer impacting events


Physical Demands:

  • Lift and handle up to 50 pounds
  • Bend, stoop, and stretch as required for placement and retrieval of network devices, materials, or equipment
  • Work under a raised data center floor
  • Climb ladders (up to 16 feet) to reach plenum spaces

title: Development Associate
description:
Job Title: Development Associate

Department: Foundation Gen & MGMT

Location: SLH - 20 Cottage-Potsdam Hospital - 50 Leroy St, Potsdam, NY 13676

Hours Per Week: 40

Schedule: Mon - Fri (8am-4:30pm)



Position Summary:
The Development Associate (DA) is responsible for identifying, qualifying, soliciting and stewarding leadership and major gift prospects to build a pipeline of individuals interested in supporting Rochester Regional Health. In consultation with other development officers, the DA will support the identification of major gift prospects to move them through the pipeline process towards a significant gift. Ideally, the Development Associate will be responsible for raising at least $250,000 per year. Additionally, the DA will develop partnerships with foundation colleagues, clinicians, volunteers, and others in support of relationships with prospective donors that lead to gifts.

Key Responsibilities:

• Complete cold-calls and proactive outreach to secure face-to-face qualification visits of major gift suspects, leading to the identification of major gift prospects, and where appropriate, the cultivation and solicitation of annual and major gifts.
• Cultivate and solicit other prospects as appropriate. Participate in the development of management strategies for confirmed major gift prospects.
• With the support of a supervisor and other partners, execute the fundraising plans for one or more areas of the development team. Focus on identifying, cultivating, soliciting, and stewarding major gift prospects within an assigned portfolio.
• Develop partnership with foundation colleagues, clinicians, volunteers, and others to develop relationships with prospective donors that lead to gifts.
• Consistently utilize Raiser’s Edge to document all activities, including written strategies, actions and proposals.
• Collaborate with others on the development team to ensure positive outcomes for donors in the advancement of our fundraising goals.
Manage activities to ensure achievement of annual metrics for visits, asks and gifts.
• Ensure that all fundraising activities with patients are compliant with all state and federal HIPAA privacy regulations.
• Performs other duties as assigned.


Minimum Qualifications:

-Bachelor's degree preferred
-Two (2) years of successful professional experience in fundraising, sales, marketing, communications, constituent relations, alumni relations, or related field preferred
-Must be available to support Foundation events that occasionally occur on weeknights and weekends.

Desired Attributes:

• Solid writing and verbal communication skills; demonstrates professionalism, organization, customer-focus consistent with entry level fundraising position; strong relationship building skills.


Required Licensure/Certification Skills:

• NYS Driver’s License

title: Director, Finance – Yacht Operations
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts is a global, luxury hotel management company. We manage over 130 hotels and resorts and 50 private residences in 47 countries around the world and growing. Central to Four Seasons employee experience and social impact programming is the company’s commitment to supporting cancer research, and the advancement of diversity, inclusion, equality and belonging at Four Seasons corporate offices and properties worldwide. At Four Seasons, we are powered by people and our culture enables everything we do.

Director of Finance, Yacht Operations

The Director of Finance, Yacht Operations serves as the senior finance leader for Four Seasons Yacht Operations and is accountable for driving business performance, financial governance, reporting, planning, forecasting, analytics, and compliance across the Yacht business.


Working in partnership with Yacht Operations leadership, Yacht General Managers, Ownership, Marc-Henry Cruise Holdings Ltd. (MHCH), and Corporate stakeholders, this role provides financial leadership that supports operational excellence, long-term value creation, and the achievement of strategic business objectives.


The Director leads performance management, financial planning and analysis, forecasting, financial governance, treasury management, debt and covenant reporting, reserve oversight, Management Agreement compliance, and business analytics across the Yacht business. This role serves as a key advisor on future fleet planning, yacht development initiatives, business expansion opportunities, margin enhancement strategies, and enterprise decision-making while ensuring alignment between Four Seasons and Ownership financial processes.


Through strategic leadership and hands-on execution, the Director helps optimize financial performance, strengthen governance, manage risk, and support the sustainable growth of the Yacht business.


What You’ll Be Doing:


Strategic Leadership & Business Partnership

  • Serve as the senior finance business partner to Yacht Operations leadership, Yacht General Managers, Ownership, MHCH, and Corporate stakeholders.
  • Participate as a member of the Yacht Leadership Team, contributing to strategic planning, operational reviews, and key business decisions.
  • Develop and execute financial strategies that support business objectives and long-term value creation.
  • Build trusted relationships with Ownership representatives, board members, lenders, and associated entities.
  • Present financial performance, forecasts, budgets, risks, and recommendations to leadership, Ownership, and Corporate stakeholders.

Performance Management & Business Analytics

  • Lead performance management and business analytics activities across the Yacht business, establishing key financial and operational performance metrics and driving accountability against approved plans and forecasts.
  • Serve as the executive owner of forecast accuracy across the Yacht business, ensuring accountability, consistency, and alignment between operational and financial planning assumptions.
  • Partner with operational leaders to identify opportunities and develop recommendations that improve revenue, labor productivity, expense management, cash flow, profitability, margin expansion, and long-term growth.
  • Drive data-based decision making through meaningful analysis, benchmarking, forecasting, and business insights.

Financial Planning, Forecasting & Reporting

  • Lead the annual budget process, rolling forecasts, and long-range financial planning activities.
  • Own the end-to-end forecasting process, ensuring alignment between Four Seasons and MHCH methodologies, reporting requirements, and planning timetables.
  • Review monthly financial results and ensure reporting accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with corporate and ownership requirements.
  • Ensure delivery of all required financial, covenant, and financing-related reporting, including P&L statements, cash flow reporting, forecasts, debt reporting, and Facility Agreement compliance reporting.

Financial Governance & Compliance

  • Serve as the primary financial steward of Management Agreement compliance and governance, ensuring all reporting obligations, fee calculations, reserve funding requirements, cost recovery provisions, contractual commitments, and financial approval requirements are administered and fulfilled in accordance with agreement terms.
  • Maintain a thorough understanding of Four Seasons Accounting & Finance policies, standards, management agreements, and applicable ownership governance requirements.
  • Maintain a strong internal control environment and ensure compliance with GAAP, company policies, ownership requirements, and regulatory obligations.
  • Provide oversight and governance of month-end and year-end close activities, driving alignment, standardization, and continuous improvement between Four Seasons and MHCH reporting processes to enhance accuracy, transparency, consistency, and timeliness.
  • Ensure accurate tracking, reconciliation, reporting, and recovery of all amounts payable to Four Seasons, including management fees, program fees, reimbursable expenses, shared services charges, and other contractual obligations.
  • Lead internal and external audits and ensure timely resolution of audit findings.
  • Oversee financial governance related to guest deposits, advance deposits, and related payment administration processes, ensuring controls, accessibility, and compliance with business and ownership requirements.

Treasury, Reserves & Capital Management

  • Oversee treasury operations, cash flow management, liquidity planning, banking relationships, funding strategies, and working capital performance.
  • Monitor payment practices and liquidity positions to ensure timely settlement of obligations and proactively identify risks to vendor relationships, operational continuity, Four Seasons reputation, and service delivery standards.
  • Oversee governance, funding, reporting, adequacy assessments, and utilization strategies associated with FF&E Reserves, Dry Dock Reserves, Cash Reserves, and other ownership-mandated reserve accounts.
  • Oversee capital expenditure approvals, reporting, and compliance with reserve funding requirements.

Global Programs Oversight

  • Support the implementation, budgeting, funding, and administration of mandatory Four Seasons programs and initiatives.
  • Partner with Corporate stakeholders to ensure program-related funding obligations are appropriately forecasted, recorded, communicated, and recovered in accordance with applicable agreements.

Planning & Growth

  • Partner with MHCH and Corporate stakeholders on fleet planning initiatives, including new vessel development, Yacht expansion projects, and long-range business planning activities.
  • Support strategic investment decisions through financial evaluation, risk assessment, and operational readiness planning.
  • Provide financial modeling, scenario planning, investment analysis, and business case development to support future growth initiatives.

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or a related discipline.
  • Professional accounting designation (CPA, CA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent) preferred.
  • Significant finance leadership experience within luxury hospitality, travel, maritime, cruise, or service-based organizations.
  • Strong experience in financial planning and analysis, forecasting, performance management, treasury, financial reporting, and business analytics.
  • Experience managing ownership relationships, management agreements, financing arrangements, covenant reporting, and reserve governance.
  • Proven ability to leverage financial and operational data to improve business performance and support strategic decision-making.
  • Experience supporting growth initiatives, development projects, vessel openings, integrations, or other complex multi-stakeholder initiatives.
  • Strong knowledge of GAAP, internal controls, compliance standards, and hospitality finance practices.
  • Advanced proficiency with financial systems, business intelligence tools, and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.

Who You Are:

  • A strategic and analytical leader with strong business acumen and a results-oriented mindset.
  • An inspiring and collaborative leader who fosters trust, accountability, and transparency.
  • A champion of continuous improvement who embraces innovation and drives operational excellence.
  • Skilled at building relationships and influencing stakeholders across functions and levels of the organization.
  • An effective communicator who clearly articulates priorities, expectations, and business objectives.
  • Demonstrates the highest levels of integrity, professionalism, and ethical decision-making.
  • Adaptable and resilient, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
  • A role model for Four Seasons values and sound business practices.


This role will be a Hybrid working model, which will require 3 days per week in the Miami Four Seasons Corporate Office (3 days per week) located at 1441 Brickell Avenue, Suite 1007, Miami, Florida. #LI-Hybrid

Four Seasons is an Equal Opportunity, Affirmative Action employer. Minorities, women, veterans, and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply. To access the 'EEOC is The Law' Information poster please visit this website - https://www.eeoc.gov/know-your-rights-workplace-discrimination-illegal

title: Data Engineer II
description:
Harvest Group is an integrated commerce agency that helps high-growth consumer brands win in today's complex retail landscape. Since 2006, we've partnered with some of the world's most recognized brands to navigate the intersection of in-store and digital commerce, retail media, and social platforms across leading retailers including Walmart, Sam's Club, Target, Amazon, Costco, and Kroger.

What sets Harvest Group apart is our connected approach. By aligning strategy, execution, and insights across every stage of the retail journey, and powering that work through our proprietary technology platform, we help brands create sustainable growth in an increasingly dynamic marketplace.

But our success starts with our people.

At Harvest Group, our culture and values shape how we work, serve our clients, and support one another. We believe in building meaningful relationships, pursuing excellence with humility, and creating an environment where talented individuals can do their best work while continuing to grow professionally and personally.

Our Values

Integrity – Doing what is right in all things
Relationship – Pursuing depth, trust, and collaboration
Service – Laboring for others with humility and care
Excellence – Delivering extraordinary performance and results with humility
Journey – Embracing our past and planning for our future with faith
Harvest Group Tunisia is the third branch of the Harvest Group company, which opened in 2016. Its main responsibilities are:

Data reporting and insights: standardized and optimized reports and performance trackers for U.S. teams and clients
Analytical storytelling: leveraging data to tell a compelling story
Software development: supporting the dynamic needs of our team
Tool creation: building easy-to-use solutions to complex data problems
Data operations and cloud data management: building and maintaining data pipelines from source systems to cloud data storage, and retrieving data from a wide variety of sources
About the Role

The Data Engineer II independently owns the development, deployment, and maintenance of data pipelines and models that power Harvest Group's data products across retail partners including Walmart, Sam's Club, Target, Amazon, Costco, and Kroger. This role works across the full pipeline lifecycle, from translating product requirements into technical designs through production monitoring and incident resolution. The Data Engineer II applies data architecture thinking alongside data operations execution, contributing to both the design and the reliability of Harvest Group's data platform.

What You'll Do

Own the end-to-end delivery of data pipeline features: requirements gathering, design, build, test, deploy, and monitor.
Design and implement transformation models including complex incremental strategies, snapshots, and cross-database references.
Write performant SQL transformations, optimizing for cloud warehouse execution patterns and compute cost.
Author and maintain orchestration DAGs for pipeline scheduling and dependency management.
Partner with product managers and analysts to translate business questions and reporting needs into durable data structures and models.
Contribute to naming, metadata, and documentation conventions that keep business semantics clear and definitions consistent.
Troubleshoot production data issues independently, performing root-cause analysis and implementing fixes.
Participate in Agile/Scrum delivery, collaborating directly with product and business partners.
Mentor Data Engineer I team members through code reviews, pair programming, and knowledge sharing.
Contribute to shared engineering standards: style guides, testing patterns, and documentation templates.
Partner with product support to resolve escalated data quality issues with root-cause fixes.
What We're Looking For

Required
2+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a related role.
Proficient SQL skills, including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, and query optimization.
Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in a production environment.
Experience with a SQL-based transformation framework (dbt preferred).
Experience with a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake preferred).
Strong version control practices (Git) and experience with CI/CD pipelines.
Ability to work independently and manage priorities across concurrent projects.
Ability to explain technical decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Ability to collaborate effectively with U.S.-based teams and clients across time zones.
Ownership mindset with a proactive approach to problem solving and continuous improvement.
Nice to Have
Experience authoring and maintaining DAGs in an orchestration platform (Airflow, Astro, or Prefect).
Python proficiency for data processing and automation.
Understanding of data modeling patterns (dimensional modeling, slowly changing dimensions, data vault).
Working experience with CPG or retail data (Kroger / 84.51, Walmart / Luminate, Nielsen, Circana).
Experience with data quality frameworks and monitoring.
Familiarity with a BI platform (Looker, Omni, or similar).
We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

Please note that we only accept resumes submitted in English.

title: Senior Consultant, Application Development

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit

title: Vice President, Product Strategy & Market Insights
description:
Where Ambition Meets Innovation

Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.


Job Overview:

LPL Financial is seeking a strategic and intellectually curious Vice President, Product Strategy & Market Insights. This role will lead the development and operation of a recurring market intelligence capability that provides actionable insights on the evolving wealth management and advisor technology landscape. The position partners closely with product, strategy, and go-to-market teams to assess market trends, competitive dynamics, emerging technologies, and industry investment patterns. The successful candidate will translate complex market developments into clear recommendations that inform product positioning, roadmap prioritization, and strategic decision-making.


Responsibilities:

  • Build and operate a recurring market intelligence capability that provides ongoing visibility into industry direction, platform trends, capability evolution, and competitive market shifts.
  • Produce regular insight deliverables including competitive landscape assessments, capability deep-dives, benchmark analyses, and executive-level market briefings.
  • Partner with product subject-matter experts to evaluate market developments, assess competitive positioning, and identify differentiation opportunities.
  • Translate industry and market insights into actionable implications for product roadmaps, investment priorities, and build-versus-buy decisions.
  • Maintain a comprehensive view of established competitors, emerging market participants, and new technology entrants.
  • Track emerging technologies and advisor experience innovations, evaluating potential opportunities and risks for LPL’s platform and ecosystem.
  • Establish repeatable research methodologies, information sources, and analytical frameworks that support a sustainable market insights function.
  • Collaborate with product, strategy, and go-to-market stakeholders to incorporate market intelligence into planning processes and key business decisions.

What Are We Looking For?

We are seeking a professional who is motivated to pursue greatness, consistently act with integrity, and is driven to help our clients succeed. The ideal candidate values collaboration, strives to win together, and contributes to a culture that seeks to create and share joywhile delivering meaningful business outcomes through informed strategic decision-making.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Strategy, Technology, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in product strategy, product management, management consulting, market research, strategic insights, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience synthesizing large volumes of information into concise recommendations that support business decisions.
  • Experience evaluating product, platform, and technology capabilities to support strategic analysis and decision-making.
  • Experience partnering with product and technical subject-matter experts to develop positioning and differentiation strategies.

Preferences:

  • Track record of influencing product roadmap, investment, or strategic decisions through analysis and recommendations.
  • Experience presenting insights and recommendations to senior leadership audiences.
  • Experience building, organizing, and managing research sources and information repositories.
  • Deep curiosity about market dynamics, advisor technology, and emerging trends in financial services.
  • Experience within wealth management, brokerage, banking, fintech, or other highly regulated industries.

#LI-Hybrid

title: Technical Consultant
description:
What You Can Expect

You are the anchor of long-term technical success for some of Zoom's most complex enterprise contact center deployments. You own the ongoing technical relationship across a portfolio of MSO accounts running Zoom Contact Center and Zoom Virtual Agent, driving continuous optimization, resolving escalations, and ensuring customers extract measurable value from the platform. You work at the intersection of customer advocacy, platform expertise, and operational excellence, partnering closely with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to move quickly on what matters most. Candidates without hands-on cloud contact center experience or conversational AI platform expertise will not be considered for this role.


About the Team

Zoom’s Managed Services Operations (MSO) team is the long-term success engine for Zoom’s enterprise and premier contact center customers. We stay engaged after implementation, ensuring complex Zoom Contact Center and Zoom Virtual Agent environments remain optimized, resilient, and aligned to each customer’s evolving business goals. Our team operates at the intersection of product, engineering, and customer success, and our work directly shapes how enterprise organizations experience and grow with Zoom’s contact center platform.


Responsibilities

  • Own the ongoing technical relationship for a portfolio of enterprise MSO accounts running Zoom Contact Center and Zoom Virtual Agent, serving as the primary technical advisor across configuration, optimization, and escalation management.
  • Lead recurring cadence calls, monthly and quarterly business reviews, and ad-hoc technical sessions with customer stakeholders, translating business objectives into actionable Zoom Contact Center and Zoom Virtual Agent strategies.
  • Execute day-two configurations including flow updates, queue management, skill-based routing, IVR modifications, and Zoom Virtual Agent conversation design changes across voice, chat, video, and SMS engagement channels.
  • Design and refine Zoom Virtual Agent bots, including intent training, NLP tuning, API and webhook integrations with platforms such as Salesforce and ServiceNow, and OAuth-based authentication flows.
  • Analyze call analytics dashboards and CX metrics to identify trends, surface quality issues, and recommend data-driven improvements aligned to each customer’s business outcomes.
  • Manage Tier 2/3 escalation triage for assigned accounts, coordinating with Zoom Support, Engineering, and Product teams to resolve critical incidents with defined timelines and thorough root-cause documentation.
  • Advocate internally for customer needs, driving feature requests, escalating product gaps, and maintaining awareness of platform releases and known issues that may affect customer environments.
  • Maintain detailed account documentation including meeting notes, configuration records, escalation logs, and runbooks, and contribute to team knowledge bases, playbooks, and AI-assisted automation tooling.
  • Partner with TAMs, CSMs, and Account Executives to deliver a unified customer experience, and actively participate in MSO Ops Weekly, team standups, and cross-functional syncs.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with cloud contact center platforms, with Zoom Contact Center strongly preferred; equivalent experience with Genesys, NICE, or Five9 accepted.
  • Demonstrated experience with conversational AI and virtual agent platforms, including bot design, intent management, NLP configuration, and API integrations.
  • Strong command of contact center fundamentals: ACD, IVR/IVA, skill-based routing, workforce management concepts, and omnichannel engagement.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, JavaScript, and CRM/ITSM integrations including Salesforce and ServiceNow.
  • Proficiency in call analytics interpretation and CX dashboard analysis, with the ability to translate data into clear, customer-facing recommendations.
  • Excellent communication skills across technical and executive audiences, with the ability to operate independently in a remote, distributed environment across time zones.
  • Experience in a managed services, professional services, or TAM/CSM capacity with ongoing account ownership responsibility; scripting and automation skills (Python, JavaScript) and certifications in Zoom, CCNA Collaboration, or cloud contact center platforms are a plus.


Ways of Working
Our structured hybrid approach is centered around our offices and remote work environments. The work style of each role, Hybrid, Remote, or In-Person is indicated in the job description/posting.


Benefits
As part of our award-winning workplace culture and commitment to delivering happiness, our benefits program offers a variety of perks, benefits, and options to help employees maintain their physical, mental, emotional, and financial health; support work-life balance; and contribute to their community in meaningful ways. Click Learn for more information.


About Us
Zoomies help people stay connected so they can get more done together. We set out to build the best collaboration platform for the enterprise, and today help people communicate better with products like Zoom Contact Center, Zoom Phone, Zoom Events, Zoom Apps, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom Webinars.
We’re problem-solvers, working at a fast pace to design solutions with our customers and users in mind. Find room to grow with opportunities to stretch your skills and advance your career in a collaborative, growth-focused environment.


Our Commitment

At Zoom, we believe great work happens when people feel supported and empowered. We’re committed to fair hiring practices that ensure every candidate is evaluated based on skills, experience, and potential. If you require an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know—we’re here to support you at every step.


If you need assistance navigating the interview process due to a medical disability, please submit an Accommodations Request Form and someone from our team will reach out soon. This form is solely for applicants who require an accommodation due to a qualifying medical disability. Non-accommodation-related requests, such as application follow-ups or technical issues, will not be addressed.


Our interviews are supported by BrightHire, a tool that helps us create a consistent and thoughtful interview experience and may include recordings. Please refer to our candidate privacy statement for more information of how we use your data.

description:
Bring YOUR energy to Alliant Energy!

At Alliant Energy, our purpose is to serve customers and build stronger communities. We are passionate about powering beyond the market challenges of today, while powering what's next in energy. When our employees say "I am energy", it means they take pride in the work we do when disaster strikes, as well as all the days in between. We want you to be safe, happy and healthy. Residency Requirements:

Travel time from your primary residence to your assigned headquarters must be 60 minutes or less under normal driving conditions.

Job Summary

Performs a variety of work connected with the operations, inspections, and maintenance of combustion turbine sites. Performs varied mechanical, basic electrical and basic control and instrument maintenance activities and other duties necessary to maintain the generation facilities. This role is open at our Sheboygan Falls Generating Station in Plymouth, WI. As our generation increases in solar, we anticipate additional support from our Simple Cycle power plants.


This position works the evening schedule from 2:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m.


What you will do

  • Performs combustion turbine operations, inspections, and maintenance in a safe and efficient manner adhering to all corporate and company guidelines to ensure compliance with all city, state, and federal regulations.
  • Participates in job safety briefings, safety tailgate sessions, safety reviews and safety observations.
  • Observes, operates and initiates repairs to the combustion turbine and related equipment.
  • Maintains an accurate operating log of all equipment and performs preventive maintenance to sustain equipment availability and reliability.
  • Performs and documents routine inspections and maintenance of the site, combustion turbines, and related equipment utilizing Maximo and predictive and preventive maintenance processes and procedures.
  • Performs and documents routine inspections of the site, combustion turbines and related equipment, and collects and retains necessary data to support regulatory permit requirements and reporting.
  • Calibrates and repairs recording and indicating instrumentation.
  • Welds with a fair skill to produce safe and reliable repairs and construction.
  • Maintains performance monitoring and control equipment. Monitors gas and steam turbine performance. Keeps testing records as assigned.
  • Participates in the performance of warehouse activities, ordering supplies as needed, and supports inventory activities.
  • Performs and participates in regular inspections, overhauls and maintenance of all related plant equipment.
  • Maintains, operates and repairs water treatment systems. Receives and unloads acid, caustic and other chemicals needed for the operation of the facility. Troubleshoots and repairs the water treatment system controls and valves. Maintains optimum water treatment system performance.
  • Performs tests and reports data on water treatment systems.
  • Operates mobile and heavy equipment to perform maintenance tasks.
  • Supports safety, plant reliability, productivity, and plant efficiency improvements by participating in various continuous improvement activities.
  • Performs all work according to established procedures and safety practices.
  • Performs various generating plant and shop area housekeeping functions.
  • Works closely with contractors on troubleshooting, repairing and/or installing equipment.
  • Performs other duties which are similar, related or incidental to this position.
  • Supports operation and maintenance activities at other generating facilities as needed.

Preferred Education

  • Associate Degree Electrical, mechanical or instrument and control technical college


Required Experience

  • 4 years’ experience in any one or a combination of the electrical, or instrument and control trades or completed apprenticeship; or 2 years of Combustion Turbine maintenance and operation experience.
  • Up to date demonstrated electrical or instrument and control experience required.


Preferred Experience

  • A combination of electrical or instrument and control trades completed trades or completed apprenticeship.


Other Requirements

  • Must possess a valid driver’s license.
  • Employees in this job classification are covered by the Residency Policy and will be required to live within 60 minutes of their headquarters.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Demonstrated ability to solve problems
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate work and work with others
  • Strong sense of personal and technical responsibility possesses necessary skills in basic electrical, basic instrument and control and basic mechanical
  • Ability to work from blueprints, diagrams, drawings, and specifications

  • Must possess technical ability
  • Knowledge of company safety rules

  • Strong leadership ability

  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative and inclusive work environment.

title: Director of Security & Safety
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Blending imaginative urban design on the banks of the St. Johns River, Four Seasons Hotel and Private Residences Jacksonville will be the centerpiece of the Jacksonville Shipyards, ideally located adjacent to the Sports Complex and proposed Stadium of the Future – a renovated and reimagined EverBank Stadium that will serve as home to the Jacksonville Jaguars while playing host to national and international sports and entertainment events for generations to come.

About the role

As Director of Security & Safety, you will play a pivotal leadership role in the successful pre-opening and ongoing operation of Four Seasons Hotel & Residences Jacksonville. Reporting as a key member of the hotel leadership team, you will be responsible for creating and maintaining a safe, secure, and welcoming environment for guests, residents, employees, and assets. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced security professional with a strong luxury hospitality background and pre-opening expertise to establish world-class security operations from the ground up while fostering a culture of safety, preparedness, and exceptional service.

What You Will Do

  • Lead the pre-opening strategy, planning, and setup of the Security department.

  • Develop and implement comprehensive security, safety, and risk management programs across the hotel.

  • Establish security policies, procedures, and emergency response protocols in line with Four Seasons standards and local regulations.

  • Recruit, train, mentor, and develop a high-performing Security team.

  • Conduct risk assessments and implement preventive measures to safeguard guests, employees, assets, and reputation.

  • Oversee all physical security operations, including access control, surveillance systems, investigations, and incident management.

  • Partner with hotel leadership to ensure a safe and secure environment throughout all phases of the pre-opening and ongoing operations.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with local law enforcement, emergency services, and government authorities.

  • Lead crisis management, emergency preparedness, business continuity, and disaster recovery planning.

  • Monitor security trends, threats, and regulatory requirements, ensuring the hotel remains compliant and proactive.

  • Prepare and manage departmental budgets, resources, and security technology investments.

  • Investigate incidents, produce detailed reports, and recommend corrective actions to mitigate future risks.

What You Will Bring

  • Proven leadership experience as a Director of Security or senior Security leader within a luxury hotel or hotel environment.

  • Previous pre-opening experience in a luxury hospitality setting is highly preferred.

  • Strong expertise in security operations, risk management, crisis response, and emergency planning.

  • Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing teams.

  • Thorough understanding of hotel security systems, surveillance technology, access control, and investigative procedures.

  • Experience working closely with government agencies, law enforcement, and emergency response organizations.

  • Strong knowledge of health, safety, fire life safety, and regulatory compliance requirements.

  • Exceptional communication, decision-making, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Fluency in English is required; Spanish language skills are a strong advantage.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced pre-opening environment, managing multiple priorities while maintaining the highest standards of service, professionalism, and discretion.

Four Seasons is an Equal Opportunity, Affirmative Action employer. Minorities, women, veterans, and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply. title: Finance - Intern, Business Finance
description:
THE BUSINESS

We are Everyday Luxury™.

It's what we do and how we do it — together.

It's working alongside world-class talent in pursuit of world-class results.

It's maximizing your potential in a high-performance culture.

It's knowing that wherever you are, you belong.

It's elevating your world — and the world of those who love and will love Aritzia.

It's You. And an endless runway of opportunity.

With a Global Support Campus in Vancouver and additional Support Office hubs in major cities across North America — including Toronto, New York, Los Angeles and Seattle — our workplace network is strategically designed to support our People and serve our Clients a frictionless experience. So, you can do what you do best — with us.

THE TEAM

The mission of the Business Finance Department is to maximize Aritzia’s financial performance with an entrepreneurial mindset.

THE OPPORTUNITY

This is a unique opportunity to join the Business Finance Department, where you will be part of the team responsible for producing insightful financial analysis to optimize Aritzia’s financial assets and business decisions. As an Intern in Business Finance, you will contribute to Aritzia’s future growth by supporting the development of strategic financial insights and solutions to support the growing business. As one of our business support functions, this is a special opportunity to develop subject matter expertise in a core business area as you grow your financial analysis skills. Our goal is that you will come out of your internship inspired, with meaningful experience and an enhanced skill set you can carry forward into your bright future.

THE ROLE

As an Intern in Business Finance, you will support with:

  • Forecasting sales and/or business expenses in the short and long term, simultaneously analyzing and explaining key drivers of future growth
  • Understanding and analyzing business results including the internal (business-driven) and external (macroeconomic) drivers for P&L line items
  • Supporting our business partners with financial analysis, insights, and go-forward recommendations on sales events, special projects, and business initiatives
  • Identifying opportunities for smart spend management through informed and fact-based business decisions
  • Providing our business partners and Aritzia Leadership Team with timely and accurate reporting on performance results, calling out key highlights, risks, and opportunities

THE QUALIFICATIONS

The Intern, Business Finance has/is:

  • Currently enrolled in a post-secondary institution, with a preferred graduation date of April 2027 to April 2028
    • Preferably pursuing a degree in Finance, Accounting, or Business
  • A commitment to learn and apply Aritzia's Values and Business and People Leadership principles
  • The ability to collaborate fluently with cross-functional partners
  • A commitment to quality and investing in results that add value to the business
  • Passion for Aritzia and the fashion industry
  • Skills and experience with Excel are an asset
  • A logical, organized approach with an appreciation for structure and details
  • A problem solver who thinks critically to develop insightful solutions
  • Work experience in Aritzia Boutiques, Concierge, or Distribution Centres is highly valued

THE DEPARTMENT

Gain firsthand exposure to how a leading retail business is managed from a financial perspective. Develop a strong understanding of the key drivers, metrics, and insights that inform strategic decision-making, while building analytical, financial planning, and business partnering skills. Learn how Finance helps maximize growth and drive smart business decisions across the organization.

Develop your financial and business acumen

  • Build an understanding of the key financial drivers, KPIs, and performance metrics that shape business decisions
  • Analyze operational reporting and identify opportunities to enhance reporting capabilities across the business
  • Support improvements to forecasting, planning, and financial models to drive greater accuracy and efficiency
  • Gain exposure to financial planning processes and how business performance is measured and evaluated

Partner across the business to drive informed decision-making

  • Collaborate with teams across the organization to gain broad business exposure and perspective
  • Support financial analysis that translates data into actionable insights and recommendations
  • Participate in cross-functional forecasting, budgeting, and planning discussions
  • Help evaluate business opportunities, identify trends, and uncover insights that support strategic priorities
  • Develop skills in financial analysis, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and business partnering

THE PERKS

Some of the industry-leading benefits you will receive working at Aritzia:

  • Product Discount — Maybe you’ve heard of our famous product discount? Or our exclusive private shopping events? You have now.
  • A-OK Commissary & Cafe — Everyday Luxury dining, exclusive to Aritzia. Our in-house bistro and cafe is a private oasis where employees can enjoy curated, subsidized Everyday Luxury dining.
  • The SET — Our in-office fitness studio and gym with state-of-the-art equipment, custom-created classes and optional personal training. Open 7 days a week, it works out well.
  • Aritzia Virtual Wellness — Because your health, happiness and safety matter, we provide 24/7 resources to support you in your wellbeing goals, whether they’re physical, mental, social or financial.
  • Aspirational Workplace — Our offices are specially designed to be spaces of creativity, productivity and inspiration. They’re also dog friendly. Woof.
  • Amenities — Additional amenities include a private parent’s room, shower facilities with elevated complementary conveniences, bike rooms and more.
  • The Extras — We also offer a multitude of other perks like dry-cleaning, hotel and restaurant discounts, self-care promos and on-site medical care.

THE LOGISTICS

  • Internship Dates: May 10 – July 30, 2027 (12 weeks)
  • Location: Vancouver, BC
    • Successful candidates must be able to work at the primary work location and self-relocate if necessary
  • Application Deadline: September 27, 2026
  • Application Process:
    • Apply online – be sure to have your cover letter, resume, and unofficial transcript ready
    • Apply to one position only – interested in more than one? You’ll have an opportunity to note other areas of interest in your application.
    • Applicants moving onto the next stage will be contacted by October

ARITZIA

Aritzia is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Our goal is to be inclusive, diverse, and representative of the communities where we work while creating an environment where every person can enjoy a successful career. This commitment applies to all candidates and employees regardless of race, ethnicity, citizenship, creed, place of origin, religion, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, family status, marital status, disability, age, and any other protected characteristic.

Requests for accommodation due to a disability or any other protected characteristic can be made at any stage of the recruitment process and during employment by contacting our People & Culture Team.

title: Greenskeeper
description:
The Greenskeeper, under the supervision of the Golf Course Superintendent and Assistant Superintendent, is to perform routine manual labor involved in golf course maintenance; do semi-skilled grounds construction and maintenance work; operate small hand-powered equipment; and occasionally perform work involving large equipment such as tractors, loaders and large mowers. Each groundskeeper may be assigned responsibility for the care and maintenance of several designated holes on the golf course and does related work as required.

The Greenskeeper will be required to perform the following tasks, but not limited to:
  • Operates mowers and string trimmers in trimming greens, collars, tees, around trees, fence lines, banks and hillsides; edges cart paths, sprinkler heads, valve boxes, and Kirby markers; edges, rakes and maintains sand bunkers.
  • Sets tee markers and cups on greens daily; maintains ball washers; replaces tee towels and flags when needed; removes tree debris; dumps tee garbage cans; and sand and seeds tee and fairway divots.
  • Maintains fuel and fluid levels for all types of equipments used on a daily basis; reports equipment problems or failure to the Equipment Technician immediately.
  • Returns all equipment to the designated location at the maintenance facility free of debris.
  • Cleans their section of the maintenance facility daily.
  • Waters greens, tees, and fairways.
  • Applies herbicide to designated mulch and non-turf areas under the direct supervision of a certified applicator.
  • Maintains clean and straight rope lines to redirect cart traffic around turf areas with issues.
  • Helps with project work; assists in the construction of new golf course features.
  • May be asked to operate mowers, dump trucks, or other light equipment.
  • Performs other duties as directed by his/her supervisor.
  • Ability to lift 50 lbs.
  • Ability to work in all types of weather (heat, humidity, rain, etc.)

Qualifications:
  • Requires knowledge of methods and materials used in grounds and landscape area construction/maintenance work; working knowledge of and the ability to use hand and power tools and equipment; ability to operate trucks and light motorized equipment; physical strength, stamina and agility; and ability to follow oral and written directions.
  • A knowledge of and/or ability to play the game golf and understand how job performance affects the playing conditions of the golf course.
  • Highly encouraged to maintain effective employee and membership relations.
  • Requires a valid California driver’s license.

Responsibilities:
  • Inform Greenskeeper of any maintenance practices that would relate to their daily duties.
  • Provide clear and concise instructions and safety training on all equipment and jobs set forth.
  • Provide necessary resources and a safe environment to complete all tasks set forth.
  • Provide employees to assist with completion of projects.

Note: Due to the dynamic nature and diversity of work required in golf course maintenance, it would be unrealistic to expect strictly outlined job descriptions to apply in every case. Job responsibilities may overlap categories at any given point in time. Under normal operations it would be understandable to ask employees to occasionally perform work outside of their normal job description.

title: Mechanical & Equipment Engineer
description:
As we create a colorful, capable and cleaner world through chemistry, we invite you to join our team to harness the power of chemistry to shape markets, redefine industries and improve lives for billions of people around the world.

CREATING ESSENTIAL CHEMISTRY THAT THE WORLD NEEDS


At Chemours, our people are redefining how the world thinks of chemistry by approaching everything we do with a commitment to delivering Trusted Chemistry that creates better lives and helps communities thrive. That begins with how we use our science, data, and unmatched technical expertise to develop market-leading products with the highest levels of performance, sustainability, and safety in the industry.

Powered by chemistry, our products are used in applications that make the products we rely on, processes, and new technologies possible. In key sectors such as clean energy, advanced electronics, high-performance computing and AI, climate friendly cooling, and high-quality paints and coatings for homes and industrial infrastructure---sustainable solutions and more modern living depend on Chemours chemistry.


Chemours is seeking a Mechanical & Equipment Engineer to join our growing Maintenance and Reliability team. This position will be available at the Delisle Plant in Pass Christian, Mississippi and report directly to the Site Reliability Manager.


This is an onsite, plant-facing engineering role focused on supporting mechanical equipment reliability, maintenance, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. The Mechanical & Equipment Engineer will work closely with Maintenance, Operations, Manufacturing Technology, and Reliability Engineering to resolve equipment issues, improve equipment performance, and support safe and reliable plant operations.


The position provides structured technical development, including significant training during the first several months and ongoing coaching from experienced Reliability Engineers. It also offers a strong development path for an engineer interested in progressing into Reliability Engineering, Asset Care, Mechanical Integrity, or other technical leadership opportunities.


The responsibilities of the position include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Provide day-to-day mechanical engineering support to Maintenance and Operations by troubleshooting equipment issues, evaluating failures, and recommending repairs, upgrades, and reliability improvements.
  • Serve as a technical resource for plant mechanical equipment, including pumps, compressors, heat exchangers, fans, piping systems, and rotating-equipment alignment.
  • Support equipment reliability and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) improvement initiatives by identifying recurring equipment issues and developing sustainable corrective actions.
  • Initiate and support Management of Change (MOC) activities associated with mechanical equipment, maintenance strategies, safety, reliability, quality, and operational improvements.
  • Use Mean Time Between Failure (MTBF) and other equipment-performance information to evaluate reliability, maintenance intervals, and equipment operating risk.
  • Participate in Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), equipment failure investigations, Root Cause Failure Analysis activities, and structured problem-solving efforts.
  • Support Mechanical Integrity/Quality Assurance activities and partner with inspection resources to understand equipment condition and inspection findings.
  • Review preventive and predictive maintenance strategies and identify opportunities to improve maintenance effectiveness and equipment reliability.
  • Work closely with Maintenance, Operations, Manufacturing Technology, and Reliability Engineering to prioritize technical issues based on safety, productivity, cost, and quality.
  • Provide technical leadership and influence cross-functional teams to implement equipment and process improvements without direct supervisory authority.


The following is required for this role:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or Mechatronics Engineering and 2 or more years of relevant engineering experience in a manufacturing, plant, or industrial environment.
  • Working knowledge of mechanical and rotating equipment fundamentals, including pumps, compressors, fans, equipment alignment, and basic vibration-analysis principles.
  • Working knowledge of Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Mean Time Between Failure (MTBF), equipment reliability concepts, and Management of Change (MOC).
  • Ability and willingness to work in an onsite industrial plant environment, including working directly with Maintenance and Operations teams to evaluate mechanical-equipment issues in the field.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, organization, and prioritization skills, with the ability to influence others and manage multiple technical priorities simultaneously.


The following is preferred for this role:

  • Experience in a chemical, petrochemical, refining, or other equipment-intensive process-manufacturing environment.
  • Familiarity with API 510 and API 570 inspection practices, Mechanical Integrity principles, and working with equipment inspection findings or inspection personnel.
  • Experience or familiarity with Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA), preventive and predictive maintenance, and reliability improvement methodologies.
  • Experience using SAP or another computerized maintenance management system.
  • Familiarity with Power BI, equipment-performance data, and basic data-analysis techniques.

title: MAWM Configuration Lead Consultant
description:
General Information:

Job Title: MAWM Configuration Lead Consultant

Job Location: San Antonio, TX / Atlanta, GA, United States (Onsite/Hybrid) OR fully remote across the United States for exceptional candidates.

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Hiring Timeline: Immediate

Travel Expectations: Up to 25-35% travel, based on customer requirements.

Existing Vacancy: Yes
