description:
Job Summary

Job Summary

Provide executive leadership for distribution and commercial quality, ensuring product integrity, compliant storage and transportation, effective hold controls, and consistent quality oversight from manufacturing release through final delivery to customers.

The role establishes functional strategy, governance, performance expectations, and organizational capability while partnering across Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Operations, R&D, Supply Chain, Legal, Commercial, and business leadership as relevant to the function. The leader is accountable for effective execution, timely escalation, and sustainable compliance with applicable requirement

Job Description

JOB SUMMARY

Job Summary

Provide executive leadership for distribution and commercial quality, ensuring product integrity, compliant storage and transportation, effective hold controls, and consistent quality oversight from manufacturing release through final delivery to customers.

The role establishes functional strategy, governance, performance expectations, and organizational capability while partnering across Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Operations, R&D, Supply Chain, Legal, Commercial, and business leadership as relevant to the function. The leader is accountable for effective execution, timely escalation, and sustainable compliance with applicable requirements.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES

Major Responsibilities

Distribution Quality Governance

  • Set strategy, standards, governance, and accountability for distribution quality across the network.
  • Own ship hold management, including placement, review, escalation, disposition, and release of product holds.
  • Ensure distribution deviations, nonconformances, investigations, and corrective actions are timely and effective.

Warehouse, 3PL & Product Controls

  • Direct quality oversight of warehouses and third-party logistics providers, including qualification, quality agreements, monitoring, and escalation.
  • Own distribution-only quality programs for products sourced and distributed without internal manufacturing involvement.
  • Direct storage, temperature control, and cold chain programs to ensure products remain within validated conditions.

Network Leadership & Partnership

  • Lead and develop regional distribution quality leaders and teams, ensuring consistent standards and capability across the network.
  • Partner with Supply Chain, Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Product Quality, Supplier Quality, and Commercial teams on distribution risks and customer needs.
  • Use quality metrics and trend data to identify risk, improve performance, and sustain product integrity through delivery.

Management Responsibility

  • Lead, organize, plan, direct, staff, coordinate, and communicate across leaders and teams responsible for the function to execute business plans and required organizational changes.
  • Set performance standards, establish clear decision rights and accountability, monitor performance, develop talent, and maintain appropriate staffing and capabilities.
  • Build an environment of open communication, collaboration, disciplined execution, and continuous improvement.

MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS

Minimum Requirements

Education

  • Typically requires a Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Assurance, Life Sciences, Regulatory Affairs, Business, or a related field.

Certification / Licensure

  • Professional quality or regulatory certification preferred, as applicable to the function.

Work Experience

  • At least 12 years of progressively responsible experience in Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Engineering, or a related function within medical device, pharmaceutical, healthcare products, or another highly regulated industry.
  • At least 7 years of people-leadership experience, including leading leaders and teams across multiple sites, regions, products, or disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience establishing functional strategy, leading complex cross-functional initiatives, and delivering sustained quality or regulatory outcomes.

Knowledge / Skills / Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of applicable FDA requirements, ISO 13485, EU MDR, and other global quality and regulatory requirements relevant to the function.
  • Proven ability to translate regulatory and quality requirements into practical, scalable operating processes and controls.
  • Strong leadership, organizational design, talent development, and performance management capabilities.
  • Excellent executive communication, influencing, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong analytical, risk-management, investigation, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Ability to balance compliance, product quality, patient safety, customer needs, and business objectives.
  • Position requires travel up to 35–50% for business purposes, including domestic and international travel.

PREFERRED JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Master’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Regulatory Affairs, Life Sciences, or Business preferred.
  • Relevant professional certification and experience in a complex global healthcare products organization preferred.

description:
To strengthen our team in Wietmarschen-Lohne we are looking for a

Product Owner (all genders welcome) - AI-Driven Reservoir Simulation & Optimization


based in Germany, UK or the Netherland.

Upstream optimization, an innovative division of the Rosenxt Group, which was spun off in 2023 and is dedicated to expanding into new business areas. Our focus is on developing advanced technologies for the optimization of energy production. Our state-of-the-art flow measurement device is a clamp-on non-intrusive system, gathering extensive real-time operational process data. In our interdisciplinary, agile, and autonomous teams, we foster innovations and customer value.


As Product Owner, you lead the development of our AI-driven reservoir simulator. This next-generation digital product combines machine learning with real-time and historical production data to model, predict and optimize reservoir performance. You connect reservoir engineers, data scientists, software developers and business stakeholders, and you turn complex technical and commercial requirements into a clear, prioritized product backlog and roadmap.

What you can expect


  • Own and continuously refine the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for the AI-driven reservoir simulator, aligned with business goals and market demands.
  • Translate reservoir engineering and production-optimization requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and well-defined epics for cross-functional development teams.
  • Collaborate closely with reservoir engineers, data scientists, and software/DevOps teams to ensure the AI model architecture is developed with production-grade data pipelines and validated against real reservoir behavior
  • Define and prioritize features covering data ingestion and preprocessing (data cleaning, integration, transformation, aggregation of high-frequency sensor and low-frequency reservoir data), model training, history matching, and production forecasting and further reservoir optimization features.
  • Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives in an agile/Scrum environment in alignment with the extended project team; track progress against OKRs and epics.
  • Act as the primary point of contact between internal stakeholders (engineering, commercial, leadership) regarding product scope, timelines, and value delivery.
  • Define and monitor KPIs for model accuracy, computational performance, and business value (e.g., incremental production, reduced simulation runtime, improved forecast accuracy).
  • Stay current on AI/ML advances in reservoir simulation (e.g., neural network surrogates, generative AI assistants, automated history matching) to keep the product roadmap competitive.
  • Option to work remotely in countries Rosenxt bases like Germany, UK or the Netherland

What you bring

To become part of the Rosenxt family, you have an analytical, structured and solution-oriented way of working. You should also bring:


  • A degree in petroleum engineering, reservoir engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager or similar role in a software or data-driven product environment with experience in oil & gas industry.
  • Solid understanding of agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban), backlog management, and tools such as Azure DevOps.
  • Deep knowledge of reservoir engineering concepts (multiphase flow, production data, history matching).
  • Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts (e.g., neural networks) sufficient to engage credibly with data science teams; hands-on ML experience is a plus.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, able to translate between technical, commercial, and executive audiences.
  • Experience with data aggregation and modeling challenges across different frequencies (real-time sensor data vs. monthly/quarterly reservoir data) is a plus.
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken); German language skills are an advantage.

Look forward to


  • Development opportunities and career opportunities in a global, innovative and long-term oriented group of companies with family character
  • Flexible working time and Home Office possible
  • An open, informal corporate culture, where we celebrate success with social events
  • Compatibility of work and family through our company-owned day care center
  • Employer funded pension, capital accumulation benefits and discounted insurance offers (occupational disability insurance and other direct insurance policies)
  • Company Restaurant (only in Wietmarschen-Lohne)
  • Various in-house sports activities (EGYM Wellpass and other offers)
  • Discounted charging facilities for electric vehicles directly at the company location
  • Attractive leasing offers for IT-products and bikes for private use
  • Corporate Benefits - employee offers in changing online shops at top conditions

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

40

title: Loss Prevention Officer
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Opened in 2008, Four Seasons Hotel Macao has become a coveted destination for both business and leisure travelers who seek exceptional and personalized services. title: Software Download OTA Architect
description:
Why join Aptiv?


You'll have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge applications, develop breakthrough technologies, and deliver innovative solutions to some of the world’s leading automotive brands. See your work come to life on the road, helping make mobility safer, greener, and more connected. Ready to shape the future of mobility with us?


YOUR ROLE


As a SWDL/OTA Software Architect, you will define and drive end-to-end Software Download (SWDL) and Over-the-Air (OTA) update architectures across vehicle ECUs and connected platforms. You will own the design of robust, secure, diagnosable, recoverable, and production-ready software update solutions while collaborating with global cross-functional teams to enable next-generation connected vehicle capabilities.

· Define and architect end-to-end SWDL/OTA solutions, including bootloader, update client, package management, installation, activation, rollback, and recovery mechanisms.
· Lead architecture design for automotive software updates using UDS, DoIP, CAN, Automotive Ethernet, and vehicle diagnostic interfaces.
· Drive integration and verification of software download frameworks across AUTOSAR-based ECU platforms, ensuring scalability, reliability, and compliance.
· Define secure update strategies leveraging HSM, secure boot, cryptographic signing, verification, key management, and cybersecurity best practices.
· Collaborate with platform, application, cybersecurity, functional safety, manufacturing, and service teams to ensure production readiness and successful deployment.


YOUR BACKGROUND


· Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, or a related field.
· 8 to 14+ years of experience in automotive embedded software development, with strong expertise in Software Download (SWDL) and OTA/FOTA architectures.
· Hands-on experience with Bootloader development, Embedded C, AUTOSAR, MCAL, device drivers, CAN, UDS, DoIP, and ECU flashing concepts.
· Strong knowledge of automotive cybersecurity concepts including HSM, secure boot, cryptographic signing, verification, rollback protection, and key management.
· Experience with Vector tools (DaVinci, CANoe), Trace32 Lauterbach, Infineon AURIX, NXP microcontrollers, ASPICE, and embedded software architecture.
· Exposure to OTA campaign management, UNECE R156, ISO 24089, cloud-based OTA solutions, and multi-ECU update orchestration is highly desirable.
· Experience working on OEM programs such as Ford, Stellantis, or other global automotive platforms is a strong advantage.


WHY JOIN US?


· You can grow at Aptiv. Aptiv provides an inclusive work environment where all individuals can grow and develop, regardless of gender, ethnicity or beliefs.
· You can have an impact. Safety is a core Aptiv value; we want a safer world for us and our children, one with: Zero fatalities, Zero injuries, Zero accidents.
· You have support. We ensure you have the resources and support you need to take care of your family and your physical and mental health with a competitive health insurance package.


YOUR BENEFITS AT APTIV


· Higher Education Opportunities (UDACITY, UDEMY, COURSERA are available for your continuous growth and development)
· Life and accident insurance
· Sodexo cards for food and beverages
· Well Being Program that includes regular workshops and networking events
· EAP Employee Assistance
· Access to fitness clubs (T&C apply)
· Creche facility for working parents

The Graduate Assistant for Accreditation and Quality Improvement sustains the operational capacity of the Office of Institutional Research and Integrated Data Analytics (IRIDA), with a primary focus on supporting university accreditation, assessment, and continuous quality improvement efforts. Following the departure of previously assigned part-time faculty support, this role fills a critical gap in the ability of the Office of Institutional Research and Integrated Data Analytics to track, document, and articulate institutional compliance to external stakeholders. The Graduate Assistant specializes in drafting technical assessment reports, designing infographics, and developing targeted data visualizations.

The core responsibilities of this position are designed to advance the PVAMU 2035: Journey to Eminence strategic framework. By providing the technical capacity to document continuous improvement and institutional effectiveness, the role directly supports JTE Goal 1: Investing in People and Performance Excellence and JTE Goal 3: Enriching Student Success, increasing institutional capacity to rigorously document compliance with accreditation standards and providing community members with data to enhance their ability to make data-informed decisions.

Responsibilities:


Technical Report Writing and Editing


  • Draft and edit technical reports for assessment and accreditation
  • Review and refine institutional documentation for clarity and accuracy

description:
About Primero AI

Primero AI is building the AI-native operating system for Latin America's largest enterprises. Our platform, Primia, connects live to the fragmented systems (Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and custom stacks) of $250M+ revenue corporates, normalizes them into a common ontology, and runs custom AI agents on top. Deployment Strategists are the bridge between our clients' business problems and the technical solutions our engineers build. title: Senior Technical Specialist – specialized in industrial processing of Marine Ingredients
description:
Interested in a career that matters?




Are you excited by turning scientific insight into real customer impact—and helping shape the next wave of biosolutions in animal-based ingredients with a special focus on marine ingredients?

Join our European Technical Service team, where you’ll work closely with colleagues in Sales & Marketing to provide world-class technical support and innovative solutions to customers across the region.


You’ll be part of a collaborative team of ~15 colleagues—a mix of Scientists and Research Associates—working across disciplines to help customers succeed and to support Novonesis’ purpose through impactful biosolutions.


The Role & Your Impact

In this role, you’ll play a key part in inspiring customers and prospects to engage in testing Novonesis’ biosolutions—identifying needs that can develop into strong sales opportunities. Working in close collaboration with Sales, you will initiate and lead technical activities that help execute those opportunities.

You will also collaborate with Application Research, Sales, and Marketing to launch and support innovative products and services that drive growth—while strengthening our technical credibility and customer partnerships in the animal- and marine-based ingredients space.


Key responsibilities

  • Partner closely with Sales colleagues to engage customers and prospects, inspire testing, and uncover new business needs and opportunities.
  • Initiate, plan, and lead technical activities (e.g., customer trials, evaluations, and onsite troubleshooting) to support the execution of sales opportunities.
  • Contribute to the launch and support of innovative products and solutions in collaboration with Application Research, Sales, and Marketing.
  • Drive structured experimentation, data analysis, and technical documentation to support decision-making and recommendations.
  • Deliver technical training and presentations, both internally and externally.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

Must-haves

  • Strong scientific foundation with a university degree (M.Sc. or PhD) in chemical or process engineering (or a closely related field).
  • Experience with process design and process optimization related to the industrial processing of raw materials and side-streams coming from the food industry, including the marine industry.
  • High level of scientific confidence and experience with experimental design and data analysis to generate actionable conclusions.
  • Strong customer and business orientation, with a strategic and commercial mindset to assess new business opportunities critically.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills—able to operate effectively in a network-based environment.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English.
  • Willingness to travel for customer meetings and trials (frequent travel is part of the role).

Additional Skills & Interests We Value

Nice-to-haves

We value leadership capabilities and the ability to positively influence technical colleagues, both internally and externally. Finally, a strong team-oriented mindset combined with an opportunity-driven and proactive approach to collaboration and problem-solving will be highly appreciated.


What We Offer

You will step into a role with high visibility and direct customer impact, where your scientific expertise helps shape and mature new growth opportunities. The position offers close, cross-functional collaboration with colleagues across Technical Service, Sales, Marketing, and Application Research in an international setup. You will join a team culture that values curiosity, knowledge-sharing, and pragmatic execution. At the same time, the role provides strong opportunities to further develop both your technical depth and commercial understanding while working with leading customers and innovative biosolutions.


Ways of Working / Working Conditions

Working model: This role offers flexibility to be based remotely from an eligible European location, with regular travel to customer sites and Denmark to collaborate with the wider team. Travel is expected to be approximately 60–80 days per year once established, with potentially more travel during the first year to support onboarding, relationship building and integration with the team.

Our purpose guides the way

In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.

Opportunities for everyone

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Security Operations, Senior Manager
description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What you’ll be doing...

We are seeking a Senior Manager in Cyber Security to drive high-impact data investigations and operational threat mitigation. Building on core threat analysis and project management capabilities, this role requires hands-on technical ability in database querying and log analysis. You will monitor data and perform deep-dive investigations into wireline and wireless accounts and systems. You will handle highly sensitive data, address urgent investigations, and translate technical insights into clear executive briefings and security solutions. This position will require some scheduled and unscheduled after hours, weekend, and holiday coverage.


Key Responsibilities

  • Deep-Dive Investigation & Root Cause Analysis: Conduct root-cause investigations into operational failures, security events, and complex fraud schemes involving wireline/wireless architectures.
  • Account Support & Communication: Partner closely with the Executive Relations Team to provide security support for sensitive account requests and manage urgent, high-visibility escalations. Provide oversight of account lock removal and account protections including SIM lock and port freeze.
  • Technical Threat Hunting & Log Analysis: Leverage Splunk and enterprise tools to analyze log data, build custom searches, track advanced threat patterns, and detect subtle system anomalies.
  • Database Querying & Analysis: Write, optimize, and execute SQL queries across platforms such as SQL Server, Teradata, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to extract and synthesize raw data.
  • Data & Pattern Analysis: Review daily security events to identify suspicious internal or external threat actor behavior. Analyze large sets of operational and sensitive data to spot trends, establish baselines, and detect subtle outliers or emerging threats.
  • Project & Work Stream Management: Simultaneously manage multiple complex projects and investigative work streams, ensuring timely deliverables and operational compliance.
  • Process & System Adaptation: Continually adapt to rapid changes in systems, operational processes, data structures, and the broader threat landscape including identifying ways to implement AI into daily operations.

This position can be located in other valid Verizon locations.


What we’re looking for...


You’ll need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
  • Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
  • Hands-on experience writing and executing SQL queries in production environments.
  • Solid understanding of wireless and wireline systems, operational workflows, and account security.
  • Proven experience in fraud detection, security, risk management, or threat operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze unstructured operational data, recognize patterns, and isolate system outliers.
  • Strong ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, manage competing priorities, and build trust across diverse teams.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

  • SIEM / Log Analytics Experience: Proficiency in Splunk for data extraction, log monitoring, and anomaly detection.
  • Project Leadership: Strong background in managing multiple technical work streams, project deadlines, and cross-functional technical relationships.
  • Analytical & Communication Mastery: Proven track record of turning complex technical findings into clear root-cause analyses and executive-level presentations.
  • Communication & Executive Presence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with proven experience writing formal executive summaries under tight deadlines.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits and Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

Job Description:

As a Maritime Technical Advisor (MTA), you will provide maritime technical, operational, and assurance expertise across Northwest Europe, supporting safe, compliant, and efficient maritime activities in line with Safety, Environment, and Asset Management (SEAM) requirements, Authorised Person – Maritime Safety (AP-MS) expectations, and applicable maritime regulations. You will support a broad range of business activities including vessel operations, terminal and waterfront operations, marine logistics, trading activities, energy assets, and associated supply chains. You will work across multiple business interfaces, providing guidance on maritime regulations, operational practices, projects, risk management initiatives, and assurance activities while supporting operational excellence and value delivery.

You will play a critical role in strengthening business resilience, ensuring regulatory compliance, supporting continuous improvement, and contributing to the safe and effective delivery of maritime operations across the region.

  • Provide maritime technical and operational support for vessel, terminal, and waterfront operations.
  • Advise on maritime logistics, cargo transportation activities, and marine supply chain operations.
  • Support port, facility, and vessel compatibility assessments to ensure safe and efficient operations.

  • Conduct or support terminal, vessel, and waterfront inspections as required.
  • Contribute to maritime assurance activities, audits, reviews, and operational assessments.
  • Support maritime risk assessments, HEMP studies, Management of Change (MOC) activities, and risk mitigation initiatives.
  • Monitor emerging maritime risks, regulatory developments, industry trends, and best practices.
  • Support incident investigations, root cause analyses, and organizational learning processes.
  • Provide technical input into maritime projects, infrastructure developments, and business improvement initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve maritime operational performance, efficiency, and business resilience.
  • Promote digitalization, simplification, and continuous improvement initiatives across maritime operations.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with operational, commercial, engineering, and HSSE stakeholders.
  • Promote knowledge sharing and maritime best practices throughout the organization.

What you bring

  • Extensive maritime operational experience, including service in a senior seagoing leadership role.
  • Professional fluency in Dutch or German is a must.
  • Strong knowledge of shipping operations, terminal activities, marine logistics, waterfront operations, and supply chain operations.
  • Deep understanding of maritime regulations, industry standards, and maritime risk management practices.
  • Experience supporting maritime assurance activities, audits, inspections, and compliance programs.
  • Demonstrated capability in maritime incident investigation, root cause analysis, and organizational learning processes.
  • Strong understanding of risk management principles and the ability to support the management of maritime risks to ALARP.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to build trusted relationships across diverse business functions.
  • Strong communication and influencing skills with the ability to provide clear technical advice and practical recommendations.
  • Proven ability to balance operational requirements, regulatory compliance, business objectives, and risk management considerations.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and multicultural environments.
  • Enterprise-first mindset with a collaborative and team-oriented approach.
  • Ability to perform effectively during emergency response situations and periods of heightened operational activity.
  • Professional maritime qualifications and membership in relevant maritime professional networks are advantageous.
  • Willingness to travel as required to support business operations across Northwest Europe.
  • Ability to qualify as the AP-MS under MTF within the Maritime Operations Assurance discipline.

title: Engineer III
description:
Technical Lead - OpenBlue CUPO Systems Specialist


Job Description Summary

Johnson Controls is shaping a future that is more productive, secure, and sustainable by applying cloud, data analytics, the Internet of Things, and Design Thinking to intelligent buildings.

In this role, you will help deliver OpenBlue Central Utility Plant solutions that support reliable, efficient central utilities for critical environments such as universities, hospitals, airports, office towers, and data centers.


Role Overview

  • Based in Pune, this position leads the engineering, integration, commissioning, and optimization of OpenBlue CUP solutions for district energy and chiller plants globally. You will serve as the technical lead for project execution, aligning delivery with customer objectives, schedules, and performance goals while helping drive energy savings, reduced water use, and lower carbon impact.
  • Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the engineering and project execution of OpenBlue Central Utility Plant solutions from design through closeout.
  • Analyze site and operational data to build accurate energy models using CUPO software and identify optimization opportunities.
  • Prepare drawings, scopes of work, and recommissioning requirements for sensors, meters, and controls needed to make a plant CUP-ready.
  • Oversee system design, programming, installation coordination, commissioning, performance validation, and project closeout activities.
  • Create and execute integration test plans with controls service contractors to verify bidirectional data and command flow between CPO and the plant automation system.
  • Oversee point mapping and local plant automation programming to support smooth transitions between operating modes.
  • Validate system functionality, analyze command dispatch results, and resolve issues throughout commissioning and startup.
  • Collaborate with customers, plant operators, and cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, high-performance outcomes.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentor engineering team members, and train operators and end users on OpenBlue CUP solutions.
  • Maintain strong ethics, quality, safety, and compliance with Johnson Controls policies and applicable regulations.
  • How You Will Do It
  • Own project outcomes with accountability, safety, and integrity while keeping delivery aligned to scope, schedule, and customer expectations.
  • Stay close to the work by reviewing plant data, point maps, and field results to identify practical optimization actions and remove obstacles quickly.
  • Improve every day through structured test plans, candid troubleshooting, and continuous refinement of engineering standards and methods.
  • Win as one team by working closely with controls contractors, project managers, operators, and other engineering disciplines.
  • Lead regular progress meetings, document decisions clearly, and keep stakeholders informed of risks, changes, and commissioning status.
  • Use Microsoft Project or similar tools to support planning, coordination, and milestone tracking.
  • Translate technical findings into clear training and support so plant teams can confidently operate the CUP solution.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in building automation controls engineering, programming, and commissioning.
  • Strong expertise in integrating building systems using industry-standard protocols such as BACnet, Modbus, and LonWorks.
  • Proven experience designing, implementing, and commissioning central utility plant control systems, including automation startup and commissioning for at least five live critical facility projects.
  • Hands-on experience in energy modeling, chiller plant optimization, data analytics, and performance assessment using software tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish engineering standards and provide technical leadership to engineering teams.
  • Strong project management and stakeholder communication skills, with experience using Microsoft Project or similar tools.
  • Prior experience supervising and mentoring technical or engineering staff.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Willingness to travel up to 50%, including international assignments.

Nice to Have

  • Master’s degree or Professional Engineer registration.
  • Strong understanding of energy modeling and data analytics.
  • Strong background in the Metasys suite of tools.
  • Programming capability for multiple makes and models of building automation systems and PLC systems.

Why Join Us

You will contribute to meaningful work that helps customers reduce operating costs, lower energy consumption, and improve the performance of critical central plants. This is an opportunity to apply your technical leadership in a collaborative environment focused on intelligent buildings, sustainability, and reliable outcomes.


If this sounds like the right next step for you, we invite you to apply and help shape the future of OpenBlue CUP solutions.

title: Nodes Quality Technician
description:
Career Area:

Operations

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Title: Nodes Quality Technician

Salary: £28,969 rising to £ 30,450 when role objectives are met

Contract: Full time & permanent

Location: Desford, Leicestershire


The Opportunity:

As a Nodes Quality Technician within the Quality Department, you will play a key role in maintaining and improving the quality of machines leaving the Desford facility. Your work ensures that products meet customer and dealer expectations through effective coordination, analysis, and communication.


What you will do:


As a Nodes Quality Technician, you are accountable for, but not limited to:

  • Work closely with operations and team leaders to build strong working relationships.
  • Carry out audits on machine defects to find root causes and support fixes.
  • Keep regular contact with US Node facilities through daily and weekly meetings.
  • Use defect data to identify and follow up on Interim and Permanent Corrective Actions (ICA/PCA).
  • Complete tasks on time and in line with company processes.
  • Be flexible and willing to work across shifts when needed.

NB. The panel cannot make assumptions when shortlisting therefore please demonstrate your qualifications and experience on your CV relevant to the criteria outlined.


What You Can Demonstrate:

  • Quality Knowledge Operations: Work closely with operations and team leaders to build strong working relationships.
  • Process Improvement & Problem Solving: Uses Lean, Six Sigma, and structured problem-solving tools to improve how things are done. Identifies root causes and supports corrective actions to reduce defects.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Shares information clearly with different teams. Leads meetings when needed and presents updates confidently.

What You May Have:

  • Skilled at a quality gate or with machine builds across lines.
  • Familiar with tools like EPIX, Team Centre, PRWB, or SWES.

Pending the number of applications, the criteria for the position may be enhanced to facilitate shortlisting.


What You Will Get
One Company, Limitless Opportunities

Caterpillar is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. We do business on every continent, principally operating through three primary segments – Construction Industries, Resource Industries, and Energy & Transportation – and providing financing and related services through our Financial Products segment.


Careers at Caterpillar are limitless, we have opportunities in Engineering, Human Resources, Manufacturing, Marketing, Sales, Supply Chain and so much more. You can create the career you want. It’s your time and talent, make it count.


Our Sustainability Commitment

Caterpillar has a long-standing commitment to sustainability, one of our five Values in Action. It is part of who we are and what we do. We actively lead sustainable green initiatives to preserve the environment; help reduce poverty with the Caterpillar Foundation and stay involved in the communities we help build.


Benefits: 27 days annual leave plus Bank holidays - opportunity to buy and sell, Bonus, Contributory pension scheme - Caterpillar will double the employee's contribution Up to 10%, Contributory share scheme - Caterpillar will match 50% of the employee's contribution, optional flexible benefits including access to private health and dental care plans, EV car lease etc

Travel: Not required

Posting Dates:

September 24, 2026 - October 9, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

title: Student Supply Chain Coordinator
description:
Student Supply Chain Coordinator

Our internships and Co-ops are designed to provide you with a business relevant project that will allow you to independently manage your own area of responsibility, while receiving support from an assigned Supervisor and Technical Mentor. We’ll help you discover your strengths and development areas in a challenging, fun, and supportive work environment.

We are seeking a student to join us for a 4 or 8 month co-op position starting in January 2027. This position will be based out of Edmonton, AB.

What You Will Be Working On

  • Collaborate with various departments to gather information for purchasing and subcontract administration proposals.
  • Assist in creating and formatting purchasing and subcontract administration documents, ensuring adherence to organizational standards.
  • Coordinate the review process, ensuring timely feedback from stakeholders.
  • Conduct market research related to purchasing and subcontract administration to gather relevant information for proposal content.
  • Analyze client requirements in the context of purchasing and subcontract administration, tailoring proposals to meet specific needs.
  • Stay informed about industry trends in purchasing and subcontract administration to enhance proposal competitiveness.
  • Maintain a comprehensive, accurate database of purchasing and subcontract administration-related proposal content.
  • Organize and manage files related to proposals for easy retrieval and reference.
  • Work closely with subject matter experts in purchasing and subcontract administration to understand technical details and incorporate them into proposals.
  • Communicate effectively with team members for smooth collaboration during the development of purchasing and subcontract administration proposals.
  • Conduct thorough proofreading and editing of proposals to ensure they are error-free and meet quality standards.
  • Assist in the development of templates and standard content specific to purchasing and subcontract administration to streamline future proposal processes.

This job description outlines the general nature and level of work performed by the Supply Chain Student. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties required for the role, and it may vary depending on assignment. Bird may modify or add to the job duties and qualifications as needed.

What We Are Looking For

Who We Need On Our Team


  • You are currently enrolled in Supply Chain, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or related program.
  • You will complete at least one more semester of education following your internship and possess a GPA of 3.0 or higher
  • Ability to lead and operate within an environment where change happens frequently
  • Ability to forge, grow and maintain positive relationships
  • Exemplify the Ideal Team Player – Hungry, Humble, Smart
  • Highly developed interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills
  • Sense of urgency and strong commitment to achieving goals
  • Ability to work collaboratively with a positive attitude
  • Residency, or a valid work permit which would allow you to work for Bird Construction or one of our wholly owned subsidiaries
  • If you are selected for a role with client specific requirements, you may be required to successfully complete a pre-employment Medical and/or Alcohol & Drug testing.
  • All applications must include a current transcript

For Those Who Seek to Redefine

The greatest achievements in history are borne from the greatness within people – where human potential meets vision, and passion fuels evolution. Unlocking this potential is the most important thing we do at Bird.

As a leader in Canadian construction for over 100 years, the impact of our team is etched deeply within the core of our legacy. Beyond Bird, this impact is felt in the fundamental aspects of our everyday lives. From the critical infrastructure we depend on, to the energy and resources that keep us moving - we are powering our communities and shaping Canada’s skylines coast-to-coast-to-coast. Entrenched in the foundation of a culture built more than a century ago is an enduring quest to reimagine what is possible. Our impact is greater than ever, and we are looking for those who seek to redefine their story.

What We Believe In

We Put Safety First

A healthy and safe work environment is non-negotiable. We build a culture of operational and psychological safety through engagement, learning and leadership.

We Lead With Honesty

We speak and act with integrity, clarity and care so people can trust our word and our work. Being honest means we can deliver the best outcomes and consistent results.

We Are Stronger Together

Success is a team effort. Our inclusive workplace enables our combined expertise, humility and creativity to unlock our greater potential.

We Are Driven To Do Great Work

We built our name on quality. We have a passion for excellence in our work and relationships that honours our businesses and our industry.

We Create Opportunity

Rooted in a solid foundation, we adapt and grow to face the future. We are committed to elevating each other to chart the best path forward in an evolving world.

At Bird, we value Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DE&I) and believe it is essential to our success. We will continue to listen, learn, and take action in our commitment to building progress in our organization, and the industry as a whole. Cultivating an environment where all employees feel included, seen, and have a sense of belonging is core to Bird’s culture. We commit to proactively employing a workforce that reflects the communities in which we work, fostering an environment of continuous learning, and never compromising on our values.

title: Engineering Project Manager - Conveyance
description:
Seeking a Conveyance Project Manager (PE Required)
Plummer has Impact
At Plummer, we're passionate about solving water and telecommunication challenges and serving our customers with excellence and integrity. As an engineering consulting firm, we take on a variety of interesting projects to help growing communities in Texas, Oklahoma, Colorado, and Florida.
People are Precious
Plummer has a culture that cares for people. We are all driven by our powerful mission to improve our environment, advance communities and serve others. Our team members are always striving for technical excellence and we enjoy collaborating to creatively solve unique challenges. Plummer provides a learning environment that fosters growth and encourages asking questions.
We make time for fun! Whether we are volunteering to lead engineering activities for kids, competing in a ping pong or dart tournament, or participating in a silly sock exchange, there are opportunities to connect.
What you are empowered to accomplish:
Plummer is looking for a seasoned Project Manager to join our Team. This is an exciting opportunity to manage all aspects of a project including planning, design, financials, and team coordination. The Project Manager will also establish and maintain strong working relationships with clients.
Build Lifelong Relationships:
People across the company will do their best to make you feel welcome, supported, encouraged, and celebrated. During your journey at Plummer you will meet some truly wonderful people who will inspire you to do your best. You will have the opportunity to mentor junior team members to pass on hard earned knowledge to the next generation of engineers. You will also receive ongoing guidance and mentorship from your Team Leader.
Our Ideal Teammate:
  • Our ideal teammate will have at least 6 years of professional engineering and project delivery experience working on municipal water and wastewater infrastructure.
  • Relevant experience should include conveyance-related projects such as water transmission and distribution pipelines, wastewater collection systems and interceptors, force mains, lift stations, pump stations, pipeline rehabilitation, and utility planning.
  • This position requires a bachelor's degree in civil, environmental, mechanical, or a related engineering discipline and Professional Engineer (PE) licensure in Texas or the ability to obtain Texas licensure within 6 months of hire date.
  • Our ideal teammate will have a firm understanding of engineering fundamentals and the principles associated with municipal water and wastewater infrastructure.
  • Experience developing and managing project scopes, budgets, schedules, engineering reports, construction documents, and cost estimates is preferred. We are seeking a strong communicator with leadership skills and the ability to collaboratively plan, solve problems, coordinate project teams, manage client relationships, and follow through on project commitments.
Meaning and Rewards:
One of the best parts of working at Plummer is knowing that at the end of the day we’ve done something positive to improve communities. Plummer also strives to create a rewarding and balanced work atmosphere with a generous benefits package which includes:
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • 401K with Company Match
  • PTO, Vacation Days, and Holidays
  • Parental Leave
  • Tuition and Professional Development Reimbursement
  • Telecommuting and Flexible Work Schedules
  • Wellness Program
  • Bonus Opportunities
Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this Web site or directly to managers. Plummer does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Plummer will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Plummer.

Job Description:

What’s the role

As an Associate Engineer, Digital & Drawing Management, you will support the implementation of data and document control procedures, systems, and processes in line with the Information Management Plan, ensuring document consistency, traceability, and compliance across a portfolio of projects while providing stakeholder support and contributing to the resolution of data and document management issues under the guidance of senior team members and management.

What you’ll be doing

  • As-Built Drawing Updates- Perform as-built updates of approved redlined drawings in ASSAI, ensuring engineering records accurately reflect final plant conditions and approved field changes.
  • Engineering Markup & Drafting-Convert engineering markups, sketches, layouts, and design inputs into controlled drawings supporting MOCs, brownfield modifications, asset improvement projects, and maintenance initiatives.
  • Multi-Discipline Drafting Support- Provide drafting and drawing revision support across Piping & Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation & Control, and Civil & Structural disciplines.
  • Drawing Validation & Quality Assurance-Review drawing packages for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with drafting standards, document control requirements, and engineering practices.
  • Drawing Recreation & CAD Management-Update drawings using available CAD files and recreate drawings from approved source documents when native files are unavailable.
  • ASSAI Document Control Support Maintain drawing revision control, traceability, and document management activities within ASSAI throughout the drawing lifecycle.
  • Stakeholder Coordination- Collaborate with engineers, project teams, and key stakeholders to prioritize drawing updates, resolve technical queries, and support project close-out activities.

What you bring

  • Hands-on experience using 3D model review tools such as Navisworks Freedom, Navisworks Manage, or Smart Plant Review is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience in 3D modeling and the use of modeling software such as AVEVA or Smart Plant would be highly beneficial.
  • Experience preparing and reviewing redline mark-ups and inspection sketches.
  • Knowledge of and experience working with Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs).
  • Candidates from any engineering discipline are welcome to apply.
  • Working knowledge of AutoCAD (2D and 3D) and MicroStation is preferred.

description:
Title:

Summary:

About the Role:
Do you enjoy working in a laboratory environment where accuracy, quality, and patient care come together?

Roswell Park Comprehensive Cancer Center is seeking a Clinical Laboratory Assistant to support critical blood product preparation and laboratory operations. In this role, you'll help ensure that blood components are processed safely, accurately, and in compliance with regulatory standards while supporting laboratory testing, quality initiatives, and day-to-day operations.

This position offers the opportunity to play an important role behind the scenes, helping provide the high-quality laboratory services that support patient care and research efforts across the organization.

The starting annual salary for this position is $44,560 and this can include a full comprehensive benefits package.

What You'll Do:
As a member of our laboratory team, you will:
Process blood products collected at Roswell Park, including Fresh Frozen Plasma, Red Blood Cells, and Platelets.
Follow established regulatory and quality standards to ensure blood products are prepared accurately and safely.
Coordinate and facilitate laboratory testing by ordering appropriate tests and communicating with internal departments.
Manage laboratory-related documentation through data entry, transcription, printing, faxing, and electronic communication.
Monitor and communicate laboratory results and requests through phone, email, and other communication channels.
Assist with quality control procedures and quality assurance activities that support laboratory excellence.
Support routine equipment maintenance and ensure laboratory resources are functioning properly.
Maintain laboratory inventory levels and coordinate supply ordering.
Assist with training and educational activities for employees and students.
Contribute to a collaborative environment focused on safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

What You'll Bring:
We're looking for someone who is detail-oriented, organized, and committed to maintaining high standards of quality and accuracy.

Successful candidates will have:
Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow established procedures.
Excellent organizational and time management skills.
The ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced laboratory environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
A collaborative approach to working with colleagues across departments.
A commitment to quality, safety, and regulatory compliance.
Basic computer and documentation management skills.

You'll be especially successful in this role if you enjoy:
Working with processes that require accuracy and precision.
Supporting teams through strong organization and coordination.
Learning new laboratory techniques and procedures.
Contributing to work that directly impacts patient care and outcomes.

Why You'll Love Working Here:
At Roswell Park, every team member plays an important role in our mission to eliminate cancer's grip on humanity.

When you join our organization, you'll enjoy:
Meaningful work that supports world-class patient care and groundbreaking research.
Opportunities to learn, grow, and expand your laboratory knowledge and skills.
A collaborative environment where teamwork and respect are valued.
Access to ongoing training and professional development opportunities.
The chance to work alongside dedicated healthcare, research, and laboratory professionals.
A mission-driven culture where your contributions make a real difference every day.

Join Roswell Park and become part of a team committed to quality, innovation, and improving lives through exceptional patient care and research.

Qualifications:

Required Education and Experience

1. Matriculation in a Bachelor’s degree program; or
2. Matriculation in an Associate’s degree program; or
3. High School diploma or High School Equivalency diploma and the equivalent of two (2) years of full-time experience in a clinical or research setting requiring the use of medical/laboratory terminology.

NOTE:
Degrees must be conferred by an accredited school, college, or university, or by an institution recognized by Roswell Park Comprehensive Cancer Center and/or Health Research Incorporated as adhering to acceptable educational standards.

title: Brand Expression Designer – Home Care Digital Commerce & Social
description:
Job Location

CINCINNATI GENERAL OFFICES

Job Description

This role is a chance to shape how iconic brands show up in culture, in feeds, on digital shelves, and at the exact moment consumers decide to click, scroll, or buy. As a Brand Expression Designer focused on digital commerce and social, you’ll be a hands‑on creative who brings brand stories to life through bold visuals, sharp craft, and platform‑native thinking. You’ll design content that doesn’t just look good – it performs, connects, and moves people. You’ll work inside a fast‑moving, in‑house design studio that operates with startup energy and agency‑level ambition, backed by the scale, reach, and purpose of P&G brands used by millions every day. If you’re socially fluent, creatively restless, obsessed with craft, and excited by the idea of seeing your work live everywhere – this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Create scroll‑stopping brand expression across social, paid media, and digital commerce platforms (Amazon, Walmart, Target, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and beyond).
  • Design platform‑native content (static, simple motion, short‑form video, and digital shelf assets) optimized for how people actually behave online.
  • Translate brand strategy, product benefits, and cultural moments into clear, compelling visual ideas.
  • Work quickly and iteratively, responding to briefs, trends, and performance insights with speed and creativity.
  • Maintain and elevate brand consistency while pushing visual systems forward in fresh, modern ways.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners who hold significant knowledge in performance marketing, data, design strategy, media, among others.
  • Use AI‑powered tools (Adobe Firefly and beyond) to accelerate ideation, iteration, and execution – AI is part of the workflow, not a side project.
  • Iterate work based on feedback, testing, and performance signals to continuously improve impact.
  • Own your work from concept through final delivery, with pride in craft and attention to detail.

What Makes This Role Different

  • High visibility, real impact: Your work goes live fast and reaches millions.
  • Culture‑forward: We design for real people, real feeds, and real behaviors – not hypothetical decks.
  • Creative ownership: You’re trusted to make, experiment, and evolve ideas.

title: Process Technician
description:
He kōrero mō mātou | About Watercare


Ki te ora te wai, ka ora te whenua, ka ora te tangata

When the water is healthy, the land and the people are healthy


There's never been a better time to join Watercare. We're delivering a $15.2 billion, 10-year capital investment programme, the largest in our history, creating opportunities to work on transformative infrastructure, sustainability and digital projects that will shape Auckland's future. With more than $4 million invested every day, you'll be part of work that makes a lasting difference to our communities and environment.


He whakamārama mō te tūranga mahi | About the role

We have an opportunity for a Process Technician to join our team based at our Army Bay Wastewater Treatment Plant.

This is a varied, hands-on role where you’ll play an important part in keeping our wastewater treatment plants operating safely, efficiently and effectively. Working as part of a small, supportive team, you’ll have the opportunity to build your technical capability, work alongside Process Engineers and contribute to improvements across our northern regional treatment plants.

Your day-to-day work will include:

  • Monitoring plant processes, carrying out inspections and responding appropriately to keep operations running safely and efficiently
  • Working alongside Process Engineers to identify opportunities for improvement and support project activities
  • Undertaking minor maintenance, sample collection and onsite analysis
  • Recording operational data and completing required log sheets and reports
  • Working both independently and as part of the team, including participating in the on-call roster to respond to critical after-hours alarms

Ngā pūkenga e rapu nei mātou | About you

You may already have experience in the water or wastewater industry, or you might bring transferable experience from a high-volume, continuous process environment such as dairy, petrochemical or a similar industry.

You’ll enjoy practical, hands-on work, be comfortable working both independently and as part of a team, and bring a positive approach to solving problems and getting things done.

Ideally, you’ll also bring:

  • A National Certificate or Diploma in Wastewater Treatment, or a willingness to work towards a relevant qualification
  • A relevant trade qualification or equivalent technical experience, with strong hands-on technical skills
  • Confidence using computers and familiarity with process control systems
  • A positive, proactive approach with good communication and teamwork skills
  • A full driver’s licence and availability to participate in an on-call roster

Ngā hua mōu | What's in it for you

We offer a competitive salary and staff benefits package including:
• Training and development opportunities
• Life and income protection insurance plans
• Generous parental leave
• Employee discounts at a range of large retailers

Me pēhea te tono mai | How to Apply

Come and join our team! If you are looking for an exciting career opportunity with a fantastic team then please apply online today - careers.watercare.co.nz.

title: Project Management Office - Intern, PMO
description:
THE BUSINESS

We are Everyday Luxury™.

It's what we do and how we do it — together.

It's working alongside world-class talent in pursuit of world-class results.

It's maximizing your potential in a high-performance culture.

It's knowing that wherever you are, you belong.

It's elevating your world — and the world of those who love and will love Aritzia.

It's You. And an endless runway of opportunity.

With a Global Support Campus in Vancouver and additional Support Office hubs in major cities across North America — including Toronto, New York, Los Angeles and Seattle — our workplace network is strategically designed to support our People and serve our Clients a frictionless experience. So, you can do what you do best — with us.

THE TEAM

The mission of the Project Management Office is to advance corporate business capabilities by bringing the highest impact projects to life.

THE OPPORTUNITY

This is a unique opportunity to join the Project Management Office (PMO), where you will be part of a team of certified Project Management Professionals responsible for delivering the most important, complex projects that bring new capabilities and innovations to the organization. As an Intern in PMO, you will have the chance to be involved in one of our large-scale projects to support project planning, development, and execution to ensure all requirements are delivered to a high quality, on time, and on budget. As PMO projects are highly cross-functional with exposure to business experts and cross-functional leaders, you will gain subject matter expertise in coveted business areas while you grow your project management skills to transform the biggest ideas into reality. Our goal is that you will come out of your internship inspired, with meaningful experience and an enhanced skill set you can carry forward into your bright future.

THE ROLE

As an intern in PMO, you will:

  • Champion the best project methodologies across the organization for the highest project success

  • Support the delivery of transformative projects with the most value at the right time with the right resourcing

  • Develop and maintain project artifacts and report on overall project status and critical decisions

  • Partner with the project team to ensure the completion of key project deliverables at each milestone

  • Interface with key stakeholders and support the facilitation of steering meetings and project communications

  • Cultivate a positive team environment, motivate, and engage project members as we work towards our common goal

THE QUALIFICATIONS

The Intern, PMO has/is:

  • Currently enrolled in a post-secondary institution, with a preferred graduation date of April 2027 to April 2028

  • Preferably pursuing a degree in Business, Computer Science, Technology, Engineering, Project or Operations Management

  • A commitment to learn and apply Aritzia's Values and Business and People Leadership principles

  • The ability to collaborate fluently with cross-functional partners

  • A commitment to quality and investing in results that add value to the business

  • Passion for Aritzia and the fashion industry

  • Skills and experience related to Project Management, Program Management, or Delivery Management

  • A logical, organized approach with an appreciation for structure and details

  • A problem solver who thinks critically to develop insightful solutions

  • Work experience in Aritzia Boutiques, Concierge, or Distribution Centres is highly valued

THE DEPARTMENT

PMO offers you the opportunity to learn from a dynamic, high-performing team of certified Project Management Professionals who are skilled at managing the people, processes, and business priorities of projects. Get a behind-the-scenes view into how projects come to life and be part of delivering the largest cross-functional projects at Aritzia.

Learn how a project connects from end-to-end with past projects, including:

  • Real estate development openings and expansions (e.g. new boutiques including flagships, new cafes, distribution centres with automation, and corporate offices)

  • Customer technology implementations (e.g. Aritzia App, and international eCommerce expansion)

  • Enterprise technology implementations impacting our customer experience and operations

  • Business growth initiatives (e.g. product category expansions and brand collaborations)

  • Business optimizations, process improvements, and change management

Hands-on experience that allows you to make a direct impact on a project during your internship

  • Create or contribute to analysis and presentations that will aid senior leadership in making lasting decisions

  • Cultivate strong relationships spanning multiple departments to manage cross-functional teams and partners

  • Organize resources, priorities, and deliverables to ensure efficient, effective, and on-time execution of work

Develop leadership and problem-solving skills that are transferable to any future career path or industry

  • Learn different ways of working to approach multiple conflicting priorities while under strict deadlines

  • Strengthen your adaptability to keep your sights on the big picture while immersed in the details

  • Enhance your ability to inspire team members and lead change when faced with roadblocks

THE PERKS

Some of the industry-leading benefits you will receive working at Aritzia:

  • Product Discount — Maybe you’ve heard of our famous product discount? Or our exclusive private shopping events? You have now.

  • A-OK Commissary & Cafe — Everyday Luxury dining, exclusive to Aritzia. Our in-house bistro and cafe is a private oasis where employees can enjoy curated, subsidized Everyday Luxury dining.

  • The SET — Our in-office fitness studio and gym with state-of-the-art equipment, custom-created classes and optional personal training. Open 7 days a week, it works out well.

  • Aritzia Virtual Wellness — Because your health, happiness and safety matter, we provide 24/7 resources to support you in your wellbeing goals, whether they’re physical, mental, social or financial.

  • Aspirational Workplace — Our offices are specially designed to be spaces of creativity, productivity and inspiration. They’re also dog friendly. Woof.

  • Amenities — Additional amenities include a private parent’s room, shower facilities with elevated complementary conveniences, bike rooms and more.

  • The Extras — We also offer a multitude of other perks like dry-cleaning, hotel and restaurant discounts, self-care promos and on-site medical care.

THE LOGISTICS

  • Internship Dates: May 10 – July 30, 2027 (12 weeks)

  • Location: Vancouver, BC

  • Successful candidates must be able to work at the primary work location and self-relocate if necessary

  • Application Deadline: September 27, 2026

  • Application Process:

  • Apply online – be sure to have your cover letter, resume, and unofficial transcript ready

  • Apply to one position only – interested in more than one? You’ll have an opportunity to note other areas of interest in your application.

  • Applicants moving on to the next stage will be contacted by October

ARITZIA

Aritzia is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Our goal is to be inclusive, diverse, and representative of the communities where we work while creating an environment where every person can enjoy a successful career. This commitment applies to all candidates and employees regardless of race, ethnicity, citizenship, creed, place of origin, religion, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, family status, marital status, disability, age, and any other protected characteristic.

Requests for accommodation due to a disability or any other protected characteristic can be made at any stage of the recruitment process and during employment by contacting our People & Culture Team.

We’re committed to making your experience positive and transparent. Please note, our recruiters will only contact you using an @aritzia.com email address. If you receive recruitment-related messages from other domains, please disregard them.
