title: Senior QA Engineer - AI
description:
About the Company

At Delta, we are reimagining and rebuilding the financial system. Join our team to make a positive impact on the future of finance.

🎯 Mission Driven: Re-imagine and rebuild the future of finance.

💡 Most innovative cryptocurrency derivatives exchange. With a daily traded volume of ~$ 10 billion, and increasing. Delta is bigger than all the Indian crypto exchanges combined.

📈 Offer the widest range of derivative products and have been serving traders all over the globe since 2018 and growing fast.

💪🏻 The founding team is comprised of IIT and ISB graduates. Business co-founders have previously worked with Citibank, UBS and GIC; and our tech co-founder is a serial entrepreneur who previously co-founded TinyOwl and Housing.com.

💰 Funded by top crypto funds (Sino Global Capital, CoinFund, Gumi Cryptos) and crypto projects (Aave and Kyber Network).

Senior QA Engineer - AI

🎯 Role Overview

Delta operates three AI products used by live traders: a customer support chatbot, an API Copilot that generates and executes trading scripts, and an MCP server. This role owns the quality of those products and is responsible for measuring it objectively.

Testing probabilistic systems differs fundamentally from testing deterministic ones. The same input produces different output on every run, an incorrect answer can be entirely fluent, and a prompt change in one flow can degrade another without any visible signal. The core of this role is establishing what correct means for these systems, building the datasets and scoring that measure it, and operating the release gate that prevents a regression from reaching customers.

This is an emerging discipline with no established playbook. We are defining the methodology as we build it, and the role carries a high degree of autonomy and ownership.

🔬 What Sets This Role Apart

Most QA roles that mention AI mean using AI to do testing faster: generating test cases from a PRD, healing flaky selectors, exploring an app with an agent. Those are useful and we do them.

This role is the other thing. The system under test is itself an AI, and the hard problem is deciding whether its output is correct when the same question produces a different answer every time and a wrong answer reads as convincingly as a right one. That means building evaluation datasets, defining what correct looks like, scoring against it, and defending a number that decides whether a release ships.

If you have spent time on the second problem, this role is built for you.

🛠 Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain golden datasets for our AI products, trace mined from production or generated, and verified against a documented source of truth.
  • Design layered scoring for AI outputs: deterministic rules where behaviour can be asserted, and model-graded evaluation where it cannot.
  • Manage evaluation runs end to end: schedule and execute them against release candidates, compare results against prior baselines, and triage failures into product defects, incorrect expectations, and platform issues.
  • Own and operate the release gate that determines whether a prompt or model change is approved for production.
  • Identify failure modes ahead of customers, including hallucination, incorrect tool selection, loss of context across conversation turns, and PII exposure.
  • Investigate production traces to distinguish retrieval failures from generation failures from tool failures.
  • Convert findings into actionable engineering evidence and into permanent regression coverage.
  • Define and report quality metrics for AI surfaces, and drive improvement against them.

✅ Requirements

Non-negotiable

  • At least 1 year owning quality for AI products in a lead or primary-owner capacity. This includes chatbots and conversational assistants, code or content generation products, and agentic systems. You should have worked directly with prompts, tool and function schemas, and model behaviour, rather than testing around them.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience building or operating an evaluation harness for an AI system, whether in-house or using a framework such as DeepEval, RAGAS or Promptfoo. You should be able to describe what the harness measured, the results it produced, and the decisions those results informed.

Also required

  • 4-6 years of QA / SDET experience.
  • Working proficiency in Python. Our evaluation platform, trace analysis and internal tooling are Python-based.
  • Ability to analyse traces and tool calls, using observability tooling such as Opik, Langfuse or LangSmith or an equivalent, to determine root cause rather than reporting the symptom.
  • Strong API testing experience. The majority of the surface under test is API-level.
  • Sufficient engineering ability to build your own tooling and automation.
  • Clear written communication. Findings must be documented in a form engineering can act on directly.

Bonus

  • Experience with trading or exchange platforms, including familiarity with futures and options, crypto derivatives, margin, or settlement flows. Domain knowledge can be picked up on the job, but arriving with it shortens the ramp considerably.

🚀 Why Join Us?

  • Play a pivotal role in shaping the regulatory landscape for digital assets and Web3 in India.
  • Work directly with founders and senior leadership on high-impact strategic initiatives.
  • Be part of a mission-driven, fast-growing organisation at the forefront of financial innovation.
  • Competitive compensation, leadership exposure, and significant growth opportunities.

Collaborating closely with Radiologists, Consultants and multidisciplinary colleagues, you'll deliver exceptional patient care while using state-of-the-art Siemens MRI and GE CT equipment.

From performing diagnostic examinations and cannulation to contributing to service development, patient pathways and quality improvement initiatives, you'll play an important role in maintaining the outstanding standards our patients expect. As a senior member of the team, you'll also support the training and development of colleagues while helping ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the imaging service.


Whether you're currently working predominantly in CT or MRI, full support, upskilling and refresher training in DEXA and General X-ray will be provided. We're seeking a Senior Radiographer with the flexibility, passion and team-focused approach to broaden their skills and contribute across all areas of the service.


At HCA UK we care about what you care about. We care that you want to deliver the very best care. We care that you want a career you can be proud of. We care that you want working conditions that support your health and wellbeing. Let us care for you and your career, the same way you do for others.


What you'll bring:

  • HCPC Registration
  • Experience in MRI and/or CT and General Radiography
  • Willingness to work across X-ray services and train in DEXA imaging

  • Strong understanding of patient care, radiation protection and clinical governance
  • A flexible and collaborative approach, with the ability to thrive in a small team environment



Why HCA UK?

Originally founded over 50 years ago by Dr Thomas Frist, HCA has gone on to become one of the world’s leading healthcare providers. In the UK, we’re one of the largest providers of privately funded healthcare and have invested over £500 million in the latest treatments, technology, techniques, medication and facilities. Being part of a large multisite, established healthcare group we can offer you unrivalled opportunities for career progression through internal and external courses, as well as working conditions that prioritise both your mental and physical wellbeing.


We believe that by caring for our colleagues, we empower them to provide exceptional care for our patients. That’s why we offer a host of flexible benefits that reflect the invaluable contribution they make every day. As a Senior Radiographer you’ll be eligible for:

  • 25 days holiday each year (plus bank holidays) increasing with service, with option to buy or sell leave to suit you
  • Private Healthcare Insurance for treatment at our leading hospitals
  • Private pension contribution which increases with length of service
  • Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work scheme
  • Group Life Assurance from day one
  • Critical illness cover
  • Enhanced Maternity and Paternity pay
  • Corporate staff discount for all facilities including Maternity packages at The Portland
  • Comprehensive range of flexible health, protection and lifestyle benefits to suit you
  • Discounts with over 800 major retailers

Culture and values

At HCA UK we believe exceptional care starts with our people. We celebrate the unique perspectives and different experiences each of us bring as we know that when you feel seen, heard and supported you can be at your best for our patients, and each other.


Our mission is simple, above all else we’re committed to the care and improvement of human life, a clear statement that extends to both our patients and colleagues. To achieve this, we live and breathe four core values:

  • Unique and Individual: We recognise and value everyone as unique and individual
  • Kindness and compassion: We treat people with kindness and compassion
  • Honesty, integrity and fairness: We act with absolute honesty, integrity and fairness
  • Loyalty, respect and dignity: We trust and treat one another as valued members of the HCA UK family with loyalty, respect and dignity

Reasonable adjustments

We believe everyone should feel comfortable to bring their full self to work and be afforded the same opportunities. As a Disability Confident committed organisation, we’re happy to discuss flexible working arrangements to suit your needs as well as offer reasonable adjustments throughout our recruitment process, and in the workplace, to anyone that needs them.

title: Senior Systems Analyst
description:

Manage production incidents, ensure appropriate escalation, assist in determining root cause and prioritization of application fixes based on risk and ROI

Respond to requests for adhoc analysis as well as other information delivery solutions

Proactively engage in testing new system functionality as required, provide end user training and ensure appropriate support processes are in place for any system changes

Proactively identify issues and opportunities for improved methods and approaches to support investment processes

Minimum 3 years’ experience working in an application support team/environment in the financial services industry

Experience with investment data concepts such as holdings (e.g. exposures, look through, SOD, EOD, intraday…), transactions (e.g. open, executed, allocated…), security master (e.g. security set up, pricing, static data), analytics and performance (e.g. CTR, alpha, gain/loss)

Hands-on knowledge of SQL and the ability to extract and analyse data to troubleshoot and fix issues.

Proactive analytical and problem-solving skills in investment management systems and data technologies

Hands-on experience working directly with investment professionals

Excellent written and verbal communications skills

High attention to detail and strong commitment to delivering quality, professional work is essential for this position.

Willingness and ability to work independently and as part of a global team, in a fast-paced, business-critical environment.

Experience in using AI tools such as Claude/GitHub Co-Pilot is advantageous

CFA Institute Claritas Certificate, CFA Charter or progress towards one considered an asset

title: Senior Commissioning Project Manager - Data Center Construction
description:
At Cumming Group, you will work on some of the world's most exciting projects in a dynamic environment where your success is measured by the impact you make. We are one of the fastest-growing project and cost management consultancies in the United States, as reflected in our top 15 rankings in ENR. With over 70 offices globally, an extremely diverse project portfolio, and double-digit year-over-year revenue growth, the opportunities to make your mark are limitless!



We are seeking an experienced Senior Commissioning Project Manager to lead the delivery and commissioning of large-scale data center and mission-critical infrastructure projects in Austin, TX. This role will oversee all phases of project execution and commissioning, from design review and procurement through startup, integrated systems testing (IST), and final turnover. The ideal candidate will ensure critical systems are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and meet the highest standards of reliability and operational performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead project delivery and commissioning activities from design through construction, testing, and turnover.
  • Serve as the primary client point of contact, managing project scope, schedule, budget, risk mitigation, and stakeholder communications.
  • Coordinate owners, engineers, contractors, vendors, utility providers, and testing firms to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Review design packages, equipment submittals, system diagrams, protection studies, and commissioning requirements.
  • Develop and manage commissioning plans, startup procedures, functional performance tests, integrated systems testing (IST), deficiency logs, and final commissioning documentation.
  • Oversee installation, startup, commissioning, and testing of critical infrastructure systems, including power distribution, backup power, controls, and related facility systems.
  • Verify equipment performance, operational readiness, and compliance with project requirements, industry standards, and safety protocols.
  • Manage contractor performance, procurement activities, contract administration, change management, and project reporting.
  • Lead project meetings, resolve technical issues, and provide leadership throughout all phases of the project lifecycle.
  • Travel as required to support projects across the United States.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Engineering Technology, or a related field preferred.
  • 8+ years of experience in project management, commissioning, mission-critical facilities, data centers, or large-scale construction projects.
  • Strong understanding of critical facility infrastructure, power distribution systems, backup power systems, controls, and facility operations.
  • Experience leading startup, commissioning, integrated systems testing (IST), and turnover for large-scale data center or mission-critical projects.
  • Knowledge of NFPA, IEEE, NETA, ASHRAE, and industry commissioning best practices.
  • Proven ability to manage complex projects, multi-million-dollar budgets, schedules, and cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent leadership, client-facing communication, negotiation, and technical documentation skills.

title: Reporter (Temporary)
description:
GBH enriches people's lives through programs and services that educate, inspire, and entertain, fostering citizenship and culture, the joy of learning, and the power of diverse perspectives.

At GBH, we believe in the advantages of coming together to build community, mentor and learn from colleagues, and connect more deeply with our mission. As a result, the majority of our staff are hybrid and work both from home and onsite. Our current hybrid approach requires staff to work onsite a minimum of two days each week, every Tuesday and Wednesday, Hybrid staff are also welcome to come in additional days each week or may be asked to come in on other days by their manager.

DEPARTMENT OVERVIEW

GBH News is a multi-platform local newsroom headquartered in Boston. Our goal -- through in-depth, high-quality journalism -- is to inform, educate and enlighten our audience. We cover the immediate news of the day as well issues and developments that shape our community and culture. GBH News broadcasts and streams local, national, and international news produces local talk shows and publishes a wide variety of locally sourced news online. We aim to reflect the diverse communities we serve in our journalism and our newsroom culture.

JOB OVERVIEW

GBH News is looking for an intrepid reporter to cover Massachusetts politics and policy. The reporter should be able to tap into Massachusetts' Congressional delegation as the news demands. They should be immersed in politics, and able to make connections between and among developments in the local, state, and national arenas while simultaneously being alert to cultural developments that shape the context of official action.

The ideal candidate should be able to translate the latest news out of the legislature, examine, and explain how policy changes impact the daily lives of our audiences, and infuse their reports with insights and experiences from the constituents we serve.

The reporter will focus on breaking daily news for online, radio, and social media. title: Media Specialist
description:
Title: Property Media & Listing Specialist
Reports to: Director of Marketing & Acquisitions
Location: Kaukauna, WI 54130
Pay: Starting at $20+ (based on experience)
We’re looking for a Property Media & Listing Specialist to own how our available apartments show up online—from capturing the media to getting it live.
This role is part photographer, visual merchandiser, field operator, air-traffic controller, and quality-control fanatic.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
Capture It: The shot list is the minimum. Creativity is the differentiator.
  • Photograph vacant and renovated apartments using our established shot list.
  • Create Matterport 3D tours. Find the angles, lighting, details, and composition that make each space stand out.
  • Edit and optimize photography for marketing.
  • Catch the little things before shooting—lights, blinds, toilet seats, debris, construction materials, etc.
  • Know when something isn't photo-ready and speak up.
Manage the Pipeline: The goal: nobody should ever have to ask, “Did we get pictures of that unit?” You'll use our Unit Vacancy Detail Report and construction schedule to determine what's vacant, what's coming ready, what needs media, and where you need to be next.
  • Build and manage your own shooting schedule.
  • Prioritize units based on readiness and leasing needs.
  • Coordinate with construction, property management, leasing, and marketing.
  • Track what's been captured, edited, uploaded, and completed.
  • Ensure media and listing updates are completed within the 48-hour standard.
Get It Live: You'll also help manage our listings across Apartments.com, Zillow, our ILS platforms, and property management system, including:
  • Uploading and organizing photos and Matterport tours.
  • Updating descriptions and ready dates.
  • Removing outdated or poor-quality media.
  • Selecting and ordering photos strategically—the hero image matters.
  • Reviewing live listings to ensure they're accurate, organized, and looking sharp.
YOU'LL BE GREAT AT THIS IF YOU
Have a strong visual eye, are exceptionally organized, can work independently, manage competing priorities, learn reporting systems, and have attention to detail bordering on mildly annoying. You don't need ten years of professional photography experience. You do need ownership. See an outdated listing? Fix it. Bad photo? Replace it. Unit coming ready? Plan for it. Find a killer angle that isn't on the shot list? Take the shot.
THE BOTTOM LINE
Thousands of prospective residents will see your work before they ever move into one of our communities. You're responsible for that first impression. Some days you'll be shooting. Some days you'll be editing. Some days you'll be figuring out where you need to be next. Find it. Frame it. Capture it. Get it live. Make it stand out. Then move on to the next one.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Whether you’re a recent grad or a seasoned professional, you can experience meaningful career growth at Rosendin. Enjoy a true sense of ownership as you work with a proven industry leader on some of the most exciting and high-profile projects in the nation. We offer a wide range of job opportunities, competitive compensation, full benefits, an Employee Stock Ownership Plan and more.

Why Rosendin?

Committed. Connected. Engaged.

If you’re looking to take your career to the next level and work with some of the best and brightest in the industry, we want to hear from you. We are an organization built on integrity. We have a culture that empowers people, embraces diversity and inspires everyone to do their best. Rosendin is the largest EMPLOYEE-OWNED electrical contractor in the United States employing upwards of 8,000 people. Established in 1919, we remain proud of our more than 100 years of building quality electrical and communications installations and value for our clients but, most importantly, for building people within our company and our communities. As an employee-owner you will have the unique benefit of being a shareholder at a company that is experiencing tremendous growth and success which means you benefit tremendously.

YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY:

Join our team as a Senior Project Manager where you will be responsible for the overall direction, completion, and financial outcome for several small to medium projects or one very large project. You will lead and manage a team of project managers, and assistant project managers to deliver exceptional results for our clients. The position proactively develops new business opportunities and relationships with current and potential customers.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Establish project objectives, policies, procedures and performance standards within boundaries of corporate policies. Put these in clear concise work statement for the field.

  • Effectively supervise a staff in the day to day administration of a job or supervise two or more Project Managers in their daily tasks.

  • Train and effectively supervise Project Managers in the company philosophy and systems

  • Negotiate and supervise the preparation of all change orders on the project

  • Maintain all logs required to track the progress of the project.

  • Train and effectively supervise a Project Assistant in the maintenance of project required tracking devices.

  • Maintain liaison with prime client and A/E to facilitate construction activities.

  • Monitor construction activities in conjunction with the onsite Foreman and Area Superintendent to ensure project is being built on schedule, and within budgets

  • Investigate any potentially serious situations and implement corrective measures within company guidelines, and under supervision

  • Represent company/project in meetings with client, subcontractors, etc.

  • Prepare monthly costing reports

  • Manage financial aspects of contracts (progress billing, rental equipment, income/expenses) to protect the company’s interest and simultaneously maintain good relationship with the client

  • The duties and responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and scope of work being performed by this position. This is not a complete listing and other duties will be assigned based on the role within the business unit.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL:

  • Experience managing electrical construction projects – after all, that is what we do!

  • Project accountability and initiative for all aspects of the project and its success.

  • Ability to creatively solve problems. You’ve been in the trenches before. You know what it takes to get the job done and done right for your customer and the company.

  • A strong knowledge of electrical systems, construction, and how these systems work.

  • A fanatical determination about planning, innovating, and improving the processes we use every day.

  • Ability to think outside the box and lead the team in driving innovative construction techniques and prefabrication strategies.

  • Possess strong leadership skills, business acumen, and integrity.

  • A strong understanding of the financials of a project and how to forecast.

  • Ability to create and foster great relationships with the field and understand what it takes to get the best out of your people.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with multiple stakeholders to achieve mutual outcomes.

  • We are counting on you to bring and foster a collaborative spirit to our work process.

WHAT YOU BRING TO US:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering or other related discipline preferred.

  • PE license a plus

  • Minimum 10+ years of experience in project management, preferably in electrical construction. Knowledge of construction technology, scheduling, equipment and methods required.

  • Can be a combination of education, training and relevant experience

  • Proven experience mentoring and managing others.

  • Business development/heavy client interaction a plus.

  • Ability to understand and follow standard operating policies and procedures;

  • Ability to perform duties in a professional manner and appearance

  • Extensive knowledge of safety protocols and procedure

  • Proficient in using a computer and Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, etc.); Oracle and Accubid preferred

  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks, changing priorities as necessary

  • Ability to work under time pressure and adapt to changing requirements with a positive attitude

  • Effective oral and written communication skills as required for the position

  • Ability to be self-motivated, proactive and an effective team player

  • Ability to interact effectively and professionally with all levels of employees, both management and staff alike, vendors, clients, and others

TRAVEL:

  • 10-25%

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • General work environment – Due to the variety of work to be performed, the Sr. Project Manager may be working at a job site or in the office. This position is performed primarily on active construction sites. Activity includes sitting for extended periods, standing, walking, typing, carrying, pushing, bending. Work is conducted primarily indoors with varying environmental conditions, such as fluorescent lighting and air conditioning.

  • Noise level is usually low to medium; can be loud on a job site.

  • Occasional lifting of up to 30 lbs.

  • We fully comply with the ADA and applicable state law, including considering reasonable accommodation measures that may enable qualified disabled applicants and employees to perform essential functions.

Rosendin is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are considered regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, age (over 40), or any other categories protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

YOU Matter – Our Benefits

  • 401k

  • Annual bonus program based upon performance, profitability, and achievement

  • 17 PTO days per year plus 10 paid holidays

  • Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance

  • Term Life, AD&D Insurance, and Voluntary Life Insurance

  • Pre-tax Flexible Spending Plans (Health and Dependent Care)

Job Summary

• This role is responsible for leading the strategy for business partners and developing channel programs within the country, ensuring alignment between initiatives, business objectives, and market needs. The role analyzes market requirements to design and execute partner-focused offerings, strengthens strategic relationships with key partners, and drives business growth through channel ecosystems. It also provides training and support to sales teams, develops and implements marketing programs with partners, monitors the performance of these initiatives, and generates insights to support continuous improvement. Additionally, the role stays up to date on industry trends and leads projects of moderate to high complexity.

Responsibilities

• Design, implement, and manage channel programs within the country, ensuring alignment with the organization's commercial strategy.

• Develop strategies to maintain and strengthen relationships with existing partners.

• Analyze market requirements and translate them into value propositions, programs, and initiatives for, with, and through partners, collaborating with sales and account teams to generate market demand.

• Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to partner engagement, certifications, program adoption, demand generation, and business growth.

• Execute and track channel programs and initiatives within the country in coordination with regional teams, ensuring the achievement of established objectives.

An urban oasis in the heart of the city. Set around a verdant inner courtyard, our hacienda-style Hotel puts the hectic urban hustle of Mexico’s vibrant capital city seemingly on pause, but only for as long as you’d like. Step outside our doors, and you’ll find yourself on the grand boulevard of Paseo de la Reforma, just a short stroll away from Bosque de Chapultepec and the trendy neighbourhoods of Condesa and Polanco. Want to know what makes Mexico City tick? Join us at Fifty Mils, one of the 50 Best Bars of the world, and taste the cocktails that are captivating Mexico City.

Únete a nuestro equipo diverso y talentoso de Four Seasons Hotel Ciudad de México,

Construido en torno a un idílico jardín con rayos de luz que permite que se refleje el brillo de los colores mexicanos, resaltando cada espacio que permiten un viaje de inspiración descubriendo como interactuar con la naturaleza poniendo en pausa al ruido, con una ubicación privilegiada, sobre el elegante Paseo de la Reforma y a metros del Bosque Chapultepec y del Museo de Arte Moderno. Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts abrió su primer hotel en 1961 y su historia es una historia de innovación continua, expansión notable y una dedicación decidida a los más altos estándares. Durante casi 50 años, Four Seasons ha transformado la industria de la hospitalidad al combinar amabilidad y eficiencia con las mejores tradiciones hoteleras internacionales. Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts ha sido clasificado CADA AÑO desde 1998 entre las "100 mejores empresas para trabajar" de la revista FORTUNE y ha sido nombrado "Leyenda del gran lugar para trabajar", un honor que actualmente solo tienen 12 empresas en el mundo.

Operando hoteles, resorts, y propiedades residenciales en los principales centros urbanos y destinos turísticos en más de 47 países, y con diferentes proyectos en planificación o desarrollo, Four Seasons se ubica constantemente entre los mejores hoteles del mundo y las marcas más prestigiosas en las encuestas de lectores, críticas de viajeros y premios de la industria. title: Digital acquisition officer
description:
We are looking for passionate candidates ready to contribute to our humanitarian mission.


Below, you will find the job details and the qualifications we are looking for.

Inclusivity and Diversity at MSF

Do your qualifications and experience not exactly match all requirements of the job?

At MSF OCG, we are committed to an inclusive culture that supports and amplifies the diverse voices of our staff members. We strive to create workplaces where teams of people with diverse backgrounds, characteristics, perspectives, ideas and experiences work together to advance MSF's social mission and create better outcomes for our patients and the communities we work with.

We understand that some people may hesitate to apply for employment if they don't meet all listed job requirements. Research shows that this is especially true for women. If you believe your profile is a good match for this position, we invite you to apply even if you don’t fulfil every listed qualification.
We encourage applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, background, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.
MSF does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of discrimination or harassment, including sexual harassment. All selected candidates will undergo reference checks.

Context & mission

Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).

The MSF movement is built around 5 operational centers supported by 24 sections and offices worldwide. MSF Operational Center Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centres.

The Digital Unit is one of the eight professional units within the Communications and Fundraising Department. Based across Geneva and Zurich, it brings together eight staff members. Its mission is to develop and retain audiences across digital channels in order to strengthen MSF’s communications and support donor acquisition. It is also responsible for the design, development, and administration of MSF’s digital ecosystem.

We are looking for a Digital Acquisition Officer. In this role, you manage operational activities with accuracy, judgment, and accountability. You ensure that processes run smoothly, data and documentation are reliable, and compliance standards are met. You also identify opportunities to streamline or improve day-to-day operations within your area of responsibility.


Job Purpose


Develop and implement MSF Switzerland’s digital acquisition strategy to generate new leads and acquire new donors through digital channels. Design and optimize acquisition offers, conversion journeys, and campaign performance to maximize fundraising results and support sustainable donor growth.


Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the definition of the digital acquisition strategy for regular giving, one-off giving and lead generation.
  • Lead end-to-end digital acquisition projects, from concept and planning through implementation, monitoring and performance evaluation, coordinating internal stakeholders and external specialists as required.
  • Develop and manage lead generation offers and conversion journeys to attract, engage and convert prospective supporters into donors.
  • Develop and implement email conversion campaigns and automated supporters’ journeys to nurture leads and increase donor acquisition.
  • Define and implement paid media strategies across relevant digital platforms, balancing brand awareness and fundraising objectives to maximize acquisition performance (leads and donations), cost per acquisition and long term value.
  • Manage relationships with external agencies and partners, providing strategic direction, challenging performance, and ensuring delivery against acquisition objectives (creative, UX design, developers, paid media agency…).
  • Monitor, analyse and optimise acquisition and lead conversion performance, leveraging audience insights, campaign data and testing methodologies to continuously improve results.
  • Collaborate closely with fundraising and communication teams to ensure alignment of acquisition activities with organizational objectives and supporter engagement strategies.

Your profile

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Digital Communication, Fundraising or related fiel, or equivalent professional experience.

Experience

  • Experience managing digital acquisition or fundraising campaigns.
  • Experience acquiring new donors and generating leads through digital channels.
  • Experience developing and managing paid media strategies.
  • Experience coordinating multiple digital projects and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Experience working with external agencies and service providers.

Languages

Essential

  • Native proficiency in French or Swiss German
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken

Desired:

  • Both French and Swiss German is an asset

Skills/ Technical competencies

  • Knowledge of major paid media platforms and products (Google Ads, Performance Max, Demand Gen, Meta Advantage+, LinkedIn Ads, etc.).
  • Understanding of supporter engagement, audience segmentation and conversion journeys.
  • Understanding of CRM and donor database principles.
  • Knowledge of digital analytics, attribution models and campaign tracking.
  • Knowledge of email marketing and marketing automation tools.
  • Understanding of landing page optimization and conversion rate optimization (CRO).

Personal Abilities/Qualities

  • Project management and prioritization.
  • Analytical and data-driven decision making.
  • Copywriting and content development for digital fundraising.
  • Stakeholder management and collaboration.
  • Planning, organization and attention to detail.
  • Continuous improvement and test-and-learn mindset.

Terms of employment

  • Full-time position 100% (40h/week)
  • Open-ended contract
  • Working place: Geneva or Zurich
  • Ideal start date: 5th of January 2027
  • Gross annual salary (for 100%): from CHF 87’372.- to CHF 100’608.- (salary commensurate with equivalent experience and internal salary grid)
  • Paid vacation: 25 days per year, prorate temporis, plus any Swiss public holidays falling within the contract period.
  • Pension plan: pension contribution covered 3/4 by MSF, 1/4 by staff member.
  • Relocation support available for eligible candidates.

How to apply

Candidates are invited to submit their application exclusively through our recruitment platform, following these guidelines:

  • CV (maximum 2 pages)
  • Cover letter (maximum 1 page)
  • Documents must be submitted in either English or French.

The application deadline is :

2026-10-11

We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier if we receive a sufficient number of quality applications.

All applications will be treated confidentially.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Please note that we do not wish to use the services of recruitment or placement agencies.

Job Title

Sr. Occupancy Planner

Job Description Summary

The Senior Space and Occupancy Planner is responsible for developing creative planning solutions for a client's regional portfolio which includes critical analysis, information and data management, extensive customer communications and negotiations, resulting in the ultimate customer experience.

This person will work with the Space Planning Manager in developing real estate portfolio scenarios, strategic and tactical planning, development of move plans and be a key part in driving the analysis of the data that drives solutions for our real estate strategy. This role is instrumental in the development of relationships with key business contacts to align business needs and their space requirements with space solutions.

Job Description

Job Responsibilities:

  • Support the Space Planning Lead and Workplace Strategist with the creation of the master space plan for a bank account's retail properties
  • Manage space planning activities and space allocations in support of day-to-day business unit needs.
  • Ticket management for New Hire, space, move and/or other requests for specific ticket types in assigned region.
  • Execute, track and report on space allocations in conjunction with the Moves Add Change team and ensure all changes are updated in the CAFM (space management) system.
  • Create relocation strategies and solutions for our internal customers and communicate effectively with all parties involved in each exchange.
  • Develop various planning scenarios by using qualitative and quantitative information, packing for delivery to move add change team, client leadership and business unit space champions.
  • Be comfortable with providing in-depth analysis to support space strategies and scenario planning.
  • Develop strong relationships with business contacts to understand product area focus, business adjacencies, and departmental reorganizations.
  • Update and establish space stacking plans and floor block plans, conduct space analysis, and create various planning options.
  • Prepare and present space management data for reporting.
  • Develop presentations that include visualization of space data; structure and approach for PPT/keynote presentations should be very clear; always include goal and purpose, focused, relevant, and specific content.
  • Ability to develop presentations that tell a complete, comprehensive but concise and relevant story, along with ability to present to internal team and/or broader audience with confidence.
  • Walk through spaces to document and validate occupancy as required.
  • Enthusiastically provide options and creative solutions to maximize space utilization and group productivity, foreseeing issues before they develop.
  • Develop and implement alternative space solutions that are over capacity or need to expand.
  • Integrate and understand furniture solutions as part of the solve for the space issues.
  • Keep on top of industry benchmarking and share innovative solutions with the team.
  • Creates new space layouts and suggests workplace improvements in response to client business needs and ways of working requirements.
  • Develops pilot projects to introduce new innovations and changes to the workplace model.
  • Makes recommendations to enhance operational efficiency, service delivery, cost savings, and asset utilization.
  • Collaborates with Real Estate Portfolio Strategist, Project Management, Occupancy Planners and other CRE team members.

Skills Needed:

  • Excellent customer service and negotiation skills providing premier services are a mandatory requirement of this position.
  • Thrives on working in a fast-paced environment, work collaboratively across functions and meet aggressive deadlines
  • Excellent verbal aptitude, presentation, and communication skills and be comfortable presenting to all levels of the organization.
  • Well organized, self-directed, and able to balance multiple planning projects.
  • Proactive and solution focused with experience in managing projects of varied scope and complexity.
  • Enjoy working in a team environment with smart and creative individuals, a team player is a must, with the ability to also work independent and autonomous.
  • Possesses strong analytical skills and the ability to develop conclusions and recommendations.
  • Demonstrates proficiency in architectural and engineering drawings, concepts & design.
  • Demonstrates a working knowledge of various office furniture systems.
  • Excellent customer service and interpersonal relationship skills.
  • Able to build strong relationships with internal and external partners to deliver effective services.
  • Strong oral, written and presentation skills along with a strong attention to detail and quality.
  • Assumes ownership of requests to ensure successful completion.
  • Ability to handle concurrent projects with minimal supervision and direction.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree and/or a combination of 5-10 years of space and occupancy planning experience.
  • Minimum of five years’ experience in a corporate real estate environment.
  • MS Excel, PowerPoint, AutoCAD and relevant (applied) CAFM proficiency required, Intermediate Level at minimum.

At C&W Services, we live by the belief that Better Never Settles. We're dedicated to creating a positive impact globally, and we're looking for talented individuals to join our team.

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance Team repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Safety: Promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures.
  • Maintenance: Complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation. Troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more.
  • Monitoring: Create, assign, and close out work order with data including labor hours, equipment maintenance, and parts used. Track and store department inventory.
  • Support: Mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.
  • Communication: Maintain positive working relationships across all of the Operations facility.

Basic Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 2+ years of experience in the repair of material handling equipment (MHE) or automated conveyor systems and controls.
  • 2+ years of experience conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures.
  • 1+ years of blueprint and electrical schematic reading.
  • 1+ years of knowledge with electrical and electronic principles.
  • Experience with a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Project, with the ability to create and manage documents effectively.
  • Ability to work flexible schedules/shifts.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associates or higher degree from a vocational school or college with a focus on Mechanical or Electrical field.
  • Experience with Material Handling Equipment (MHE) safety standards accordance with Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and Safety standards.
  • Experience with robotic operation and maintenance.
  • Able to troubleshoot basic input and output functions.

Physical Demands:

  • Must have ability to reach overhead, kneel, squat, climb steps/ladders, use an aerial lift, and frequently lift a maximum of 50 lbs. of equipment.
  • Ability to perform tasks wearing appropriate or required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), which may include but is not limited to hard hat, face mask, face shield, and composite toe shoes.
  • Regularly required to crouch or bend and reach to install/move equipment.
  • Involves movement between departments, floors, and properties to facilitate work, averaging 6 to 12 miles per day.
  • Work in a warehouse environment with fluctuating temperatures.
  • Regularly required to type on a computer for 1-2 hours per day.

We're recognized by the Human Rights Foundation as a Best Place to Work for LGBTQI+ individuals and are dedicated to continuing to build a culture of inclusion and respect.

What’s Next?

Ready to take the next steps in your career? Apply today and be part of a team that is making a difference!

title: Lot Assistant
description:
Who We Are:
At OPENLANE we make wholesale easy so our customers can be more successful.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive pay

We’re looking for:

Are you ready to be part of a dynamic team in the automotive industry? OPENLANE, a leader in automotive remarketing, is looking for a Lot Assistant with experience in coordinating vehicle inventory. The ideal candidate will have prior experience working at a dealership or similar organization, controlling vehicle inventory, and preparing vehicles for transport.


This is a full-time position, and hours may range from 7:30am - 6:00pm, Monday through Friday.


You Are:

● Adaptable. You will be able to pause & shift tasks to assist other departments with priority requests.

● Careful. You are mindful of your surroundings, working safely and carefully.

● Dependable. You are reliable and can be counted on to complete your tasks as assigned.

● Safe. We care about safety and you should too. You will operate a variety of motor vehicles safely, per our driver safety procedures

● Organized. You will be responsible for maintaining an organized and orderly lot to ensure efficient operations, including completing regular inventory scans


You Will:

● Ensure vehicles are ready for auction and ensuring vehicles are in working order (i.e. boosting, adding gas, attending to lock outs, preparing for towing, and filling tires)

● Accurately record any services provided (fuel, tow, etc) to ensure accurate billing

● Photograph vehicles post-reconditioning services

● Provides customer service by assisting customers or other internal departments in retrieving their vehicles

● Assist with vehicle stock in & check out process

● Operate vehicles under various weather conditions and may be required to manually remove snow through various means (clearing vehicles of snow, light shoveling in the yard, operating

plow truck, bobcat, loader, etc.)

● Assist with snow and ice removal from lots, walkways, and egress routes.

● Inspect the interior of vehicles, cataloging all personal items (electronics, documents, clothing, valuables) on a formal inventory sheet.

● Safely remove personal belongings from the vehicle cabin and trunk without causing damage to the items or the vehicle.

● Photograph items and vehicle conditions, ensuring accurate matching of the items to the correct Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) or impound file.

● Transfer and store removed property in a secure, climate-controlled, or locked holding area for a mandated statutory retention period (often 30+ days).

● Maintain the exterior of the property, including light landscaping, removing trash, and general upkeep

● General custodial duties, including cleaning of floors, and groundskeeping

● Assist Lot Manager with identifying and completing maintenance projects and repairs


Must Haves:

● High School diploma or equivalent

● Valid Class 5 Drivers’ license is required

● Basic computer & smartphone skills required

● Experience working outside in all weather conditions

● Strong customer service and communication skills


Nice to Haves:

● Ability to drive both standard & automatic transmissions

● Ability to bend, reach, and lift medium-to-heavy boxes or items from tight vehicle spaces.

● High level of accuracy in record-keeping, labeling, and data entry to prevent lost or misattributed property claims.

● Professional demeanor when interacting with distressed or upset vehicle owners claiming their possessions.

● Bilingual in French and English is ideal

● Qualified/Experienced in operating plow trucks, bobcats, loaders, and/ or tow trucks is strongly preferred

● Being licensed to operate motorcycles or ATVs

title: Project Director, Talent Search Grant
description:
Job Profile Summary

Under the direction of the Senior Director of Student Success (reporting through the Dean of Student Services to the Vice President of Student Services), the Project Director provides strategic leadership, administration, coordination, and oversight of the federally funded TRIO Talent Search (TS) REACH Project. The project is designed to assist low-income and first-generation students in grades 6 through 12 with academic preparation, educational planning, college access, career exploration, and financial aid navigation to support enrollment and success in postsecondary education.
The Director is responsible for ensuring the project achieves all approved objectives and operates in compliance with U.S. Department of Education regulations, grant requirements, College policies, and applicable federal and state laws. Responsibilities include program planning and implementation, personnel supervision, participant recruitment and eligibility verification, service delivery oversight, fiscal management, performance monitoring, data collection, reporting, partnership development, and continuous program improvement.
The Director serves as the primary liaison regarding the project with Broward County Public Schools Career, Technical, Adult and Community Education (CTACE) Department, HANDY, Inc. and/or other subaward recipients and community partners, target schools, postsecondary institutions, and the U.S. Department of Education. These responsibilities are reflected in the approved grant Plan of Operation.

This position is funded through the U.S. Department of Education TRIO Talent Search REACH Grant and is currently authorized through August 31, 2031. Continued employment is contingent upon grant funding, annual performance evaluations, and contract renewal.

Minimum Education

Bachelor’s degree in one of the following areas required. Master's degree preferred.

  • Education
  • Counseling
  • Educational Administration
  • Higher Education Administration
  • A closely related field

Minimum Experience/Training

  • Six (6) years of progressively responsible experience designing, implementing, coordinating, or managing educational programs serving youth, or comparable program/project management experience.
  • Demonstrated experience working with disadvantaged students and youth in educational settings.
  • Experience providing or coordinating counseling, academic advising, student support services, or related educational programs.
  • Experience coordinating multiple activities, personnel, partners, and deliverables.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with students, families, educators, administrators, and community stakeholders.
  • Strong written, verbal, organizational, technology, and project management skills.

Preferred Experience

Experience with:

  • TRIO or other federally funded college access and student success programs
  • Federal grant administration and project management
  • Academic advising and career counseling
  • Curriculum, program, or service development
  • Federal grant regulations and compliance requirements
  • Programs serving low-income, first-generation, and underserved populations
  • Retention and student success initiatives
  • Personal experience overcoming academic and/or economic barriers similar to those experienced by the population served
    Essential Functions

    Daily - 20%: Program Leadership, Administration, and Compliance

    Provides overall leadership, planning, implementation, and operational oversight of the Talent Search Grant Project. Ensures all project activities comply with approved grant objectives, U.S. Department of Education regulations, College policies, recordkeeping requirements, fiscal accountability standards, and applicable federal and state regulations. Liaises with and ensures seamless coordination with subrecipients on all project activities, including data collection and tracking. Prepares and submits required reports, including the Annual Performance Report, and serves as a liaison with the U.S. Department of Education regarding project administration, performance, and compliance.

    Daily - 15%: Student Services, Academic Advising, and College Access Programming

    Directs and participates in the delivery of academic advising, educational planning, career exploration, tutoring referrals, course selection guidance, college preparation, financial literacy activities, FAFSA and scholarship assistance, college admissions support, campus visits, dual enrollment preparation, industry credential awareness, and other Talent Search services designed to promote secondary completion and postsecondary enrollment.

    Daily - 10%: Personnel Management and Professional Development

    Recruits, hires, trains, supervises, assigns work, evaluates, and develops project personnel, including the Assistant Director/Career Pathway Navigator. Establishes performance expectations, fosters teamwork, provides coaching and professional development, and promotes effective collaboration among College employees, school personnel, and community partners.

    Weekly - 20%: Participant Recruitment, Eligibility, and School Partnerships

    Leads outreach, recruitment, eligibility verification, enrollment, and retention efforts to ensure required participant objectives are achieved. Maintains productive relationships with principals, counselors, teachers, advisors, and CTACE, HANDY and/or other community partner staff to facilitate recruitment, referrals, academic monitoring, interventions, and student support services. Conducts meetings with school personnel and project partners to coordinate program implementation and address participant needs.

    Weekly - 10%: Individualized Student Planning and Performance Monitoring

    Ensures participants receive needs assessments, individualized academic and career plans, progress monitoring, and appropriate intervention services. Oversees systems for tracking participant eligibility, academic achievement, service delivery, graduation progress, FAFSA completion, postsecondary enrollment, and other federal performance indicators.

    Monthly - 10%: Partnership Coordination and Subrecipient Oversight

    Manages partnerships with schools, colleges and universities, workforce organizations, and community agencies. Implements and monitors subrecipient agreements with community partners, evaluates performance and deliverables, coordinates collaborative activities, and maintains stakeholder engagement to support project objectives.

    Monthly - 5%: Budget Administration and Fiscal Management

    Develops, administers, and monitors the approved project budget. Reviews expenditures, authorizes purchases within delegated authority, conducts routine budget reviews, and collaborates with Grants Accounting, Grants Management, and College leadership to ensure appropriate stewardship of federal funds and adherence to grant requirements.

    Monthly - 5%: Program Evaluation, Continuous Improvement, and Related Duties

    Reviews project implementation, participant outcomes, service utilization, budget performance, and progress toward approved objectives, in collaboration with an external evaluator. Identifies opportunities for improvement, implements corrective actions, participates in professional development activities, attends meetings and conferences.

    As Needed - 5%: Performs related duties as assigned.

    Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

    • Models inclusive excellence through specific actions that support the College’s mission in the recruitment, hiring, and retention of talented and diverse faculty and staff
    • Extensive functional knowledge and expertise in all aspects of own and related areas of the College, and pertinent interdependencies
    • General understanding of the external environment and how it affects academia in general and Broward in particular, including political, legal, environmental, educational, financial and social influences
    • Strong knowledge of College structure, policies and practices, and the impact on own area
    • Strong supervisory and team building skills
    • Ability to partner with others across the College and externally to exchange information, collaborate on projects, share resources, etc.
    • Ability to influence others of the benefits/importance of an idea or plan of action and to gain their support or commitment
    • Strong negotiation skills and ability to reach mutual points of agreement and benefit among peers and colleagues
    • Knowledge of federal grant administration, compliance requirements, FERPA, and applicable federal and state regulations
    • Strong organizational, leadership, and project management skills
    • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills
    • Ability to establish productive partnerships with schools, community organizations, government agencies, and College departments
    • Ability to manage multiple priorities, timelines, and reporting requirements
    • Strong negotiation, collaboration, and consensus-building skills
    • Ability to analyze data and use findings to improve program performance
    • Proficiency with technology, virtual collaboration tools, and data management systems
    • Ability to interact effectively with diverse populations and foster a student-centered environment

    Our Culture - At Broward College our leaders embody a culture of competence, care, character, composure and courage. We prioritize serving each other and our students through high-quality guidance, mutual respect, resilience and fair, thoughtful decision-making, all while upholding the values of integrity, transparency and honesty.

    Broward College offers an exceptional benefits package, including, but not limited to:

    • Affordable High Quality Healthcare Insurance (Medical, Dental & Vision)

    • Retirement Options – Florida Retirement System (FRS) Pension Plan or the FRS Investment Plan

    • Wellness Program

    • Vacation/Paid Time Off

    • Winter and Spring Break Off

    • Paid Parental Leave

    • Tuition Assistance and Tuition Reimbursement are available to employees and family members

This is a generalist role — you should be comfortable reading and writing production-quality code across multiple languages, and equally comfortable designing and running an AppSec program that spans SAST, DAST, and SCA tooling, secure architecture reviews, and developer enablement. This position will require occasional after-hours and weekend work. The selected candidate will be expected to attend work on a regular and predictable schedule in accordance with agency leave policy and perform other duties as assigned.


Key Responsibilities

Design and drive the application security strategy across the SDLC — from design reviews through CI/CD to production.

Own and continuously tune **SAST** (e.g., Checkmarx, Fortify, Semgrep, CodeQL), **DAST** (e.g., Burp Suite Enterprise, OWASP ZAP, Invicti), and **SCA** (e.g., Snyk, Black Duck, Mend, Dependency-Track) tooling — integration, rule tuning, false-positive reduction, and coverage.

Perform secure architecture and design reviews for new features, services, and major system changes.

Read, write, and refactor code (not just review it) to build internal tooling, PoCs for vulnerabilities, custom scanners, and secure-by-default libraries/frameworks.

Conduct manual code reviews and threat modeling for high-risk services, complementing automated tooling.

Partner with engineering teams to remediate vulnerabilities, and act as a technical escalation point for security findings.

Build and maintain CI/CD security gates (pre-commit hooks, pipeline scanning, break-the-build policies).

Define and evangelize secure coding standards, guardrails, and reusable security patterns/libraries.

Run or support penetration tests and coordinate remediation with engineering.

Mentor developers and security champions; deliver secure coding training.

Track and report AppSec metrics (vulnerability density, MTTR, tool coverage, false-positive rates) to leadership.

Stay current on emerging threats (OWASP Top 10, CWE/SANS Top 25, supply chain attacks) and evolve the program accordingly.


Required Skills:

**Engineering foundation (must-have — this is a generalist coding role, not a pure GRC/tooling role): **

Strong hands-on software development experience in at least one backend language (e.g., Java, Python, Go, Node.js, C#) and working familiarity with others.

Comfortable reading and writing code across the stack — APIs, web front ends, mobile, or infrastructure-as-code, as relevant to your environment.

Solid understanding of software design patterns, frameworks, and modern CI/CD pipelines.

**Application security expertise: **

Deep, practical experience with **SAST**, **DAST**, and **SCA** tools — selection, deployment, tuning, and interpreting results (not just running scans).

Strong grasp of OWASP Top 10, OWASP ASVS, CWE/SANS Top 25, and secure design principles (authN/authZ, cryptography, input validation, session management).

Experience with threat modeling methodologies (STRIDE, PASTA, or similar).

Familiarity with container/cloud security (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/Azure/GCP security services) is a plus.

Understanding of software supply chain security (SBOM, dependency risk, artifact signing).

Experience building custom security tooling or writing SAST/DAST rules.

Exposure to regulated industries (BFSI, healthcare) or compliance frameworks (PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2).

title: Regulatory Policy Specialist
description:
Xcel Energy (NASDAQ: XEL) is a leading energy provider and Fortune 500 company, dedicated to serving millions of electricity and natural gas customers across eight states: Minnesota, Colorado, Wisconsin, Michigan, North Dakota, South Dakota, New Mexico and Texas. We make energy work better for our customers, helping them thrive every day. That means always raising the bar - delivering better service and providing more reliable, resilient, and sustainable energy.

Xcel Energy is a place where you’ll have opportunities to grow, expand your skills, and help lead the clean energy transition. We offer meaningful rewards, recognition, and support to help you build your career and make an impact - both on the job and beyond. Most importantly, it means you’ll be joining a company that knows employees are the driving force behind its success and is committed to helping you be your best.

Xcel Energy supports a hybrid work model to enable collaboration and flexibility. Many roles are expected to work onsite three days per week (Tuesday–Thursday); however, work location expectations vary based on role, team, and business needs.

Work directly with senior management to develop regulatory case filings and strategies that support the company's strategic goals and objectives. Consult with subject matter experts throughout the company to develop filings and strategies consistent with company goals. Communicate and work effectively with regulatory case management teams to ensure filings consistent with strategies. Prepare supporting testimony in regulatory proceedings, administrative rulemaking and legislative hearings as necessary. Coordinate regulatory compliance activities in assigned jurisdictions.


This position will be a part of the generation and transmission team and will be expected to lead large complex regulatory filings across our generation, transmission, and large load proceedings.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the development, compilation and editing of regulatory case filings. Provide clear written explanations of complex issues. Applying regulatory experience, understand and identify key facts in order to develop effective messages. Responsible for ensuring documents created are concise and well-organized. Also responsible for ensuring these documents conform to the style, tone and formatting conventions as part of standardized, consistent approach to regulatory filings. Demonstrates technical expertise by maintaining a thorough understanding of the regulatory structure of Xcel Energy companies and the regulatory environment in which we operate. Responsible for advocating the company's positions with regulators and stakeholders in a variety of forums (e.g. regulatory proceedings, administrative rulemakings, legislative hearings, etc.).
  • Develop, compile and edit large, complex filings. Support multiple projects while delivering high quality work product. Ensure proper controls of documents are maintained; soliciting and screening feedback from stakeholders to incorporate as appropriate. Communicate (written and oral) regularly with senior management and internal customers to ensure awareness of current regulatory case filings and issues that impact the company. Work directly with senior management throughout the company to develop and promote regulatory and legislative policy positions. Work effectively with regulatory case management teams to ensure filings are consistent and production of work is efficient. Work and write in a time constrained environment.
  • Assist with the drafting of discovery responses. Applying regulatory experience, evaluate responses for effectiveness in responding to the question presented. Ensure appropriate context consistent with the company's request.
  • Responsible for the development of key messages for presentations to external regulatory agencies and legislative committees. Responsible for the development of presentations for internal audiences. Work in partnership across the business area and teams to achieve results.
  • Assist witnesses in development of pre-filed testimony.


Minimum Requirements

BA/BS. Five to seven years or equivalent experience in regulatory field.

- Specific experience in dealing with regulatory filings required.

- Occasional overnight travel and extensive overtime required.

- Must be proficient in use MS Office Suite.


Preferred Requirements

title: Product Builder- Ops Automation Squad
description:
At Pluxee, we shape the world of employee benefits and engagement by bringing to life a personalized and sustainable employee experience, at work and beyond.

Permanent Regular

Job Description:

The mission

We are looking for a Product Builder to join the new global Ops Automation Squad within Product & Engineering at Cobee by Pluxee.

The squad will turn operational needs shared across countries into reusable product capabilities, self-service tools and automation that help the platform scale.

Your scope will focus on the global platform: common product workflows, reusable configuration capabilities, standard APIs and data interfaces, and shared tools that enable country teams to work more efficiently.

Your mission will be to understand operational problems, identify opportunities for reuse across countries, and build reliable solutions that reduce manual effort, improve product quality and deliver measurable impact.

This is a hands-on role combining product thinking, technical fluency and delivery: mapping processes, speaking with users, analysing data, prototyping with AI or automation tools, building with Engineering, shipping solutions and measuring adoption.

What you will build

Within the global product roadmap, examples of the capabilities you may build include:

  • Reusable self-service capabilities for benefit and wallet configuration, with common validation rules and controlled access.

  • Shared platform provisioning and onboarding capabilities that support deployment and adoption across countries.

  • Reusable tools for bulk product actions, with approvals, validation and audit trails.

  • Common product validations that prevent inconsistent data and reduce avoidable operational exceptions.

  • Standard APIs, events and data interfaces that enable country teams to connect their processes to the global platform.

  • Shared internal tools that give Operations and Customer Care teams visibility into product workflow status and help them diagnose issues.

  • Human-in-the-loop features within reusable automation, with appropriate permissions, review steps and traceability.

  • Reusable AI assistants and automation components that help teams navigate product workflows and information.

  • Improvements to existing global automation based on user feedback, product defects and adoption data.

Success means reliable capabilities that country teams can adopt and reuse, with measurable reductions in manual work and errors.

What you will do

As Product Builder, you will:

  • Work with country Operations, Finance, Customer Care and IT teams, alongside global Product, Engineering and Data, to understand shared needs and product friction.

  • Map workflows, edge cases, dependencies and data flows to identify which needs can be addressed through common product capabilities.

  • Assess reuse potential, expected impact and implementation effort, and contribute proposals to global product prioritisation.

  • Build and validate prototypes using AI tools, internal tooling, low-code/no-code platforms, APIs, scripts, data analysis or lightweight product interfaces.

  • Work with Engineering to build, test and maintain reliable global capabilities, following platform standards and release practices.

  • Define success metrics for each initiative: adoption across countries, time saved, fewer manual steps, lower error rates and better user experience.

  • Use data and feedback from country teams to size opportunities, inform roadmap decisions and measure outcomes after release.

  • Document product behaviour, interfaces, configuration options and usage guidance so country teams can adopt the capabilities effectively.

  • Build permissions, auditability, monitoring and appropriate human oversight into the global capabilities you deliver.

  • Investigate defects in the squad’s delivered capabilities with Engineering and improve their reliability and usability over time.

What we are looking for

We are looking for people who are comfortable with ambiguity, complexity and execution.

You may come from Product, Operations, Engineering, Automation, Consulting, RevOps, FinOps, Product Ops, Business Operations or a similar background. What matters most is your ability to understand complex systems and build practical solutions.

You should have

  • Strong product judgment and a builder mindset.

  • Experience improving operational, financial, administrative or internal workflows.

  • Ability to understand complex processes and simplify them without losing control.

  • Comfort working with technical teams, APIs, data models, integrations and internal tools.

  • Hands-on experience with automation, AI tools, no-code/low-code platforms, SQL, scripting or workflow tools.

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to define and measure business impact.

  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical teams.

  • A bias for action: you do not wait for perfect specifications to start learning.

  • High ownership: you follow through from problem discovery to reliable delivery, adoption and measurable impact.

  • Good judgment around risk, compliance, privacy, data quality and operational control.

Nice to have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, benefits, payroll, HR tech, insurance, SaaS or regulated environments.

  • Experience with invoicing, billing, reconciliation, settlements, financial operations or accounting workflows.

  • Experience with HRIS, payroll providers, SFTP/API integrations or employee data flows.

  • Experience building internal tools for Operations, Finance, Customer Care or Partner teams.

  • Experience using AI agents, copilots or LLM-based workflows in real business processes.

  • Experience with tools such as Retool, Metabase, SQL, Zapier, Make, n8n, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitLab, PostHog or similar.

  • Ability to write lightweight scripts or query data independently.

  • Spanish and English fluency. Portuguese would be a plus.

How we work

We work in small, empowered squads with strong ownership and fast iteration cycles. We value clarity, direct communication, curiosity and high standards.

With Project Singular, we are changing the way Product, Design, Engineering, Data and Operations work together. We value people who combine product thinking, technical fluency, practical use of AI and ownership of outcomes.

The squad works within global Product & Engineering and follows the global product roadmap. Country Operations and IT teams are key partners in discovery and adoption, and own the day-to-day execution and control of their local processes.

Why join now

This is an opportunity to join a new global squad from day one and shape how Cobee by Pluxee builds reusable automation across countries.

You will work on real problems that affect clients, employees and internal teams, building shared capabilities that improve the platform and help country teams scale. You will see your work move from an initial prototype to an adopted product capability.

If you enjoy complex problems, real users, hands-on building with AI and automation, and measurable impact, this role is for you.




Why join Pluxee?


Join an inclusive team

Work at the heart of the community alongside 5,000 experts across 29 countries - we embrace diversity and value uniqueness, fostering a workplace where everyone can thrive.

Turn inspiration into possibility

Get space to try new ideas, experiment and move the world of work forward as you bring new digital experiences - and moments of connection - to millions of people.

Make a positive impact

Touch millions of lives and create meaningful change for people and the world we share, supporting our commitments to diversity, sustainability, and local economies.

Grow with us

Get support you need to take meaningful steps in your career, whether you're performing your work/life balance or learning new skills.

title: CNC Operator
